item.title: 6 Maximalist 2027 Wedding Dress Trends Taking Over The Aisle
item.description: From Carrie Bradshaw-worthy rosettes to edgy cat-eye necklines, here are the six biggest maximalist 2027 wedding dress trends to know.
item.dc:creator: Alyssa Lapid, and ,Ashirah Curry
item.content:encoded:
The fashion industry’s more-is-more mentality has found a new runway that’s perfect for peacocking: the aisle. In 2027, brides are poised to be bolder and more fashion-forward than ever, pulling high-drama styles straight off the buzziest catwalks. So if you’re about to say “I do,” consider this your cue to go all out and have fun with your look. You’re the star of the show, after all — and your wedding gown needs to keep up with your main-character energy.

Next year, traditional silhouettes are taking a back seat. Brides-to-be are embracing sculptural, gallery-worthy pieces that blur the line between bridalwear and art. The exaggerated hip trend, made famous by Schiaparelli, is staging a full-on wedding takeover, while timeless strapless gowns are getting an edgy makeover. Instead of your usual straight or sweetheart necklines, designers are leaning into striking, pointy cat-eye cuts that practically demand a close-up.

Oversize floral touches are also bringing major SATC energy to 2027. Expect larger-than-life rosettes blooming all over gowns and delicate 3D floral appliqués accenting veils.

For those looking to make an entrance, the upcoming bridal lineup is right up your alley. Read on for six maximalist wedding dress trends guaranteed to turn every head in the room as you walk strut to your soon-to-be spouse.

2027 Wedding Dress Trends

Lace is hardly groundbreaking in the bridal world. Once considered the epitome of opulence, the delicate fabric has practically become a neutral. But next year’s take on the material looks anything but ordinary. Rather than the usual body-hugging dresses or intricate overlays on fuller gowns, designers like Cult Gaia are experimenting with translucence, proportions, and fabric manipulation. Think sheer sets that could double as lingerie (some complete with built-in corsets), dresses featuring asymmetrical sleeves, and skirts finished with cascading peplums.

Emilia Lace Gown

Sau Lee -

Whilemena

Danielle Frankel -

Agnes Topper

Jenny Yoo -

Geneviève

LOHO Bride -

Hips are having a major style moment, driven largely by Daniel Roseberry at Schiaparelli, whose runways regularly feature rigid gowns with exaggerated, jutting hips. Next year, expect fashion-forward brides to embrace all sorts of hip-enhancing drama, from subtle sculpts to surrealist flares.

For a classic-meets-modern take, opt for a ballgown with a basque silhouette. Or go all in with a dramatic hoop-style skirt inspired by Marie Antoinette, the historical poster child for ornately exaggerated hip gowns. Hang these in the Louvre.

Zuleyha Kuru Maugi Gown

Anthropologie -

Danielle

Jenny Yoo -

Maria-Antoinette Wedding Dress by Rara Avis

Luxx Nova -

Sense

LOHO Bride -

Who needs a bouquet when your dress is practically blooming? The oversize rosette aesthetic, once popularized by Carrie Bradshaw, has infiltrated the bridal space, with designers like Demetrios and Lirika Matoshi leaning into garden motifs. Go for a voluminous ballgown with blooms sprawling down the skirt, a column silhouette with a wreath of flowers enveloping your hips, or even a minidress with an entire garden sprouting along the hem.

Beatrice Wedding Dress by Rara Avis

Luxx Nova -

Mikado Floral Mini Dress SS26 Look #19

Esé Azenabor -

The Rose

Lirika Matoshi -

Barbara by Stephanie Cachapuz

Wedding Atelier -

Sure, brides have long been fans of corsets. But next year’s take on the sculpted bodice is edgier, more risqué, and a whole lot more undone. Exposed boning is taking center stage, adding texture to everything from minimalist gowns to intricate embroidered designs. Some even feature artful draping around the waist, creating the illusion of a gown caught mid-undress. And because the structure is on full display, you can even tweak the curves (or angles) to suit your vibe — pairing a straight tube neckline with a dramatic basque dip, for example, or embracing more unconventional cuts.

Julie Corset with Carnation Embroidery

Wiederhoeft -

Gris

LOHO Bride -

Sutton Embroidered Skirt

Sau Lee -

Galia Satin Corset Gown

Meshki -

Speaking of necklines, one that’s bound to become a favorite next year is the cat-eye, aka a strapless bodice with pointy peaks. From minimalist body-hugging satin sheaths to voluminous tulle-clad princess gowns, just about any piece can benefit from this subtle, edgy update. It’ll instantly earn you the title of coolest bride in the room.

Pro tip: Style it with a lace choker or skinny reverse scarf to emphasize the sharp details.

Garland

Atelier Arielle -

Greta Wedding Dress

Rasario -

Carmela Fringe Bow Fitted Gown

Walone -

Cardero Dress

Park & Fifth -

Gowns aren’t brides’ only opportunity to embrace maximalism. Enter: the statement veil. 2027 brides will be swapping traditional styles for something more eye-catching and decidedly modern. Picture a massive bow doubling as a hair clip on a floor-length veil or a fitted lace cap with a billowy tulle train. No veil? No problem. A headpiece covered in oversize rosettes works just as well. It’s giving *couture*.

Isabetta Veil

Daughters of Simone -

Organza Floor Sweeping Bow

Kamperett -

Veil Astra

Voir Bride -

Braelynn Juliet Veil

Jennifer Behr -

Floral Headpiece with Crystal Face Veil

Diba Celina -

item.title: Under The Radar Black Friday Deals You Don't Want To Miss
item.description: Shop under-the-radar Black Friday deals on Lelo sex toys, luxury bedding, sleep clocks, beauty essentials, lingerie, and more must-have steals.
item.dc:creator: Carina Finn
item.content:encoded:
Black Friday is practically its own micro-season now, which means there are already some excellent under-the-radar deals you'll want to know about. Whether you're buying a gift for yourself—like one of Lelo's award-winning sex toys—or are looking to make a big home upgrade with new bedding or a sleep-tracking alarm clock, this is the best time of year to make a big purchase. Our team of shopping experts is constantly on the lookout for the deepest discounts and most exciting scores of the sale, so check back often to see what new steals we've found for you.

A Bra That Makes You Look Like The Season’s Most-Anticipated Gift

Adore Me Signature Bow Unlined Cupless Bra

Adore Me -

Who doesn’t want to be unwrapped like a present on Christmas morning (or better yet, Christmas Eve?). This bra from Adore Me has an unlined, cupless design that makes it both sexy and comfortable, and the bow tie front makes it so much fun to wear and even more fun to take off. Get it as part of a matching lingerie set for a spicy winter night, or be bold and style it with a cropped jacket and your favorite denim as part of a going out look.

An Elegant Work Bag With Old Money Energy

JEMMA EMMA 37 Bag

JEMMA -

Get this full grain leather bag as a gift to yourself, or as a gift for the person on your list who just got a new job or a big promotion. Jemma’s iconic Emma 37 bag is made from luxe Italian full grain leather with gold-toned hardware that makes a splash with its simplicity. It’s large enough to hold a 14” laptop and all your daily essentials, but the smaller size keeps it looking chic with an office siren outfit.

A Fluffy Comforter You’ll Want To Snuggle Under All Winter Long

Bedsure Fluffy Comforter

Amazon -

There’s nothing like getting cozy under the covers with a pile of pillows, a cup of hot chocolate, and your comfort show on a winter weekend. This fluffy comforter is the key to maximizing that experience, and it’s one of Amazon’s best under-the-radar Black Friday deals. It comes in Twin, Full, Queen, and King sizes as well as an array of on-trend colors.

A Warming Personal Serum That’ll Help Things Heat Up

Epiphany Her Arousal Serum

Sometimes, you just need a little help getting warmed up, and this arousal serum is one satisfying way to get there. All it takes is a teeny bit of this serum, strategically applied, and you’ll be treated to a gentle warming sensation that’ll get your senses all perked up.

An Alarm Clock That Resets Your Circadian Rhythm

Hatch Sleep Clock

amazon -

You’ve probably seen the Hatch Sleep Clock all over social media, and if Daylight Savings Time has been wrecking your sleep schedule, consider this sale your sign to finally buy one. You can create a fully customized routine that includes sleep tracking, so you can optimize the settings as you go.

Salt & Stone’s Best-Selling Lineup

Salt & Stone Full Body Set

Salt & Stone -

Get the full lineup of Salt & Stone’s body-care bestsellers with this heavily discounted set. It includes a body wash, body cream, deodorant, and body mist, all in a ready-to-gift box. Choose from three different scents: saffron and cedar, santal and vetiver, or bergamot and hinoki.

A Vibrator That Hits All The Right Spots

LELO ELISE™ 2 G-spot Vibrator

LELO -

Most vibrators only have one internal motor, but this one has two motors at the base and tip to provide intensely pleasurable sensations. It has an easy-to-use control panel featuring eight unique settings, and the entire thing is 100% waterproof—so it’s safe to use in the shower.

A Pair Of Festive, Barely-There Undies

Adore Me Signature Bow Bikini Panty

Adore Me -

These bikini panties have a backless style with a bow-tie closure that’s so fun to undo. They’re made from a soft, silky fabric that feels great against the skin. You can buy them as part of a matching lingerie set, or wear them under your cutest holiday dress for a very special after-party.

An Ultra-Moisturizing Hyaluronic Acid Serum

Beauty Pie Triple Hyaluronic Acid & Lipopeptide Serum

Amazon -

Want dewy, bouncy mochi skin before the year is out? Add Beauty Pie’s triple Hyaluronic Acid serum to your cart. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and won’t leave a sticky finish, and it layers well under sunscreen and makeup. It’s the perfect boost for your beauty routine if plump, glowy skin is your goal.

A Shower Filter That Promotes Healthier Hair & Skin

Filterbaby Showerhead Pro BOGO Bundle

Filterbaby -

Say goodbye to chlorine, chloramine, and the other heavy metals that may wreaking havoc on your hair and skin. This shower filter works by removing said heavy metals, as well as mineral deposits, for skin that looks healthier and hair that feels less cleaner and less heavy. Especially ideal for households with hard water, it’s designed to fit easily onto most American showerheads and takes mere minutes to install.

An Ergonomic Pillow That Spices Up Your Sex Life

LELO Sex Pillow

LELO -

If you think you don’t need a sex pillow, try rotating through your favorite positions with the help of Lelo’s wedge-shaped one and see if you still feel the same way at the end of the night. It features a unique inflatable design that not only makes is discreet and travel-friendly, but also allows you to adjust the firmness so you can get the exact right amount of support.

A Trio Of Vibrators That Are Guaranteed To Make You Smile

Smile Makers Art of Pleasure (3 Pieces)

Smile Makers -

What’s better than your favorite vibrator going on sale for Black Friday? How about a variety pack of waterproof silicone sex toys to add intrigue to your solo or partnered sex sessions. This pack from Smile Makers comes with a rabbit-style vibrator, a wavy internal want, and the palm sized Ballerina for ultimate external stimulation.

A Lightweight Color Corrector For Flawless “No Makeup” Days

BeautyPie Superluminous Color Corrector

Amazon -

The basis of a great no makeup look isn’t just moisturizer or SPF—although they’re important, too—you’ll also want a good color corrector. This one from BeautyPie comes in an easy to use compact, and all you have to do is dab it on with your fingertips for an effortless look. The green color helps to neutralize redness and blemishes with the brightening power of Vitamin C.

item.title: 90 Cheap Gifts That Are So Damn Bougie
item.description: From bookworms to beauty gurus and more, there’s something here for all the loved ones on your list.
item.dc:creator: Caroline Reinstadtler
item.content:encoded:
Bougie gifts don’t have to cost a fortune. You can give your friends and family impressive presents they’ll absolutely adore, even when you’re on a budget. From bookworms to beauty gurus and more, there’s something here every taste that looks a lot more expensive than they really are. Keep scrolling to discover incredibly chic favorites at great prices.

A Fluted Loaf Pan Made Of A Nonstick Silicone That's PFAS-Free

Nordic Ware Fluted Loaf Pan

Amazon -

Banana bread, chocolate cake, and lots of other desserts look so much bougier in this fluted loaf pan. It's made of a PFAS-free nonstick silicone that effortlessly releases your bread. It's also oven-safe up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit. Holding up to 6 cups of batter, its intricate design will look stunning on any table.

Highlighter Pens That Underline In Fun Patterns & Colors

AECHY Colored Curve Highlighter Pens (8-Pack)

amazon -

With these highlighter pens, color-coding your notes has never been more fun. On one side, they have a traditional felt-tip highlighter; on the other, they have a roller that underlines in fun designs and colors. Their ink is nontoxic and dries quickly to minimize smudges. Since they come in a sturdy snap case, you can store them as a set.

A Stunning Suncatcher For Indoors Or Out

HDCRYSTALGIFTS Crystal Hanging Suncatcher

Amazon -

Designed for indoor or outdoor use, this hanging suncatcher has fancy chandelier vibes. It’s 1 foot long and reflects little rainbow flecks of light all over the walls and surrounding space. One fan wrote, “Higher quality than expected and it’s more beautiful in person.”

Car Tissue Holders That Fit In Your Cupholders

Winoo Designs Car Tissues (4-Pack)

Amazon -

If you sneeze while you steer, invest in these car tissue holders. They fit snugly into cupholders, keeping them close at hand while you drive. Each one contains 50 tissues, and each pack comes with four boxes to keep you stocked up. The tissues themselves are absorbent and soft to the touch. You’ll also fall in love with their floral prints and color palettes.

Mixing Bowls With Airtight Lids & Silicone Bases To Keep Them Steady

Wildone Mixing Bowls with Airtight Lids (22 Pieces)

Amazon -

Every baker needs these mixing bowls in their arsenal. Airtight lids keep batters and ingredients fresher for longer, especially when stored in the fridge. Silicone bases hold them steady on your counters while you whisk. These also come with three grater attachments, an egg separator, a flexible spatula (for scraping icing off the bowls), and more. Reviewers gave them an overall score of 4.7 stars, with one noting, “Wish I had known about them when I first started cooking!”

A Retractable Car Charger With 4 Ports & A Shockproof Design

LISEN Retractable Car Charger

amazon -

Power up any device with this retractable car charger, which currently has an overall score of 4.6 stars on Amazon. With two USB ports, it charges multiple electronics at once. It also has a shockproof design that keeps it running smoothly, even on bumpy roads. Adjust its angle to keep using your phone while it charges (unless, of course, you're in the driver's seat).

Scented Lava Gel Pens Infused With Essential Oils

Lifelines Scented Lava Gel Pen (5-Pack)

Amazon -

Stimulate your senses with these scented lava gel pens that are infused with essential oils for an aromatherapy experience. These oils include jasmine, peppermint, cedarwood, and more. With a 0.5 millimeter gel tip, they write smoothly. Plus, you can turn them upside down to activate their colorful bubbles.

A Measuring Spoon Set That Comes With A Holder

XDONEF Cactus Measuring Spoons Set (5 Pieces)

Amazon -

This measuring spoon set is both fashionable and functional. Its spoons are designed to look like cactus leaves, instantly dressing up your countertops. They're coated with a lead-free ceramic glaze for food safety. When they get dirty, pop them in the dishwasher. Best of all, the flowerpot measures exactly 1 cup.

A Book With An Embossed Cover That Holds Up To 300 Photos

JIMBON Our Adventure Book Scrapbook

Amazon -

Make treasured memories, then document them in this adventure book. It holds up to 300 photos, giving you visual reminders of all the magical places you've been. Its hardcover protects the pages inside, while its embossed lettering looks gorgeous on any shelf. It also has a craft paper bag on the back for stamps, tickets, and other memorabilia.

Fan-Fave Collagen Masks With 41,000+ 5-Star Reviews

BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Reviewers are legit obsessed with these collagen face masks. Coming in a pack of four (with two separate pieces for a good fit), they go clear over three to four hours (or overnight) as the ingredients sink in, and it has earned a 4.5-star overall rating on Amazon. It’s formulated with niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, collagen, and more to boost radiance and hydration.

Glass Coffee Mugs With Airtight Bamboo Lids & Gold Spoons

LANDNEOO Vintage Coffee Mugs (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Make mug cakes, overnight oats, and more in these glass coffee mugs. Each mug has an airtight bamboo lid to keep food and drinks fresh. The set also comes with four gold spoons that look stunning with any dishes. Embossed designs on the mugs add elegance and flair to even the busiest of mornings.

A Heatless Curling Headband With 2 Satin Scrunchies To Secure Your Hair

ROBECURLS Heatless Hair Curler Set

Amazon -

For damage-free definition, try this heatless curling headband. It’s easy to use — just wrap dry or damp hair around it, then secure the ends with the included satin scrunchies. Its integrated wire bends to wrap around your head, while its satin charmeuse is gentle on hair. By reducing friction and breakage, it can also help with healthy growth.

A Book Nook Kit That's Lit From Within

CUTEBEE Book Nook Kit

Amazon -

Any literature lover would adore this book nook kit. Lit from within, it emits a soft glow to decorate your bookshelves. You can assemble it in about one to two hours — and it comes with a detailed manual to guide you every step of the way. It measures 4.6 inches wide, so it should fit on every shelf. With its intricate details, it creates a tiny world all its own.

A Slushie Maker Cup With A 2-In-1 Straw & Spoon

RELPOM Slushie Maker Cup

Amazon -

Enjoy your favorite frozen treats at home with this slushie maker cup. Sip or scoop it with the two-in-one straw and spoon. Made of food-grade silicone, it's safe to reuse. Simply freeze it for four to five hours, add any chilled drink, and squeeze the cup. You'll have a flavorful dessert that works with almost any drink you can imagine.

A Memory Foam Pillow With A Separate Storage Block

Bespilow Memory Foam Lap Desk Pillow

Amazon -

WFH is way cozier with this memory foam pillow. Its bonus storage block comes with compartments that are great for snacks, glasses, and other work essentials. Its ergonomic design supports your arms and elbows, and it also helps keep your eyes far away from your screen, reducing strain and fatigue. If it gets dirty, caring for it is easy — just unzip its cover and toss it in the washing machine.

Glowing Crystal Balls With A Stable Wooden Base

KRISININE Crystal Chakra Balls Night Light (8 Pieces)

Amazon -

Each of these glowing crystal balls represents one of your chakras. When you buy, you'll receive seven spheres, lit from within by LED bulbs. A stable wooden base supports them on any flat surface. Plug them into the wall with their USB cable, which measures just over 3 feet long. They have a purposefully cracked design, which gives them a bougier look.

An Amethyst Lamp With Genuine Crystals

Runyangshi Crystal Table Lamp

Amazon -

Illuminate your bedroom with this amethyst lamp. Amethyst is known for helping with relaxation, and each of its crystals is one-of-a-kind, making your lamp totally unique. You can choose between three color modes, and adjust its brightness from 20% to 100%. It plugs into any USB port, with buttons that are intuitive and easy to use.

Dye-Free Hand Sanitizer Sprays That Are TSA-Friendly

Touchland Hand Sanitizer Sprays (3-Pack)

Amazon -

Free of dye and coming in two dreamy scents, as well as one unscented version, Touchland hand sanitizer sprays are a functional yet chic way to avoid getting sick and keep your hands cleaner. The one-ounce sprays are small enough to take on a plane — and they’re slim enough to slip in a pocket.

A Roomy Corduroy Tote Bag In Fun Patterns

Miss Adola Corduroy Tote Bag

Amazon -

Featuring a fun pattern and cozy corduroy material, this tote bag features all the pockets you could want and two styles of handles for wearing over your shoulder or across your body. It’s large enough to hold a 15-inch laptop, has two inner pockets, and plenty of space to keep your water tumbler and other must-haves handy. Peruse all the other options in the listing for a perfect aesthetic fit.

An Insulated Coffee Mug With A Leakproof Lid

Ideus Insulated Coffee Mug with Lid

Amazon -

Hot and iced drinks taste equally delicious in this insulated coffee mug. Its leakproof lid prevents splashes, so you can easily take it to work, school, or on the go. It's made of a food-grade stainless steel that's free of lead and BPA. With an ergonomic handle, it’s easy to hold.

A Toiletry Bag With A Hanging Hook That Swivels 360 Degrees

BAGSMART Toiletry Bag

Amazon -

Take your favorite products wherever you go in this toiletry bag. With four separate compartments, it helps you organize your makeup, medicine, and more. Its sturdy metal hook makes it easy to hang and swivel for easy access, and its water-resistant fabric helps it withstand wear and tear. Padding inside helps protect your items even more.

An Insulated Neoprene Cup That Prevents Condensation

Sok It JavaSok Insulated Cup Sleeve

Amazon -

Iced coffee lovers need to know about this insulated neoprene cup. Made of durable neoprene, it fits cups between 16 and 20 fluid ounces. Its thick fabric keeps your hands away from condensation, and its outer layer is waterproof. Because it folds down flat, you can easily pack it in your purse for impromptu trips to the coffee shop.

A Waterproof Face-Cleaning Brush With Vibration & Heat Features

PRITECH Facial Cleansing Brush

Amazon -

Get a deeper, more thorough clean with this clever silicone facial-cleansing brush. In addition to scrubby nubs and a vibration mode (with five vibration patterns), it also has a heat feature (on the metal end) to help breakup and remove any oil or makeup buildup on the skin. It’s waterproof for use in the shower or bath and rechargeable, too.

An Acupressure Mat & Pillow Set To Alleviate Muscle Tension

ProSourceFit Acupressure Mat and Pillow Set

Amazon -

Unwind after a long day with this acupressure mat and pillow set. After 10 to 30 minutes of use, it can help reduce muscle tension, back discomfort, and headaches. Its cushioned foam supports your neck and back while it works its magic. It's equipped with almost 9,000 acupressure points, and it’s also great for feet.

Candle Warmers With Built-In Timers For Extra Peace Of Mind

Briever Dimmable Candle Warmer Lamp

Amazon -

These candle warmers are a flameless way to enjoy your favorite scents. Set their built-in timers, and they'll run for two, four, or eight hours, then shut off on their own. You can also choose between four temperatures; the hotter they are, the faster they melt your candles. Adjust their heights to fit candles up to 5.9 inches.

A Lip Balm Holder That Sticks To Car Consoles

CHRSHN Chapstick Holder for Car

Amazon -

Instead of rummaging through your purse, invest in this lip balm holder. With its strong 3M adhesive, it sticks to car consoles, so you can reapply while you drive. It's also great for desks, nightstands, and other flat surfaces. When you’re stuck in traffic, its warm smile and vibrant pink hue will cheer you right up.

Foodie Dice That Answer “What’s For Dinner?”

Two Tumbleweeds Foodie Dice – Seasonal Dinner Inspiration

Amazon -

If your dinner routine is getting stale, shake things up with these foodie dice. They come with five primary dice and four seasonal veggie dice. These include a cooking method, a protein, an herb, and more. They're also vegetarian and vegan-friendly, so you can use them to cook for your whole family.

A Pink Light Box That Comes With 220 Letters & 180 Emojis

BONNYCO Cinema Light Box

Amazon -

Speak your mind with this pink light box. With 220 letters and 180 emojis, it’s customizable with any word or phrase you can imagine. It also comes with two markers and 30 clear cards, so you can write your own. It can be powered by either six AA batteries or the included USB cord. Each letter has a protective film to keep it sturdy against wear and tear.

Fuzzy Memory Foam Slippers That Wick Away Moisture

LongBay Women's Fuzzy Faux Fur Memory Foam Cozy Flat Spa Slide Slippers Comfy Open Toe Slip On House Shoes Sandals (Large/ 9-10,Cream)

Amazon -

Relax comfortably with these fuzzy faux fur slippers. Crafted with cozy memory foam, they also have a nonslip rubber sole to be more functional throughout the home (and even outside). With a terry cloth lining, they work to wick away moisture. The hardest part of this purchase will be convincing yourself to take them off.

  • Available colors: 6
  • Available sizes: 5-6 — 11-12

A Bamboo Charcuterie Table That Comes With A Set Of Cheese Knives

Piticco Bamboo Charcuterie Picnic Table with Knives

Amazon -

Bring this bamboo charcuterie table to your next picnic. It comes with four stainless steel cheese knives and a matching stand. It measures 17-by-13-by-9 inches, and it folds up nicely, so you can store it in your picnic basket. Made of durable bamboo, it's stylish and smooth. You can even use its built-in cupholder for wine, champagne, and dishes full of snacks.

A Birthstone Pendant That's Plated With 14 Karat Gold

Turandoss Pink Sapphire Birthstone Necklaces for Women, 14K Gold Plated Birthstone Necklaces for Women Dainty October Birthstone Necklace Gold Necklace for Women Jewelry Gifts

Amazon -

Celebrate your birthday all year long with this birthstone pendant necklace. Plated with 14 karat gold, it’s comparable to any pricer pieces you'd find at the jewelry store. It comes with extension chains, so you can customize its length. You can choose between 12 colors of cubic zirconia.

Leaf Bookmarks Featuring Vibrantly Painted Metal

WY LIGHTING LEVEL store 4pcs Metal Bookmarks

Amazon -

Avid readers will fall in love with these leaf bookmarks. Featuring painted metal, they’re made to last, with intricate designs that look like miniature works of art. Their vibrant colors and adorable charms make them pop off the page. When you buy, you’ll receive four bookmarks in four different variations.

A Daily Planner That's Undated, So They Can Start Any Time

ZICOTO Daily Planner

Amazon -

If you’ve ever bought a planner, only to realize in March you haven’t touched it, try this daily planner instead. It’s undated, so you can start planning anytime — even months after you buy it. Its spiral binding and corners are gold, and its minimalist lettering looks gorgeous on any desk. It helps you plan out 120 days and track your habits, helping you break old patterns and start new ones.

A Cordless Bedside Lamp With 3 Brightness Levels

Xhope4u Cordless Bird Bedside Lamp

Amazon -

If birds don’t sing outside your window in the morning, this cordless bedside lamp is the next best thing. Choose between three colors and three brightness levels for a glow that's all your own. Its rechargeable battery shines for up to a week on a low setting and four hours on the brightest. It has a flat, stable base, and it's gentle on your eyes.

A Roll-Up Puzzle Mat That Keeps Every Piece In Place

Becko Roll Up Puzzle Mat

Amazon -

For screen-free fun, try this roll-up puzzle mat. It works with puzzles of up to 1,500 pieces, so even the most experienced puzzlers can use it. It includes an inflatable tube and a felt mat to wrap around it, as well as two elastic bands to secure your pieces in place. A drawstring bag gives you an easy storage solution.

Collagen Sheet Masks That Are Suitable For All Skin Types

I Dew Care Sheet Masks (14-Pack)

Amazon -

Give your skin a spa night with these collagen sheet masks. They come in a pack of 14, with six different varieties. You can choose between hydration, brightening, de-stressing, and more. They're suitable for all skin types, and they're free of potential irritants, including parabens, sulfates, and phthalates.

An Acetate Claw Clip Available In 16 Personality-Packed Designs

OMG Decor Claw Clip

Amazon -

Durable and strong, this claw clip belongs in your accessory drawer. It's made of a cellulose acetate material that's difficult to break. With a glossy sheen and bright red hue, it's a personality-filled accessory that looks good on everyone. If cherries aren’t your thing, it’s available in 16 other fun and colorful designs.

A Bath Pillow With Nonslip Suction Cups

Binobella Bathtub Pillow

Amazon -

Relax and unwind with this bath pillow. It's ergonomically designed, supporting your head, neck, and shoulders while you soak. Its mesh fabric dries quickly, preventing mildew from building up. It's also machine-washable and comes with a protective mesh bag, as well as a hanging loop. It even comes packaged in a chic gift box, making it a great last-minute pick.

An Insulated Lunch Bag Made With A Water-Repellent Fabric

Carhartt Insulated Lunch Cooler Bag

Amazon -

Whether you’re braving the office or the great outdoors, you might like this insulated lunch bag. Its water-repellent fabric keeps your food completely dry, even if you get caught in the rain or snow, and its zippered compartments are great for organization. Plus, the Carhartt logo looks cool with any outfit. You can carry it by its shoulder strap or by the handle on top.

Easy-To-Clean Car Coasters With Grooves To Catch Liquids

SINGARO Car Cup Coasters (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Road trips call for these car coasters. They come in a pack of four, each one measuring 2.77 inches in diameter. They're made of high-quality silicone, which is waterproof and dustproof. Their grooves are designed to catch liquids, keeping your interiors clean. When you get to your destination, simply rinse them off in the sink.

Fluffy Slippers Made Of Soft Faux Fur With Wear-Resistant Soles

NZFUN Cow Slippers

Amazon -

If you don’t feel like moo-ving today, throw on these fluffy slippers. Their soles are nonslip and wear-resistant, so you can step outside safely. Their soft faux fur material feels like you're stepping onto a cloud. Thick memory foam soles support your arches while you walk. These cute cows are available in multiple color options.

  • Available sizes: 5.5-6.5/4.5-5.5 — 13-14/12-13
  • Available colors: 14

A Personalizable Sign You Can Use Inside & Out

Dyoart Personalized Garden Stake Metal Sign

Amazon -

Customize your outdoor space with this personalized sign. The word or phrase of your choice is transcribed onto steel using laser-cutting technology. The metal is also rustproof, waterproof, and fade-resistant. Available in seven different designs, you can use it indoors or outdoors; its stake will stay put in any potted plant.

A Jewelry Case With 3 Tiers That’s Great For Secure Travel

Vlando Viaggio Jewelry Case

Amazon -

Travel with this jewelry case to keep your collection organized. With three tiers, it provides individual compartments for your necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and more. Its adorable tassel and metallic details make it a perfect complement to your cutest luggage. Made of faux leather, it resists scratches and damage while you’re on the go.

Shower Steamers Made With Essential Oils For Aromatherapy

JoJowell Aromatherapy Shower Steamers (18-Pack)

Amazon -

Make your next shower a therapy session (aromatherapy, that is) with these shower steamers. They're made with concentrated essential oils that release slowly while you scrub. Some of their scents can even help relieve congestion, so they're great for sick days. Each package comes with six scents: eucalyptus, mint, lavender, watermelon, grapefruit, and citrus.

An Essential Oil Diffuser That's Minimalist & Chic

Craft & Kin Reed Diffuser Set Amber Moss, Reed Diffusers for Home, Fragrance Diffuser Sticks, Oil Diffuser Sticks, Oil Diffuser with Sticks, Reed Diffuser for Men

Amazon -

This essential oil diffuser looks just as good as it smells. Its green glass jar is a chic, minimalist addition to any room. It works without heat or flame, making it a great choice for homes with kids. Its jar holds about 3.5 ounces of oil at a time. When it runs out, you can repurpose its jar in tons of different ways.

A Peel-Off Lip Stain For Lasting Color That's Fragrance-Free

Sacheu Lip Liner STAY-N & Lip Elixir Bundle — Long Lasting Matte Lip Tattoo, Transfer Proof Lipstain Infused with Hyaluronic Acid & Vitamin E, for All Skin Types — P-inked and Clear

Amazon -

You’ve probably seen this peel-off lip stain all over social media, and for good reason. It delivers lasting color, as well as hydrating with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E. Its formula is fragrance-free and vegan, and it's safe for all skin types. Simply line your lips, then apply the lip elixir; wait up to 20 minutes, then peel it off.

An Initial Bracelet Made Of Hypoallergenic Metal That Won't Fade

Turandoss Gold Initial Bracelets - 18k Gold Plated Letter Initials for Women, Bridesmaids Gifts

Amazon -

This initial bracelet could represent your own name or that of someone you love. Plated with 18 karat gold, its metal is hypoallergenic, durable, and fade-resistant. Its letters are bold and easy to read. Fasten it with its lobster clasp to keep it securely in place while you wear it all day. It also happens to arrive in a velvet bag, so it's ready to be gifted.

Gold Eye Patches Made With Collagen & Caffeine To Help Wake You Up

PLANTIFIQUE Gold Eye Patches (20 Pairs)

Amazon -

Long nights call for these gold eye patches in the morning. Made with collagen and caffeine, they depuff and brighten to make you feel more awake. Each box comes with 20 pairs, so you'll be fully stocked for about three weeks. Safe for sensitive skin, their vegan formula is free of potential irritants like parabens and sulfates.

An Under-Eye Brightener With Caffeine & Peptides For A Quick Refresh

Palladio Under Eye Brightener

Amazon -

This under-eye brightener is packed full of rejuvenating ingredients. With caffeine and peptides, it instantly refreshes dark circles and tired skin. It's Leaping Bunny certified as cruelty-free, and it's made without parabens, too. It has a medium-coverage effect, so it works with or without makeup. As one customer raved, “The texture is silky, it applies easily, and it melts into your skin.”

Reviewer-Backed Lotion Capsules That Are Easy To Tote On The Go

Jergens Lotion Bursts (38 Pieces)

amazon -

These lotion bursts make it easy to keep skin hydrated on the go or during a trip. The bottle contains 38 little capsules that can be smoothed into skin that provide 24 hours of moisture each. They feature a cherry almond scent and one fan wrote, “I carried them all around New York and they didn’t melt. [...] When you start to rub it in, it magically becomes normal feeling lotion. [...] Super effective.”

A Nail & Cuticle Cream Made With Shea Butter & Rice Bran Oil

Onsen Cuticle Cream

Amazon -

Home manicures are even more luxe with this nail and cuticle cream. Made with shea butter and rice bran oil, it hydrates and soothes, creating a stronger base for polish. It also has mineral-rich hot spring water from Hokkaido, Japan, which may help with healthy growth. Its compact tube makes it perfect for packing in toiletry bags or suitcases.

Wireless Earbuds That Last Up To 48 Hours On A Full Charge

Wekily Wireless Earbuds

Amazon -

Gift these wireless earbuds to the music or podcast lover in your life — or keep them for yourself. They last up to 48 hours on a full charge, and their noise-cancelling capabilities make your favorite songs sound even clearer. Their smart touch design enables you to answer calls, hang up, skip songs, and more.

A Cult-Favorite Tumbler With A Leakproof Lid For Any Adventure

STANLEY IceFlow 2.0 Flip Straw Tumbler

Amazon -

This stainless steel tumbler is the perfect companion for any adventure. Its double-walled insulation keeps cold drinks cold, while its handle makes it easy to carry. With a leakproof lid and a flip straw, it prevents splashes and spills. It holds 30 ounces of water, coffee, and any other beverage of your choice.

A Wooden Puzzle That’s Worthy Of Display When Complete

Mys Aurora Wooden Puzzle

Amazon -

Pretty enough to display after it’s complete, this wooden puzzle features real-looking succulents — and many pieces have a unique shape (like an animal, plant, or something else). Made with 200 pieces, it’ll take about four hours to complete, and it even comes with a puzzle-saver sticker to show it off at the end.

A Detangling Brush That Works Equally Well On Wet & Dry Hair

Crave Detangling Brush

Amazon -

Knotted, matted strands are no match for this detangling brush. Its flexible bristles gently work their way through hair without ever tugging or pulling. Compact and lightweight, it fits snugly into purses and carry-ons. Use it on wet and dry hair alike; it minimizes breakage and works on all hair types.

A Painting Board With A Soft Brush That Uses Water Instead Of Ink

Buddha Board Original Water Painting Board

Amazon -

Temporarily bring your ideas to life with this painting board. Just dip its soft brush into water, then write and draw as you would with paint. That said, unlike paint, your designs will disappear, so you can restart as often as you like. Each set includes a board, a brush, and a water tray. Handle your board by the edges to keep it fingerprint-free.

Self-Heating Eye Masks With A Lavender Scent

BeHoomi Steam Eye Masks (20-Pack)

Amazon -

These self-heating eye masks are a great alternative to pricey spa treatments. Just place them over your eyes, and they heat up on their own, relaxing you right away with their lavender scent. Their fabric is skin-friendly and hypoallergenic, and since flexible hooks hold them in place, you can toss and turn without shaking them off.

A Makeup Bag With A 3D Cat Design That Closes Tightly

Openhahaha Drawstring Makeup Bag, Cat Makeup Bag, Travel Makeup Organizer, Cosmetic Pouch Bag, Cat Gift for Women, Lay Flat Makeup Bag Gifts for Cat Lovers

Amazon -

Store cosmetics and brushes in this drawstring makeup bag. With a 3D cat head, it's a hilarious addition to your bedroom or bathroom. Its fabric is soft to the touch while its detailed design is sure to make you smile. It measures 7-by-7 inches and closes with its drawstrings, giving you ample (and somewhat flexible) storage space.

Wine Wands Designed To Remove Histamines & Sulfites

PureWine To Your Health Red Wand Filters (8-Pack)

Amazon -

Allergy sufferers may want to try these wine wands. Removing up to 95% of both histamines and sulfites, they can alleviate symptoms like headaches and stuffy noses. Simply swirl one in your drink for about a minute, then start sipping with confidence. They also enhance the taste and aroma of every glass.

A Book Page Holder Made Of Walnut Wood For One-Handed Reading

TILISMA Book Page Holder

Amazon -

Any avid reader should have this book page holder in their arsenal. It lets you read with one hand, so you can snack, sip a drink, and more. It's handmade from walnut wood by talented artisans, and its ergonomic design is gentle on hands. At just over 3 inches long, it fits into pretty much every book. It also comes in multiple sizes to best fit your fingers.

Waterproof Solar Garden Lights With LED Bulbs

ASMAD Solar Garden Lights (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Snow, rain, and high heat — these solar garden lights can handle them all. Made of waterproof materials, they can handle anything Mother Nature throws their way. You don't need any plugs or cables to install them. Instead, simply press them down into the dirt, and their solar panels will do the rest, shining for up to 12 hours on a full charge.

Pearl Stud Earrings With Modern Details

Barzel Caged Pearl Stud Earrings

amazon -

Meticulously made, these pearl stud earrings look much more expensive than they are. They’re made in Brazil with painstaking attention to detail. Each one features a 6-millimeter pearl with a coating encased in 18-karat gold. They're entirely nickel-free, making them safer for sensitive ears. Plus, their strong backings keep them in place all day. “Beautiful earrings!” wrote one reviewer. “I got these to wear for work, and they are perfect and lightweight.”

Flameless Flickering Candles With A 4.5-Star Overall Rating

Kakoya Flameless LED Candles (Set of 5)

Amazon -

Highly rated and packing major ambiance, this set comes with five flameless pillar candles. Despite the realisitic look and flickering lighting mode of the “wicks,” they’re each powered by two AA batteries.

A Wooden Terrarium Made With Premium Borosilicate Glass

XXXFLOWER Plant Terrarium with Wooden Stand

Amazon -

Whether you’re new to gardening or have always had plants, you’ll adore this wooden terrarium. Its base is flat and stable, protecting your herbs and small hydroponic plants from accidents. Its vases are made of a premium borosilicate glass that resists heat. Since they're crystal-clear, you can watch your plants grow from every angle.

An Electric S'Mores Maker With A Flameless Heater

Nostalgia Electric S'mores Maker

Amazon -

With this electric s’mores maker, you can have your favorite summer dessert all year long. Its flameless heater works just as well as a backyard bonfire — and it's safer. When you buy, you'll receive two stainless steel forks and four trays to store ingredients. It's easy to disassemble when you're finished, so you can wash the trays before your next use.

A Gone-Viral White Truffle Facial Serum For A Dewy Glow

d'Alba White Truffle Face Serum

Amazon -

Boasting a 4.5-star overall rating on Amazon after more than 37,000 reviews, this facial serum packs an unexpected ingredient: white truffles. The high load of antioxidants they provide deliver a glow and dewy finish that reviewers are raving about. “This might be my favorite overall skincare product. It’s a non-greasy, lightweight formula that sits great under makeup or as part of a toner-flooding routine. It refreshes powder makeup to correct cakey-ness and gives a natural looking glow. Smells divine,” wrote one shopper.

A Bonsai Starter Kit You Can Use Indoors Or Outdoors

Planters' Choice Bonsai Starter Kit

Amazon -

Give your space a touch of greenery with this bonsai starter kit. It includes four different species of seeds, as well as burlap pots, a soil disk, and bamboo markers. A comprehensive booklet keeps you informed every step of the way. You can choose whether to grow your trees indoors or outdoors, and you can use them at any time of the year.

A Stained Glass Suncatcher With A Sturdy Metal Frame & Chain

DASTOLL Stained Glass Window Hanging Suncatcher

Amazon -

Rainbows make everything better; bring more into your life with this stained glass suncatcher. Hang it by its chain, which attaches to its sturdy metal frame. Its colorful glass comes to life when the sun shines, casting a wide array of colors onto the walls. Its frame measures 6.3-by-6.3 inches, and with its chain, it's about 13 inches long.

A Versatile Massage Tool With A Double-Sided Design

Gaiam Finger Massager

Amazon -

Show your hands some TLC with this finger massage tool. Its double-sided design soothes sore muscles, relieving stiffness while improving circulation. Side A has two rollers to fully massage each finger, while Side B has one roller to target specific points. It also comes with a guide and a how-to video for some extra help. As one five-star reviewer stated, “I don’t know how I survived without this.”

A Lip Oil With A Subtle Tint & Visible Plumping Effect

NOONI Korean Lip Oil

Amazon -

This Korean lip oil puts a perfect finishing touch on any look. It’s packed with hydrating ingredients, including appleseed oil and raspberry extract, and its subtle tint provides the slightest hint of color. It also visibly plumps your lips, making them appear fuller than before. Over 12,000 reviewers gave it a five-star rating.

A Low-Priced Acupuncture Pen With A Quality Feel

tophld Acupuncture Pen

Amazon -

An easy and comfortable way to release muscle tension, this acupuncture pen is made of easy-to-clean stainless steel and comes with a drawstring pouch to protect it during storage. Both ends feature a different gauge head to work on muscles of different sizes all over the body, and it comes with a helpful booklet detailing different acupuncture spots to try.

Heart-Shaped Magnets That Hold Well

Janvelle Heart Magnets (12-Pack)

Amazon -

These little heart-shaped magnets add the sweetest touch to your fridge. But they aren’t purely decorative: The 12 magnets on the back securely hold photos, your shopping list, notes, and more, keeping everything handy.

A Mini Cat Trinket Set To Make You Workday More Joyful

iland Mini Cat Figurines (6 Pieces)

Amazon -

Make your workday a little more enjoyable by placing these cat trinkets on your desk. Included are four of the cutest hand-painted cats in various poses, plus a wooden tree (which you can paint if you want) and two carpets for them to hang out on.

A 4-In-1 Beaded Charging Cable That’s Pretty & Practical

Atsidexa 4-In-1 Beaded Charging Cable

Amazon -

This beaded charging cable is prettier to look at, but also more practical. It’s far less likely to end up in a tangled mess, and the four-in-one charger cord design means it’s compatible with most phones, tablets, and other electronics.

A Beaded Bracelet With A Cat Pendant That Symbolizes Good Luck

Generic Cat Bracelet

Amazon -

This lovely bracelet is crafted with calming blue crystal beads, plus there’s a ceramic cat pendant that symbolizes good luck and prosperity — it truly brings positive vibes to your day. The bracelet features a stretchy cord band for easy on and off.

A Slim Toaster With A Colorful Modern Design

bella Slim Toaster

amazon -

With its slim body and pretty colors, this toaster takes up little space while making a big impression. A 10-inch slot fits two slices side by side, including thicker breads like bagels and Texas toast. Six shade settings and a cancel button let you choose how dark you want your toast, and the removable tray and cord wrap keep the counter tidy between uses.

An At-Home Towel Warmer For A Spa-Like Feel

TASALON Hot Towel Steamer

Amazon -

Create an at-home spa moment with this towel warmer. Simply fill it with rolled-up towels, pour water into the tank, and flip it on ... you’ll have hot towels ready for your enjoyment in as few as five minutes. It shuts off on its own so you don’t have to remember that step.

Mini Porcelain Dishes That Are So Versatile

AVLA Porcelain Cocotte Bowls (4-Pack)

Amazon -

These miniature dishes are covered in the cutest polka-dot designs. And you’ll actually find yourself reaching for them often — they’re ideal for soups, appetizers, desserts, and more. Each one (four are included in the set) holds nine ounces. And the porcelain material is microwave-, oven-, freezer-, and dishwasher-friendly.

A 3D Heart That Makes Your Car’s Start Button Easier To Press

enttgo Car Start Button

Amazon -

Upgrade your car’s push-to-start button with this adorable heart. It secures in place using double-sided adhesive tape, and the 3D heart design looks adorable and makes the button easier to push. For less than $10, it’s an instant yes.

A Hand-Crafted Cat Planter For A Shockingly Low Price

Hewory Cat Planter

Amazon -

The perfect size for plant propagation or small flowers, this crystal-clear vase is paired with a sweet stained-glass cat (who is casually pawing at the greenery), all on a wooden base. This pick is handcrafted, so it’s shocking that it costs less than $30.

A Satin Pillowcase That Makes Your Bed & Hair Look Polished

Kitsch Satin Pillowcase with Zipper for Hair & Skin - Softer Than Silk Pillow Cases, Smooth Cooling Satin Pillow Case, Wrinkle-Free, Machine Washable - Pillow Cases Standard Size (19x26) - Haze Blue

Amazon -

A satin pillowcase is the low-effort beauty upgrade that pays off every single morning. The smooth surface glides under your hair instead of tugging it, so you get less frizz and fewer tangles. It's also gentler on skin than cotton. The sheen adds instant polish to any bed, and the zipper closure keeps your pillow from slipping out.

A Genius Flat Book Light That Goes Behind The Pages

ZWJFDCBD Book Light

Amazon -

This book light is different from most — it boasts a flat design to fit in front of the pages, illuminating them for far easier reading. It can be set to three color temperatures (white, warm, or neutral), and the built-in battery will last up to 35 hours per charge.

A Mini Steel Drum To Create Custom Soothing Sounds

EASTROCK Mini Steel Tongue Drum

Amazon -

Create your own custom music by tapping this miniature steel drum with the included mallet. It has a standard C key and eight notes, and the sound it puts out is clear, moderate in volume, and honestly just so soothing.

Flexible Silicone Claw Clips That Are Way Comfier

Glaudmeiss Flexible Claw Clips (4-Pack)

Amazon -

These aren’t your average claw clips: They’re made from soft, flexible silicone that holds securely — yet is so much comfier, especially when leaning back against your car’s seat. The set comes with four clips in neutral hues, though plenty of other sets are available in the listing.

A Travel-Friendly Umbrella With A Wooden Duck Handle

LEAGERA Duck Umbrella

Amazon -

This compact umbrella is perfect for travel, since it folds down super small. However, when it’s raining, you’ll be thankful for its 37-inch diameter when opened. The umbrella is windproof and UV protective, with a wooden handle shaped like a duck's head.

A Luxurious Body Oil That Gives Skin A Soft, Scented Glow

Saltair Salt Water Vanilla Body Oil

Amazon -

Whether you prefer Island Orchid, Salt Water Vanilla, or any other of its 10 scents, Saltair's nourishing body oil has fans swooning. Each is formulated with Kukui, Moringa, and Squalane oils to help skin feel soft and hydrated, and is then scented with a unique blend of notes. It works for all skin types and melts into your skin quickly, leaving no greasy finish.

A Hooded Scarf That Protects Your Hair On Cold, Windy Days

Putian Hooded Scarf

Amazon -

Winter hats immediately ruin a good hair day, which is where this knit hooded scarf comes in. The slouchy hood leaves plenty of room for buns, ponytails, and curls, and the attached scarf wraps around the neck or ties into a loose knot for a chic way to protect against the wind. “Definitely recommend this if you want to stay warm and look stylish,” one shopper wrote.

Ceremonial-Grade Matcha That Makes Daily Green Tea Feel Regal

Naoki Matcha Superior Blend Matcha

Amazon -

Matcha fans will love this ceremonial grade powder. It’s made from shade-grown leaves in Japan and has an earthy, smooth flavor that Amazon fans enjoy. Its vibrant green color also makes it a great choice for dessert recipes. A 1.4-ounce tin has 20 servings, so it’ll save you a ton of money compared to store-bought teas and lattes.

An Electric Blanket That Keeps You Warm & Cozy All Winter

Templewet Heated Electric Blanket

Amazon -

Wrap yourself in softness and warmth with this electric blanket. The sherpa material is plush and fluffy on its own, but you can take it to the next level by plugging it in and choosing from six heat settings. An auto timer and overheating protection add safety, and it’s available in a variety of colors to match your space.

An Amazon Echo Lamp With A Built-In Timer That Changes Color

Amazon Echo Glow

Amazon -

Check tasks off your to-do list with this Amazon Echo lamp. You can pair it with any compatible Alexa device, then control it with your voice from a distance. Its built-in timer changes color, visually alerting you when your food or laundry is finished. It adds mood lighting to any space, whether you're throwing a party or just chilling at home.

An Initial Necklace That Seems Way More Expensive Than It Is

PAVOI Initial Pendant Necklace

Amazon -

Jewelry that feels personalized is always an amazing gift. This pendant necklace features the initial of your choice and comes plated in 14-karat gold, which is hypoallergenic and sensitive skin friendly. The 18-inch chain comes with an extender if you choose to wear it longer, and you can choose from three colors to personalize it further: rose gold, white gold or yellow gold.

Foot Masks That Provide Relief To Tired, Achy Feet

Dr. Scholl's Soothing & Reviving Foot Mask (3 Pairs)

Amazon -

Like supercharged sheet masks for your feet, these foil-like booties provide soothing, warming relief to feet that are tired, achy, and sore. Formulated with shea butter, peppermint, and lavender to leave feet

A Slim, Tiny Wallet That Comes In Tons Of Cute Designs

Thread Wallets Ultra Slim Leather Card Holder (Polka Dot)

Amazon -

This super-slim wallet is thin enough to fit nicely into the pocket of your jeans, but spacious enough to hold up to eight cards and some cash, as well. Great for travel or work because you can wear it around your neck with a lanyard, the wallet comes in 27 different designs, from polka dots and checkerboard to floral and even a Diet Coke-themed option.

A Cedarwood-Scented Candle That Turns Into A Planter

Modern Sprout 2-in-1 Candle Set (3 Pieces)

Amazon -

This cedarwood-scented soy candle pairs notes of lavender, orange blossom, and vanilla with a chic ceramic vessel that doubles as a little planter. Once the wax is gone, add soil and the included lavender seeds to turn your spent candle into a tiny indoor garden.

A Makeup Bag With A Varsity-Style Initial

BAGSMART Initial Makeup Bag

Amazon -

Everyone loves a makeup bag — after all, you can never have too many — especially when it comes emblazoned with your initial. It’s surprisingly spacious inside, with three pockets, and comes in a variety of cute colors and patterns, all featuring a stylish padded texture.

6 Pairs Of Cute & Fuzzy Socks

TEHOOK Fuzzy Socks (6 Pairs)

Amazon -

One can never have too many fuzzy socks, which is why they’re eternally the GOAT of small-but-practical gifts. This order comes with six pairs of super-cozy socks, all made of warm, plush fleece — and the colors and designs you can choose from are practically endless.

A Mini Spoon Set In An Elegant Swan-Shaped Holder

SGvrPvz Gold Swan Base With Coffee Spoons (12-Piece Set)

Amazon -

Your coffee station is about to get a major upgrade. This adorable spoon set features 12 mini spoons made of stainless steel topped with delicate floral details, all displayed in an elegant swan shaped holder. Perfect for stirring up espresso or serving up dessert, it’s a functional find that’s almost too pretty to put away.

A Set Of 12 Claw Clips In A Chic Matte Texture

Janfun Large Hair Claw Clips (12-Pack)

Amazon -

Take your updo to the next level with these stylish matte claw clips that come in assorted designs. This set features a mix of neutral, go-with-everything colors, but they also come in a variety of pastels. They’re heavy-duty enough for thick, curly hair, thanks to their larger-than-average size.

Festive Press-On Nails In A Trendy Cat Eye Design

Glamnetic Christmas Cat Eye Press On Nails

Amazon -

Cat eye nails are having a major moment, and this festive press-on set is a fun way to get in on the trend. Each set contains 30 nails in a variety of sizes, as well as everything you need for easy application. The result looks like a salon-quality manicure, and plenty of Amazon reviewers say they can last up to three weeks.

A Best-Selling Shower Set That Smells Like A Tropical Holiday

SOL DE JANEIRO Jet Set Shower Kit

Amazon -

This popular shower kit covers a full routine in three steps. Start with the Brazilian 4 Play body wash, then follow with the iconic Bum Bum Cream, which uses caffeine-rich guarana to visibly firm and tighten skin. A spritz of Cheirosa 62 perfume mist finishes things off with the brand's signature scent. It’s TSA-friendly and perfect for travel.

item.title: Score Up To 70% Off Sizzling Intimates & Cozy Loungewear From Savage X Fenty
item.description: The cult-favorite brand has deals starting at just $6 during its holiday sale.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Kraese
item.content:encoded:
With the temperature plunging (and, depending where you are, climbing then plunging, again), the temptation to hole up indoors until spring is stronger than ever right now. But, honestly, what better time for Savage X Fenty to bless us with its holiday sale, where New Rewards Members have a chance to score up to 70% off on some of the most sizzling hot offerings from the iconic brand (in addition to unlocking access to other year-round exclusive perks).

Savage X Fenty Holiday Sale

Ahead, you’ll find some of our current favorite pieces from the sale, ranging from lacy balconette bras that leave just enough to the imagination to buttery soft briefs in festive prints and cozy two-piece PJ sets that’ll have you wanting to spend the day in bed (alone or with company). And of course, true to the brand’s vision, everything is designed and sized for all different bodies, which is probably the sexiest part of all.

Shop The Pieces We’re Loving Right Now

Romantic Corded Lace Unlined Balconette Bra

Shimmer Bloom Lace Unlined Balconette Bra

Savage X Cotton Boxer Briefs

Petal Soft Pajama Set (2 Pieces)

Forever Savage Hooded Onesie

item.title: The Best Early Friday Deals On Amazon 2026
item.description: Shop the best Black Friday Amazon deals on beauty, home, fashion, tech, and cozy essentials before holiday savings disappear.
item.dc:creator: BDG Commerce
item.content:encoded:
Black Friday is here, and Amazon has yet again outdone itself with seriously good deals you won't want to miss. From beauty staples to popular home upgrades and everything in between, there are tons of ways to save big. We've rounded up the best Black Friday deals worth adding to your cart.

63% Off A Best-Selling Long Sleeve Tee You’ll Want Multiples Of

Trendy Queen Long-Sleeve T-Shirt

-

Amazon -

Stocking up on wardrobe basics is a smart way to navigate big sale days, and this long-sleeve T-shirt is the perfect add-to-cart. Its soft, slightly stretchy, and makes for a great layer when the temperatures drop. You may just want to pick up a few while it's at this price.

53% Off A Trendy Bubble Blanket That’s Beyond Soft & Snuggly

Bedsure Cloud Bubble Blanket

-

Amazon -

Bubble blankets are as eye-catching as they are cozy, but it's rare to find them at this good a price. This soft, textured throw will serve as a statement piece in your living room or bedroom. Curl up with it on a chilly night with a candle lit and a favorite movie — the vibes are immaculate.

60% Off A Ring Battery Doorbell With Enhanced Zoom

Ring Battery Doorbell 2K

amazon -

Ring's rechargeable battery doorbell gives you a wide-angle 2K view of what's happening around your front door. Enhanced zoom lets you take a closer look, while Two-Way Talk makes it possible to speak with visitors from your device. Its built-in rechargeable battery also makes it an option for homes where hardwiring a video doorbell isn't convenient.

47% Off A Super Thin Bath Mat That Is Absorbent & Quick-Drying

Bosap Ultra Thin Bath Mat

-

Amazon -

This ultra-thin bath mat is designed to slip under doors without any bunching. It's incredibly absorbent, quick-drying, and backed with 100% natural rubber to provide a solid nonslip grip to your floor. It's also machine-washable, and available in a ton of sizes and colors for a customized fit.

20% Off Beauty Pie’s Under-Eye Corrector That Neutralizes Redness

Beauty Pie Superluminous Under-Eye Corrector

Amazon -

This green tinted cream uses color theory to neutralize unwanted reddish tones, whether you apply it under your eyes, on your nose, or on top of an inflamed blemish. The color corrector can be used both on its own or underneath foundation or concealer, and it's enriched with ingredients that are beneficial for dry and sensitive skin, such as soothing bisabolol and antioxidant-rich vitamin C.

52% Off A Classic Hanes Hoodie

Hanes EcoSmart Hoodie

Amazon -

A classic Hanes hoodie is the kind of basic that's useful for lounging, running errands, traveling, and just about everything in between. This one is made from midweight fleece with ribbed cuffs and a waistband, a drawstring hood, and a roomy kangaroo pocket. The fabric is designed to resist pilling, and more than 170,000 reviewers have weighed in on it.

34% Off A 3-Pack Of Extra-Long iPhone Charging Cables

Bkayp iPhone Charger 10-foot (3-Pack)
