The title is certainly deserved: While facing off against the Spirit in October, Bethune broke the NWSL’s single-season record for assists with 11. This came just two years after she tied the previous record of 10 assists, set by Portland Thorns legend Tobin Heath in 2016, during her rookie season.

“Breaking the assist record was an individual goal that I had set for myself this year,” Bethune tells Bustle on Nov. 19. “So to do it, especially in an important game, it felt really good.”

That match was, in fact, integral to the Current’s success. The team beat the Spirit 2-1 to earn a spot in the playoffs. It was Bethune’s third time making the postseason, but only her second stepping onto the field. In 2024, she tore her meniscus while throwing out the ceremonial first pitch at a Nationals game, which ultimately was a season-ending injury.

“It was not my first go-around with a major injury, but it was my first in the professional league,” says Bethune, who suffered three ACL tears while playing in high school and college. “The way that the meniscus injury happened, it just kind of taught me to say no. It’s an important lesson.”

That new outlook has clearly paid off, as Bethune held the NWSL’s sparkling, Tiffany & Co.-made trophy in Washington, D.C., on the very field where she began her professional career. Before the game, Bethune reflected on competing against her former team.

“I love the city of D.C. It’s a lot of fun,” the Georgia native says. “But I’m just excited to be in the final with Kansas City, and it’ll be a really good game.”

For the Current, it certainly was.

Ahead of the NWSL championship game, Bustle caught up with the midfielder to talk about her go-to playlist and why recovery is so important.

What’s your morning routine like?

I'm a dog mom first, so I get up and take care of my dog and then get some coffee, head to the facility, eat breakfast, and train.

What’s your coffee order?

A cinnamon brown sugar latte or caramel latte, but always iced — iced only.

How do you unwind after a hectic day?

I’m a chill gal. I like to hang out with my dog or hang out with the girlies, spend time outside, and I listen to a lot of music.

What’s the best wellness advice you’ve ever received?

Pay attention to the little details when it comes to recovery. I put a heavy emphasis on the thought that just because you’re feeling good doesn’t mean that you shouldn’t get treatment.

What’s on your go-to playlist?

Some Future, a lot of rap typically, but if I’m in a calmer mood, it’s R&B.

This interview has been edited and condensed for clarity.

item.title: A New 'Home Alone' Sequel With Macaulay Culkin Is In The Works
item.description: Macaulay Culkin has confirmed reports that a new 'Home Alone' movie is officially in the works. Here's everything to know about the highly anticipated sequel so far.
item.dc:creator: Grace Wehniainen
item.content:encoded:
Thirty-six years after a precocious Kevin McCallister was first left Home Alone — and 34 since his luxury sojourn in New York City — Macaulay Culkin seems to be plotting a welcome return to the beloved Christmas films.

On Nov. 20, Puck reported that a new Home Alone movie is in development at Disney, and that Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg are set to work on a script with Culkin. In fact, Deadline notes that the actor pitched his own idea to executive David Greenbaum, who helms Disney Live Action and 20th Century Studios, this summer. While further specifics and casting have not been announced, the outlet reports that Culkin would indeed return to star.

While Culkin starred in the first two films, he wasn't involved in the Home Alone sequels that followed — so the upcoming project could be a true continuation of Kevin’s story that viewers know and love (and rewatch every year). Culkin himself confirmed this on Instagram, sharing Variety’s report on the new film and writing: “It’s true…”

Culkin has previously teased his interest in a theoretical sequel, telling The Hollywood Reporter last year that he envisioned an older Kevin, perhaps “a widower or something like that,” struggling to relate to his son.

In one version of his hypothetical follow-up, he accidentally forgets his child like his own parents did... twice. But in another twistier take, he suggested: “I leave him behind on purpose, like, ‘Oh, that made me the man I am today.’”

In this version, Kevin’s child sets traps to keep his own dad out. “And I think I see them coming because, you know, I’m the expert. It also explains why I don’t call the police or locksmith because I’m embarrassed my kid is beating me and this is my gig.” The house, he said, could be “a metaphor for getting back into the kid’s heart.”

Shortly after the sequel was reported, Chris Columbus told Variety that the loss of Catherine O’Hara — who played Kevin’s mom, Kate — made it difficult to think about the franchise’s future. “Catherine, as I’ve always said, is 50% of Home Alone,” he said. “There’s the yin and yang of Home Alone: Catherine O’Hara and Macaulay Culkin. Without those two in the film, there is no film, because they create the emotional epicenter of that film.”

item.title: The Best Sulfate-Free Shampoos Of 2026, By Hair Type
item.description: Your guide to the best sulfate-free shampoos of 2026, by hair type — with color-safe formulas for dry curls, damaged ends, fine hair, and more.
item.dc:creator: Deanna Pai
item.content:encoded:
It’s not exactly hard to find a sulfate-free shampoo these days. Finding one that actually works for your hair? That's another story. Between formulas for color-treated strands, sensitive scalps, fine hair, and everything in between, the options can get overwhelming quickly. But there is a sulfate-free shampoo for just about every hair concern — you just have to know what to look for.

What Sulfate-Free Actually Changes

Sulfates are surfactants, meaning they help shampoo create a lather and wash away grime, oil, and product buildup from your hair and scalp. Sulfates aren't inherently bad, but they can be drying or irritating for some people, particularly those with sensitive scalps. They're also commonly avoided in color-care routines because of concerns about fading, although research hasn't consistently shown that sulfates alone cause more color loss. Ultimately, the overall shampoo formulation matters more than whether it carries a sulfate-free label.

How To Match A Sulfate-Free Shampoo To Your Hair & Scalp

  1. Color protection: If your hair is color-treated, look for a color-safe formula designed to help maintain your shade between salon appointments.
  2. Fragrance: If you’re prone to irritation, look for a fragrance-free shampoo. Fragrance is a common contact allergen, and sulfate-free formulas can still contain it.
  3. Wash frequency: If you wash your hair frequently, look for a formula that cleanses without leaving your strands feeling dry. Less frequent washers may benefit from an occasional clarifying shampoo to remove accumulated oil and product buildup.
  4. Scalp compatibility: If your scalp is oily, dry, or reactive, look for a formula that addresses those needs. Oily scalps may benefit from more thorough cleansing, while dry scalps tend to prefer moisturizing formulas.
  5. Budget: You don't have to spend a fortune to get a good sulfate-free shampoo. There are effective drugstore options, but if you're willing to spend up to $40, you can find salon-grade formulas with additional color-protecting benefits.

The 8 Best Sulfate-Free Shampoos, By Hair Type & Scalp Need

1. The Best Sulfate-Free Shampoo For Fine, Color-Treated Hair With A Sensitive Scalp: Pureology Hydrate Sheer Shampoo

Hydrate Sheer Shampoo

Pureology -

Pureology has plenty of options if you're looking for a sulfate-free shampoo for color-treated hair. Its shampoos use the brand's proprietary ZeroSulfate technology to cleanse without traditional sulfates, along with its AntiFade Complex to help maintain color vibrancy. The Hydrate Sheer Shampoo is a particularly good fit for fine hair: It's a lightweight, silicone-free formula that delivers moisture without weighing down strands. Plus, the 9-ounce bottle costs $39. Pureology's entire shampoo range is formulated for color-treated hair and is vegan.

2. A Dermatologist-Developed, Fragrance-Free Formula For Allergy-Prone Or Eczema-Prone Scalps: Seen Shampoo

Seen Shampoo, Fragrance-Free

Seen -

If you can't try a new hair product without experiencing scalp itchiness or discomfort, stick with a fragrance-free formula. Dermatologist Dr. Iris Rubin created Seen to address the connection between hair care and skin health. Its Fragrance-Free Shampoo skips sulfates, dyes, silicones, and parabens, too, making it a thoughtful choice for people who are sensitive to multiple common hair-care ingredients.

3. A Gentle, Paraben- & Dye-Free Pick Suited To Postpartum Shedding & Thinning Hair: Nécessaire The Shampoo

Nécessaire The Shampoo

Amazon -

Postpartum shedding can be a frustrating part of the hair-growth cycle, so it's understandable to want to be extra gentle with your strands. Nécessaire’s fragrance-free shampoo pairs plant-based surfactants with hyaluronic acid, aloe vera, and panthenol to cleanse while helping keep the scalp hydrated. It's also made without SLS/SLES, silicones, parabens, or phthalates. While no shampoo can prevent postpartum shedding, this is a gentle-feeling option for anyone whose scalp is feeling especially dry or sensitive.

4. A Reparative, Protein-Based Formula For Recovering A Damaged Or Overly Dry Scalp: Virtue Recovery Shampoo

Virtue Recovery Shampoo

Sephora -

Maybe your hair isn't just color-treated: You also regularly style it with hot tools or go to the salon for chemical treatments (or both). If that's the case, it may need some extra TLC. Virtue's Recovery Shampoo uses the brand's Alpha Keratin 60ku protein, which is designed to help replenish damaged areas of the hair and improve its overall feel. The sulfate-free formula also contains hydrolyzed quinoa to help strengthen and condition strands.

5. A Lightweight, Color-Protecting Formula Built For Daily Washers: Redken Color Extend Magnetics Shampoo

Redken Color Extend Magnetics Shampoo

Amazon -

If you wash your hair every day, a color-safe formula that cleanses without leaving strands feeling stripped is key. Redken's Color Extend Magnetics Shampoo is sulfate-free and formulated with an acidic pH to help smooth the hair cuticle and maintain shine. It's designed to help defend hair against color fading (from both washing and sun exposure) and is still gentle enough for daily use.

6. An Affordable, Mass-Retailer Formula For Budget-Conscious Shoppers: Herbal Essences Color + Protect Grapeseed Sulfate-Free Shampoo

Herbal Essences Color + Protect Grapeseed Sulfate-Free Shampoo

Walmart -

Know that you don't have to shell out for a good sulfate-free formula. The Herbal Essences Color + Protect Grapeseed Shampoo is designed to help keep color-treated hair vibrant, with grapeseed, aloe, and camellia to help moisturize strands. It's also free of parabens, dyes, and phthalates, and retails for around $10 — a wallet-friendly way to make the switch.

7. A High-Foaming Clarifying Formula For Oily Scalps Or Product Buildup That Still Skips Sulfates: K18 Peptide Prep Detox Shampoo

K18 Peptide Prep Detox Shampoo

Amazon -

If there's one drawback with sulfate-free shampoos, it's that they can be more milky than foamy — so you miss out on suds. This color-safe, sulfate-free clarifying shampoo by K18 uses activated charcoal and salicylic acid to help remove excess oil and product buildup — without sacrificing a nice lather.

8. A Conditioner-Cleanser Hybrid Suited To Curly Or Textured Hair That Washes Less Often: Curlsmith Curl Quenching Conditioning Wash

Curlsmith Curl Quenching Conditioning Wash

Amazon -

A co-wash pairs the moisturizing power of conditioner with the cleansing abilities of shampoo — making it ideal if you have curls and coils, dry hair, or coarse texture. Curlsmith's version is infused with avocado and coconut oils to help moisturize and detangle strands without stripping away as much of their natural oil.

Sulfate-Free Shampoo Vs. Co-Wash For Color-Treated Hair

  • Sulfate-free shampoo: If you're dealing with sweat, product buildup, or oily roots, a lathering sulfate-free formula can give you a more thorough cleanse while avoiding traditional sulfates.
  • Co-wash for color-treated hair: If your hair and scalp are dry or your curls need extra moisture, a co-wash can help cleanse gently while preserving more of your natural oils. The tradeoff is that it may not remove excess oil and buildup as effectively as shampoo.

You don't necessarily have to choose one or the other. Alternating between a co-wash and a sulfate-free shampoo can help you balance moisture with a more thorough cleanse, particularly if you have dry, textured hair but still deal with product buildup.

Sulfate-Free Vs. Traditional Shampoo For Sensitive Scalps

  • Traditional shampoo: Formulas containing sulfates aren't inherently irritating, but some people find certain cleansing agents too drying. Fragrance and preservatives can also trigger reactions, regardless of whether a shampoo contains sulfates.
  • Sulfate-free shampoo: Skipping sulfates can be a good starting point if you find traditional shampoos drying or irritating.

If you don’t notice any improvements or your scalp gets even more uncomfortable (think tight or itchy), make an appointment with a dermatologist.

FAQ

What’s the best sulfate-free shampoo for sensitive scalps with color-treated hair?

The best pick is a shampoo that pairs a sulfate-free formulation with color protection. Pureology’s shampoos combine the brand's proprietary ZeroSulfate technology with its AntiFade Complex, which is designed to help maintain color vibrancy while gently cleansing. The Hydrate Sheer formula is particularly suited to fine hair that needs lightweight moisture.

Should I use a sulfate-free shampoo or a co-wash for color-treated hair?

You can use both. A sulfate-free shampoo gets you a more thorough cleanse, while a co-wash can help preserve hydration and hair color. Alternating between the two on wash days can help you balance effective cleansing with hydration.

Should I use sulfate-free or traditional shampoo if I have a sensitive scalp?

A sulfate-free shampoo is helpful, but it’s not the whole story. Fragrance and other ingredients can cause irritation in both sulfate-free and traditional shampoos. If you have a diagnosed scalp condition or ongoing symptoms, consult a dermatologist.

What sulfate-free shampoo do hairstylists recommend most for keeping color from fading?

Hairstylists reach for sulfate-free shampoos that have built-in color protection. Pureology is a salon-grade option specifically formulated for color-treated hair. Every shampoo in its lineup features the brand's AntiFade Complex, which is designed to help protect color vibrancy, alongside its ZeroSulfate technology.

What’s the best fragrance-free, sulfate-free shampoo for allergies or skin sensitivities?

Seen’s Fragrance-Free Shampoo is a good choice to consider. Developed by dermatologist Dr. Iris Rubin, it's formulated without fragrance, sulfates, silicones, dyes, or parabens.

Can I find a sulfate-free shampoo under $40 that still lathers well?

Absolutely. Pureology's Hydrate Sheer Shampoo costs $39 for a 9-ounce bottle and delivers a salon-grade, sulfate-free formula with color-protecting benefits and a satisfying lather. If you're shopping on a tighter budget, Herbal Essences' Color + Protect Grapeseed Shampoo is another option at around $10.

item.title: Black Friday Girl Math: The 13 Rules For Justifying Every Cart
item.description: Spending $40 to get free shipping? That's profit. Here are the 13 unofficial rules of Black Friday girl math we're using to justify our holiday shopping carts.
item.dc:creator: Morgan Sullivan
item.content:encoded:
To quote the enduring Queen of Pop, Ms. Britney Spears, there are only two types of people in the world. And, in case you were wondering, that great divide? It’s between those who stick to their shopping lists and those who convince themselves they've actually saved money by spending $200 they never planned on.

Most of us are the latter. Thankfully, the very serious™ economic theory of girl math, which essentially constitutes creative and illogical justifications for spending money, has been popularized long enough that we are heading into another holiday season with its teachings. And with Black Friday and Cyber Monday approaching, when you meet the gaze of a beautiful $400 wool coat that used to cost $850, you might need some internal mental gymnastics to justify the purchase during a holiday meant for buying things for… literally anyone else.

Don’t worry, your secrets (and your credit card statement) are safe here. Below, you’ll find some justifications to keep in your back pocket, whether you’re convincing yourself or someone else watching you add to cart.

1. Paying $10 for shipping is a waste of money — but spending an extra $40 on a random top you didn't even want to get free shipping? Congrats, you just saved $10.

Bonus points if you don't even have to sign in to your account to qualify for free shipping. The faster it gets to your doorstep, the faster you can justify the purchase before the “underconsumption core” side of TikTok tries to lecture you about impulse buys. And that semi-sheer long-sleeve you just ordered from REVOLVE has a much longer shelf life than, say, the $8 influencer matcha that cultural commentators swear you’re spending your hard-earned money on, anyway.

2. If you were going to buy it at full price anyway, the discount is basically income.

You’ve saved it to your LTK to practice restraint — and now you see it has a significantly lower price tag. Now is the time to strike, considering it was about to be added to cart at a much higher price. (And now you have more money to spend on more important things, like other gifts for yourself.)

3. Buy two during the sales because your sister, best friend, or roommate is going to steal it anyway.

It's accounting for anticipated theft. But it’s also accounting for the money you save on Tylenol, because you’re avoiding so many headaches down the line. While not a monetary rebate, it’s a life rebate: You’ll never have to shout, “ARE YOU WEARING MY SWEATER?” again. Or at least for the rest of the holidays.

Plus, you’ll be a really good sister. Merry Christmas to you, and Merry Christmas to her. Everybody wins, etc., etc.

4. If it’s for a dog or a baby, that doesn’t count as spending.

Finally, we’re getting to the gift-giving portion here. Because Cyber Week is so devilishly good (we’re talking 40% to 80% off!!), we often forget it’s supposed to be for others, not just ourselves. And when you come across teeny-tiny Adidas Sambas and embroidered dog scarves alike, you realize those are such small purchases — in every sense of the word.

5. And on that note, you’re reminded you don’t have a baby.

So you can shop more for yourself without feeling guilty. You’ve earned this Black Friday treat because you don’t have to spend money on a whole other human. Major Samantha Jones "I don't have a baby" party vibes here.

6. If it's from your Gen Z cousin's ShopMy, it's already been vetted.

So, yeah. It might be a fancy serum with a higher price tag than your typical Amazon purchases and drugstore skin care staples, but again, she knows. And her face — with those angelic, collagen-filled cheeks — would never lie. Nor does it look like she’s using something economical.

7. It’s practical (but elevated), which means it’s a cost you would’ve accounted for anyway.

You’ll need deodorant (fancy, viral sticks in minimalist packaging) and laundry detergent (in a swanky perfume scent). You lost your hoop earrings, so you’ll need a new pair — they might as well be nickel-free silver. And if it’s going to be a PJ set, why not make it the kind with custom embroidery of your last name?

8. Returns equal a profit match.

Returning a $50 item gives you a $50 credit. Because that money is already "gone" from your bank account, spending that credit on a new Cyber Monday deal means the new item is completely free. And guess what? No one here ever claimed to be a finance expert. (Or an expert at anything at all, really.)

9. Spending now means more wiggle room in December.

Shopping the sales now means you've preserved your future budget, so you have even more money to spend later. Follow along for your own holiday excitement… because the sound of the UPS truck rolling up to your house during the holidays hits almost as hard as a customary listen of *NSYNC’s “Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays.”

10. Buying a discounted red lip is just following the Lipstick Index.

When times get tough, who doesn’t turn to little luxuries? And if that little luxury happens to be 30% off on Black Friday, well, that's just typical economic behavior. (Besides, you might just need a red lip for the holidays, so it’s more like seasonal planning than it is frivolous spending.)

11. It’s honoring tradition to add to cart.

Your ancestors used to hunt and gather. Your sister used to have to drive to the mall and force conversation with people from her high school — the horrors. Now, you can add anything to cart from the luxury of your own home. (The cost of gas, time, and social exhaustion = gone.) Which means more money in your pocket, essentially.

12. Spending $50+ on a White Elephant gift is justified if it causes drama.

If you have the best gift, you hold all of the power of the night. If this were a game of The Traitors, you would win. And that’s the second-best feeling to actually winning the gift itself.

13. Anything after Thanksgiving is a Christmas expense.

Once the turkey leftovers are in the fridge, regular budgeting rules no longer apply. Because you literally cannot put a price on magic. Or a luxury face oil.

item.title: A Tarot Reading About Money: Week Of November 23 - 29, 2026
item.description: Tarot reader Nina Kahn offers insights about money and work for the week of Nov. 23 – Nov. 29, 2026.
item.dc:creator: Nina Kahn
item.content:encoded:
The hustle and bustle of the holiday season is officially underway this week, and you may already be preparing your wallet for the Black Friday sales that’ll continue rolling out through the days ahead. The buzzy and frenetic vibes are being intensified by a full moon in clever and quizzical Gemini that rises on Tuesday. This lunation has a major unpredictability factor, so watch out for sudden curveballs that throw a wrench in your workflow or prompt an unexpected last-minute purchase.

This week’s money tarot reading reveals some financial anxieties lurking beneath the surface, but also offers lots of grounding advice that’ll help you take control of your material resources and build success in your career. If you’d like advice on how to handle professional and financial matters this week, read on to see the cards I pulled to offer some collective guidance.

Card 1: What do you need to know about your finances this week?

Do you know where this week’s full Beaver Moon gets its name? It’s a traditional moniker that refers to the beavers in North America seeking shelter and preparing for winter during this time of year. Similarly, the Four of Pentacles wants you to be more aware of your resources and guard what you’ve got a little more thoughtfully right now, too. This card depicts someone with four large golden coins in his possession. He holds one tightly in his arms, keeps one secured under each foot, and balances another atop his head, symbolizing his desire to lock down what he’s got.

While this card can sometimes indicate being greedy or miserly, it usually arrives as a reminder to simply spend more wisely and be a bit more frugal. It’s a holiday week — one that includes Black Friday, no less — so there may be purchases that are hard to avoid. However, do your best not to go overboard and do your shopping conscientiously. If you can lock in and focus on saving money while understanding the value of your dollar, you’ll set yourself up for financial success throughout the season to come.

Card 2: How can you feel less anxious about money?

With the Nine of Swords present, it’s safe to assume that fears about your finances are weighing on you heavily this week. This is the quintessential card of anxiety and stress, which seems obvious when you notice the imagery of a person sitting awake in their bed, holding their head in their hands with worry. Swords often represent thoughts in the tarot, and the large stack of swords behind this character show that he’s currently being plagued by a few too many — so much so that they’re keeping him up at night.

However, the most important message baked into this card is that these negative and worrisome thoughts are exactly that: thoughts. Not facts, not premonitions, not real pieces of information — simply thoughts that are being created through fear and anxiety. Just because your mind is fixating on worst case scenarios doesn’t mean that’s how your situations will actually play out. Stress is real, but making yourself sick with worry won’t change the outcome. It’ll only fray your nerves and make you miserable. If you catch yourself in a mental flurry of worry, stop yourself before you start spiraling. No need to crash out or lose sleep.

Card 3: What will impact your career this week?

Cheers to a positive week on the professional front! With Thanksgiving coming up on Thursday, some people are enjoying a shorter work week — but that doesn’t mean you won’t accomplish anything important or continue making strides toward your current career goals. This card depicts two people holding large golden cups up to one another, symbolizing the synergy and collaborative vibe that comes when people put their cards on the table and are open with one another.

This week, focus on being more receptive to working with others. This might mean taking advice from a peer in your field, pulling someone else on board to help you with a project, or reaching out to a contact who might be able to help open a door toward a greater ambition in the future. Business partnerships are thriving now too, and some new ones may even be in development. Soften up to the idea of collaborating and sharing ideas, and watch as some magic unfolds.

Nina Kahn is Bustle’s resident astrologer and tarot reader.

For more, check out your horoscope.

item.title: A Tarot Reading For The Week Of November 23 - 29, 2026
item.description: A one-card daily reading for the week of November 23 – 29. The message? Your healing journey is just beginning.
item.dc:creator: Nina Kahn
item.content:encoded:
2026 has been a challenging year for many people — and astrologically speaking, the past month alone has been a very rocky road. Venus retrograde turned relationships inside out and had everyone reevaluating what’s meaningful to them, while Mercury retrograde threw a wrench in schedules and projects, turning everything into an obstacle course. Everyone’s fighting their own unique battle, whether you can see it from the outside or not. But this week, you may finally hit a turning point that allows you to begin a new journey toward healing.

There’s a full moon hitting on Tuesday, Nov. 24, and this marks the midpoint of the current lunar cycle. This lunation is particularly intellectually illuminating, with the potential to spark revelations that help things click into place. Whether you’ve been dealing with intense struggles or just wading through the inconveniences of the recent retrogrades, this week — assisted by this powerful full moon — will begin turning things around and showing you the light at the end of the tunnel.

Enter the Six of Swords, which is the card I pulled for this week’s energy. It depicts an adult and a child sitting on a bare-bones boat wrapped in blankets, with a garden of upright swords stabbed into the boat’s floor in front of them, symbolizing their many recent struggles. They’re both looking downward to indicate exhaustion, but there’s a third person in the boat who is rowing them across a body of water — taking them away from the choppy waves behind them and rowing toward more serene seas.

This week, you too are being rowed to a safer and more calming space, so it should finally feel like you can breathe again. This trajectory change might happen by chance, as the full moon could catalyze a perspective shift or reveal a new opportunity. However, it might involve a more active decision on your end, too, requiring you to proverbially call a boat and ask for help to get you out of a negative situation.

Whether you take the lead in your own rescue or simply accept the assistance that comes your way, know that you can finally breathe a sigh of relief, as better days lie ahead. You’re kicking off a brand new journey — one that allows you to start fresh and leave your baggage behind — so give yourself a moment to breathe and recover, then start thinking about how you’d like to debut your brand-new era. We are so back, baby (or we will be soon, anyway).

item.title: A Horoscope For The Week Of November 23 - 29, 2026
item.description: Astrologer Nina Kahn reveals what the stars have in store for every zodiac sign's horoscope for the week of November 23 – 29, 2026.
item.dc:creator: Nina Kahn
item.content:encoded:
It’s a festive and eventful week, both in the stars and here on Earth. Sagittarius season began over the weekend, and having the sun in this free-spirited fire sign is lightening up the vibes in a big way, bringing a sense of spontaneity and a desire to celebrate the good times.

Monday brings some beautiful connections between lover Venus and the destiny-shaping North Node, and then with the confident sun and dreamy Neptune — all of which can boost creativity and imagination, while sprinkling a star-crossed magic over relationships. Tuesday’s full Beaver Moon in Gemini injects everything with a dose of the unexpected, disrupting usual thoughts and conversations with some unpredictability. Express your truth, even if it shakes up the status quo.

Go-getter Mars also zooms into attentive Virgo on Wednesday, giving everyone a more sustained attention span — especially when it comes to things that you’re passionate or competitive about. The lingering full moon buzz might also set the stage for a wild Blackout Wednesday, complete with surprises and plot twists. By Thanksgiving Day, the moon snuggles up into its home sign of Cancer, so it truly is a fabulous time for getting cozy, nourishing yourself with comfort foods, and spending time with family.

Optimistic vibes shine straight into the weekend, as romantic Venus blows a kiss to abundant Jupiter on Saturday. Enjoy your time off if you have it, and know it’ll be well spent connecting with friends and fostering harmony in your partnerships. Vulnerability opens new doors when it comes to bonding.

Finally, one of the year’s biggest aspects arrives on Sunday, and that’s an auspicious trine between forward-thinking Uranus and control-seeking Pluto. This outer planet alignment could lead to progressive breakthroughs or positive shifts in power structures. Slow-moving changes could finally crack through to the surface, allowing everyone to see the progress that’s been building.

Here’s each zodiac sign’s horoscope for the week ahead.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

Expect the unexpected this week, both in regards to outside events and your own inner thought processes. The things you’re learning, observing, and coming to terms with intellectually may reshape your perspective, allowing you to jump into a radically fresh timeline. Don’t be afraid of change.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

Finances can be tough to balance during the holidays, and Thanksgiving week may be especially chaotic, bringing some sudden expenses or unexpected investment opportunities. It’s good to have a reliable system, but right now, you may want to explore a new approach when it comes to managing your cash flow.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

You’re like a sponge when it comes to absorbing new information and experiences, so it’s important to give yourself space to change your mind and explore new ideas. Don’t let anyone trap you inside of an old version of yourself just because your growth highlights their insecurities.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

This week offers you a powerful inside glimpse at your own subconscious. If you choose to explore the depths, you might be surprised by what you discover. Things you didn’t realize were weighing on you or driving your behavior could finally become clear, giving you the power to change them.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

You’ve been tapped into your present-moment passions lately, but are they aligned with your higher aspirations and values? Look toward the future and start figuring out ways that your current contributions could help create the world you hope to live in. You can make a bigger impact than you think.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

Growth can be triggered from all sorts of places, so whether or not you have a short work week for Thanksgiving, your professional life could be a major catalyst for clarity. Take time to process any career developments and consider what’s driving your ambition as well as what’s holding you back.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

Thanksgiving small talk with peripheral family members or high school classmates might not inspire much excitement — and that’s exactly why you should focus on honing in on your special interests instead. A fresh hyperfixations could open up a whole new way of thinking and give you a lot more to talk about.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

It doesn’t always feel natural to quantify feelings or put words to every emotional experience, but this week, talking through whatever’s weighing on your heart could be the key to understanding it. Knowing yourself and others is a whole lot easier when there’s openness and honesty involved.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

If you were to step back and let the people in your life dictate your direction, where might you end up? Well, there’s a reason you’re in the driver’s seat and they’re not — and this week you may need to remind them of it. There’s no need to water down your aspirations or views to placate others.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

Sometimes all you need to shake you out of a stagnant streak is a change to your routine. Switch up your morning rituals, try some new productivity hacks, or experiment with different daily habits than usual. Having some extra days off for the holiday weekend could be the perfect time for a reset.

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

You’re getting hit with a sudden shockwave of inspiration this week that can open new doors and remind you of the many possibilities that lie before you. You may not be able to bottle up this feeling, but you can act on it now and channel your passion into something that’ll continue to bring joy to your life.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

It’s amazing how uncomfortable your comfort zone can become without you even realizing you’ve outgrown it. This week, consider making some foundational changes to your life that allow you to cater your energy toward new goals and more aligned routines. Your home life could use a reset.

item.title: The Kookiest, Most Clever Things On Amazon You Never Knew Existed
item.description: This list is packed with kooky-looking items that will delight anyone else who comes across them. Even better, each one actually serves a purpose
item.dc:creator: Debbie Lee
item.content:encoded:
Amazon is probably already your source for basics, but you may want to take a minute to discover its weirder side. This list is packed with kooky-looking items that will delight anyone else who comes across them. Even better, each one actually serves a purpose. Have you ever considered stirring milk into your coffee with a mini wind-up boat motor instead of a spoon? Blind spot mirrors are a great safety addition to your car, but what about ones shaped like hearts? Take a look and see which fun finds the Bustle shopping team thinks are worth adding to your life.

A Handheld Microscope That Turns Backyard Bugs Into A Science Lesson

BMDSAE Handheld Digital Microscope

Amazon -

This handheld digital microscope turns backyard exploration into a miniature science experiment. It offers up to 1000X optical and digital magnification, with adjustable LED lighting for examining bugs, leaves, and everyday objects in greater detail. A shock-resistant case and anti-shake grip help withstand clumsy hands, while the rechargeable battery lasts about two hours. You also get 32MB of storage for saving photos and videos of your discoveries.

A Rotating Candle That Creates A Tiny Show When Lit

DAISRED Candle Carousel

amazon -

Light this charming Scandinavian-style spinning candle and watch it transform into kinetic art. As it burns, rising heat spins metal hummingbird blades above the flame, creating a mesmerizing display. The wax is infused with essential oils for a gentle scent and provides roughly 25 hours of burn time.

A Popular Straw That Helps Cure Hiccups Fast

HICCAWAY Hiccup Straw

Amazon -

With nearly 4,000 five-star ratings, Amazon fans are raving about the game-changing nature of this hiccup straw. Fill a glass with water, sip through the straw with some effort, swallow, and repeat two or three times. Its physician-designed approach uses controlled suction to stimulate the vagus and phrenic nerves, and the company cites a 92% effectiveness rate in an official study. It's reusable, dishwasher-safe, and small enough to keep in a bag.

A Coloring Book Set That Makes Stress Relief Funny

ZICOTO Adult Coloring Books (2-Pack)

Amazon -

This adult coloring book set offers a creative way to unwind with a healthy dose of adult humor. The two 32-page spiral-bound books combine woodland and intricate floral illustrations with profanity-laced motivational phrases, giving you something to color while occasionally making you laugh.

Scented Lava Pens That Make Journaling Feel Like A Spa Treatment

Lifelines Scented Lava Gel Pen Set (5-Pack)

Amazon -

These scented lava gel pens turn writing into a full-on sensory experience. Each one has a lava-style barrel filled with shifting bubbles, plus uniquely scented ink made with essential oils, including green apple and coconut. Five bright ink colors and smooth gel tips make them equally fun for journaling, doodling, and note-taking.

Shower Drain Hair Catchers That Keep Clogs From Ruining Pipes

DrainWig Shower Drain Hair Catchers (2-Pack)

Amazon -

If you've resigned yourself to fishing hair out of the shower drain every week or so, these hair catchers could change that. Each one uses a stainless-steel chain that threads through your existing drain cover, catching hair before it reaches your pipes. You shouldn’t have to touch the hair when you remove it, and a decorative white flower on top keeps things looking cute enough to make you forget you're dealing with a chore.

An LED Drawing Board That Feels Like Screen Time, Minus The Screen

Lumiboard Led Drawing Board with 13 Light Effects, 16" Rechargeable Glow Doodle LED Note Board with Colors, Neon Light Up Drawing Tablet Gifts for Kids for Easter Birthday Christmas Gift Ideas

Amazon -

This best-selling LED drawing board turns ordinary doodling into colorful, glowing art. The acrylic panel offers eight RGB colors and six dynamic light modes, with adjustable brightness to reduce glare. A rechargeable battery provides up to 16 hours of runtime at the lowest settings, and the kit includes plenty of extras, including markers, tracing paper, magnets, a lanyard, a spray bottle, and a cleaning cloth.

A Mini Bop It That Tests Your Reflexes & Evokes Nostalgia

World’s Smallest Bop It Extreme

Amazon -

The World's Smallest Bop It Extreme takes all the chaos of the original game and shrinks it into a 4-inch package. Bop, twist, pull, spin, and flick your way through voice commands to test your memory and reflexes. Multiple game modes and music styles keep things interesting, whether you're aiming for a personal best or flexing on friends at a party. It's basically childhood nostalgia that fits in your pocket.

A Weighted Plush Bunny That Turns Cuddles Into Cramp Relief

Happy Fuel Microwavable Weighted Stuffed Animal

Amazon -

Why settle for a regular heating pad when you can get relief while cuddling a sweet bunny? This stuffed animal is filled with natural, unscented clay beads that add gentle weight against your body. Microwave it for 60 seconds to create soothing warmth for period cramps, muscle aches, or stressful days. You can even add your favorite essential oils for an aromatherapy boost.

A Floating Globe That Looks Like A Science Fiction Scene

Poojaed Magnetic Levitating Globe

Amazon -

Forget the old-school spinning globes from your childhood classroom — this levitating model makes your desk look like it belongs in a futuristic movie. Magnetic force keeps the globe floating above its base without physical support, while a gentle spin can keep it rotating for 15 to 25 minutes. Built-in LEDs provide a soft glow, and multiple Amazon shoppers rave about its affordable price.

A Flying Orb That Turns Your Backyard Into A Light Show

Ivtivfu Flying Orb Ball (Blue, 2025 Upgraded) with Dazzling Lights, Magic Hover Spinner, Cool Boomerang Drone, Floating Cosmic Globe, Kids Toys Gifts for 6 7 8 9 10 Year Old Boys Girls

Amazon -

This flying orb ball turns backyard play into a miniature light show. Toss it, catch it, spin it, and watch the illuminated orb hover and change direction midair. It's USB-rechargeable and compact enough for a backpack, so you can take it to any outdoor gathering and inspire kids and adults alike to spend more time touching grass than rotting in bed.

An Avocado Coin Pouch That Almost Looks Too Real

FUSMYE Avocado Coin Purse Pouch

Amazon -

This avocado coin pouch looks so realistic, you may have to stop someone from trying to spread it on toast. Made from soft, durable silicone, it unzips to hold cash, cards, and loose change, then doubles as quirky decor when you're not carrying it. It's a fun, compact accessory you can stash in your purse, glovebox, or — if you want to play a gag on someone — the fridge.

A Coffee Cup Night-Light That Doubles As A Phone Holder

Yesinaly Coffee Cup Night-Light

Amazon -

Add some caffeine-inspired comfort to your bedside, bookshelf, or desk with this coffee cup night-light. It features seven colors and three dimmable warm white settings, charges via USB, and runs for up to 27 hours on a full charge. Its legs double as a built-in phone stand, and the soft silicone body can survive being knocked off the nightstand. Squeeze or tap it to set your preferred mood, then bask in the adorable glow.

A Frog-Shaped Salt Cellar That Adds Humor To The Kitchen Counter

OTOTO Frog Salt Cellar

Amazon -

This frog-shaped salt cellar makes everyday cooking a little easier and a little more whimsical. A generous 6-ounce capacity means fewer refills, and the lid opens to reveal a tongue that doubles as a spoon, so there's no need to dig through a drawer for a utensil. Made from durable ceramic, it's dishwasher-safe, heat-resistant, and built to withstand daily use in a busy kitchen.

A Cat Purse Hook That Keeps Your Bag Off Grimy Floors

Fiyrtarn Purse Hook

Amazon -

Your handbag has spent enough time on questionable restaurant floors — this cat purse hook will put an end to that. Made from durable metal, it supports up to 12 pounds and folds flat when you're not using it, so it’s easy to just toss in your bag. A rubber pad helps prevent slipping or scratches, while rhinestone accents make it cute enough to double as a bag charm.

A Toast Cushion That Instantly Softens Any Seat

Lumogeva Toast Seat Cushion

amazon -

Give your chair a breakfast-themed makeover with this toast seat cushion — because why not? Cotton filling provides comfort, a crystal-velvet cover adds a slight shimmer, and the nonslip base keeps it firmly planted on your seat. Choose from four facial expressions and enjoy the quirky, kawaii-esque energy wherever your backside needs a little extra support, from home offices to gaming setups.

A Sheep-Shaped Towel That Makes You Laugh While Drying Your Hands

Heikrdo Sheep Hand Towel

Amazon -

With its goofy expression, this sheep hand towel makes drying your hands feel way more charming than a square of terry cloth would. Made from absorbent chenille microfiber, it has an ultra-soft texture and a built-in loop that keeps it hanging neatly by the sink. Use it in the bathroom, kitchen, or guest powder room, where the shaggy sheep adds instant personality.

An Eject Button That Plugs Into Your Cigarette Lighter

Osilly Dustproof Car Plug

Amazon -

This aluminum cigarette lighter plug is for anyone who believes in the importance of small details — and in having a sense of humor. It slips into a standard 12-volt socket to keep out dust, crumbs, and other debris, while its polished metal finish reads "EJECT" for a funny, eye-catching accent that will delight passengers.

Flexible Dog-Shaped Key Caps That End Confusion

WIRESTER Key Cap Covers (2-Pack)

Amazon -

For those who love pups, these key caps are a cute solution to the common problem of not knowing which key you're holding. The PVC construction is flexible and slips over your keys in seconds — use one for your house key and another for your car key, and you can tell them apart instantly. The two-pack includes German shepherd and Boston terrier designs, giving your keychain a playful personality.

A Hammer Of Thor Bottle Opener That Makes Opening Beer Cool AF

Lmaytech Beer Bottle Opener

Amazon -

When you need to open a beer, this bottle opener does the job in dramatic fashion. The hammer-shaped body, inspired by Thor's weapon of choice, will delight Marvel and mythology fans alike, while the sturdy metal opener effortlessly handles standard bottle caps. There's even a chain for hanging it near the fridge, so it won't get lost in a junk drawer.

Squeeze Bean Fidget Toys That Give Busy Hands Something To Do

Ganjiang Squeeze Bean Keychain Fidget Toys (12-Pack)

Amazon -

These squeeze bean fidget toys turn the satisfaction of popping peas from a pod into something you can carry everywhere. Attach one to a keychain, backpack, or bag zipper to give restless hands something to do during commutes, meetings, calls, or classes. The 12-piece pack makes them easy to share, too, whether you're stocking a party prize box or have a house full of fidgeters.

A 1980s-Style Alarm Clock With 2020s-Style Functions

RayCue Maclock WB-8 Retro Pixel Alarm Clock - 1984 Computer-Inspired USB Desk Clock with Pixel Display, Multiple Alarms & Adjustable Brightness | Maclock Calendar, Temperature, Unique Retro Tech Gift

Amazon -

This retro pixel alarm clock looks like it came from a 1980s computer lab and landed on your nightstand. Its ivory shell and pixel display show the time, date, and room temperature, and a touch dial makes it easy to adjust brightness. Startup animation and a floppy-disk prop keep the look authentic, while five alarm modes and USB-C charging keep features modern and convenient.

A Wind-Up Coffee Mixer That Turns Stirring Into Entertainment

Hoyt Mercantile Co Motor Mixer Coffee Stirrer

Amazon -

This wind-up boat motor coffee stirrer turns a mundane part of your morning routine into a tiny performance. Clip the miniature motor onto your mug, wind it up, and let the propeller stir your coffee, tea, or hot chocolate while your hands stay free to read, scroll, or take a bite of toast. No batteries are required, and it works with hot or cold drinks.

A Cat Figurine That Doubles As An Earbuds Stand

atHand Dance Cat Airpod Holder

Amazon -

Instead of leaving earbuds on a tabletop, where they can roll off or go missing, this cat-shaped holder gives them a permanent home. The sturdy little figurine holds AirPods 1, 2, 3, Pro, and most similar models in its raised paws, securing them with tiny hidden magnets. The base can double as a pen holder, but the kitty also serves as cute desk decor even when it's empty-handed.

A Popular Illustrated Book That Keeps Self-Care Lighthearted

The Little Frog's Guide to Self-Care by Maybell Eequay

Amazon -

The Little Frog's Guide to Self-Care makes personal growth less intimidating by putting the advice in the hands of an adorable mushroom-hatted frog. Created by artist Maybell Eequay, the book pairs more than 40 hand-drawn illustrations with short, funny lessons about self-love and emotional honesty. Keep it on your coffee table for easy access to gentle words of encouragement for yourself and guests.

A Disco Ball Wax Warmer That Spins & Sparkles

SCANDINORDICA Disco Ball Wax Warmer

Amazon -

This disco ball wax warmer turns any room into an instant party. Its spinning design throws flecks of light around the room, color-changing LEDs set the mood, and the electric heating plate melts wax without an open flame. A removable silicone tray makes cleanup easy, and it doubles as a night-light when you're out of wax. It's a functional gadget in a slightly extra package.

A Practical Crossbody Bag That's Shaped Like A Stick Of Butter

Sweet Lion Butter Crossbody Bag

Amazon -

If you're the type of person who leans hard into trends, this butter bag is an accessory that captures the current moment. Made from vegan leather, it’s 9 inches long, so there’s plenty of room for essentials like your phone, keys, cash, and lipstick. A detachable gold-tone chain lets you wear it crossbody, over the shoulder, or as a clutch, and a zipper closure keeps everything safely contained.

A Game Boy-Inspired Plasma Lighter That Lasts 2 Weeks Per Charge

Rolls Plasma Lighter Retro Lighter

Amazon -

Old-school gamers will be delighted by this Game Boy-inspired plasma lighter, not only for its looks but also for its performance. Dual plasma arcs are windproof and can ignite candles, barbecues, and kindling without butane or an open flame. It charges via USB-C in under an hour and lasts about two weeks with regular use.

A Boiled Egg Mold That Turns Breakfast Into An Archaeology Dig

Genuine Fred Dino MATIC Hard-Boiled Egg Mold

Amazon -

This food mold shapes a simple hard-boiled egg into a tiny dinosaur skull, turning breakfast into an adventure. Simply add a freshly boiled egg, seal it, and let it take shape. It's a great way to encourage picky eaters to see food as fun.

Viral Socks That Literally Hold Hands When You Walk

SURGETIDE Magnetic Holding Hands Socks (2 Pairs)

Amazon -

Put on a pair of these adorable hand-holding socks, then share the second pair with your bestie, partner, or spouse to celebrate your special bond. Each sock features an embroidered hand with a tiny embedded magnet, so the hands naturally snap together when you're near. They’re made from a cotton-polyester blend with spandex for stretch, and they’re machine washable for easy cleaning.

A Beloved Smiley Face Planter That Gives Your Houseplant Personality

RZOIKZOI Rocking Chair Smiley Face Planter

Amazon -

This rocking-chair smiley-face planter gives any shelf, patio, or plant corner a laidback vibe. Your plant becomes its hair, while the resin chair actually rocks when you nudge it. A drainage hole helps prevent overwatering, and the durable resin body makes it suitable for outdoor use without cracking or fading.

A Stretchy Snail Headband That Makes Skincare Fun For Everyone

Molain Face Wash Headband

Amazon -

You need a headband to get the most out of your skincare routine, and this one does it with a silly, happy energy. Made from soft, absorbent microfiber, it keeps your hair out of the way, whether you’re just washing your face or commiting to an elaborate 10-step routine. The elastic stretches up to 12 inches to fit kids and adults, while the snail's tentacles add a welcome dash of whimsy to your grooming regimen.

Mini Drawing Boards That Let You Get Creative Anywhere You Go

Bedwina Mini Magnetic Drawing Board Keychains (12-Pack)

Amazon -

These mini magnetic drawing boards are a throwback to the Etch-A-Sketch of your childhood, only in keychain form. Draw and erase without paper, markers, or cleanup, and tuck each one into your bag for an easy distraction during restaurant meals, car rides, or long stretches in a waiting room.

A Cat-Like Mug Warmer That Doubles As A Phone Holder

PUSEE Mug Warmer

Amazon -

Set this mug warmer on your desk and say goodbye to lukewarm coffee. Choose from three temperature settings — 113, 131, or 158 degrees — and let it keep your drink at your preferred temperature while you work. It automatically shuts off after eight hours and works with most flat-bottomed mugs. The cat-shaped design is a bonus for feline fans, while its outstretched paws double as a phone stand for extra functionality.

Duck Paper Clips That Secure Serious Paperwork With Unserious Energy

Daxtril Duck Shaped Paper Clips (60 Pieces)

Amazon -

These paper clips take the form of tiny ducks, adding a touch of joy to everyday office supplies. The 60-pack gives you a flock of bright yellow ducks for holding documents, marking pages, tackling craft projects, and more. They're just as practical as standard paper clips, but their sunny shape will make you smile in a way the usual silver clips never could.

A Waffle House Night-Light That Brings Nostalgia To Your Halls

Waffle House Plug-in Night Light

Amazon -

This Waffle House plug-in night-light brings 2 a.m. diner energy to your hallway without requiring a road trip or a plate of hash browns. The classic logo glows automatically when the room gets dark, thanks to its built-in sensor, and then shuts off when it gets light again. It's a great gift for Waffle House loyalists, retro Americana fans, or anyone who enjoys late-night diner runs.

Swizzle Sticks That Make Every Cocktail Look Bar-Worthy

ABSOK Swizzle Sticks (10-Pack)

Amazon -

These colorful swizzle sticks make even a basic drink look like it came from a fancy hotel bar. Each of the 10 acrylic stirrers is topped with a tiny decorative cocktail, adding pizzazz to cocktails, mocktails, iced coffee, or whatever else is in your glass. They're sturdy enough for regular use, so this isn't novelty barware destined for the trash after one party.

A Light-Up Sign That Lets You Rate Every Driver On The Road

Flik Thumbs Up & Down Light

Amazon -

Channel your road rage into humor with this thumbs-up and thumbs-down light. Stick the rechargeable LED sign to your back windshield with the included automotive tape, then flash your verdict at merges and tailgaters. It runs for up to four months on three fresh AA batteries, and multiple satisfied Amazon shoppers noted that the brightness is impressive.

Pushpin Magnets That Hold Notes Without Sharp Ends

MapMagnets Magnetic Push Pins (24 Count)

Amazon -

These magnetic push pins replace the tiny, sharp tacks that always inevitably nick someone's thumb. The colorful magnets hold up to six sheets of paper without sliding, making them a great choice for pinning memos on filing cabinets, whiteboards, and fridges. One fan wrote, "If you're a magnet fan, congratulations, because you just found the [promised] land." There are 24 per set, and you can choose from a variety of colors to match your taste.

A Panda Mug That Turns Your Morning Coffee Into A Tiny Surprise

ZaH 3D Ceramic Mug

Amazon -

Sip from this mug and watch a surprise slowly emerge at the bottom: a three-dimensional panda that looks up at you like the cutest thing ever. The 8-ounce ceramic cup is heat-resistant and microwave-safe, making it practical enough for everyday coffee or tea while being far more fun than your average mug. It has well over 4,000 five-star ratings on Amazon and is also available with other animal suprises, including a bunny and a dolphin.

A Dachshund Hair Clip That Makes Updos Fast, Flashy & Funny

Hapdoo Dachshund Hair Clip

Amazon -

This dachshund hair clip is a playful way to show your love for the comically short-legged breed. Made from durable acetate with polished edges, it holds thick, thin, curly, or fine hair without snagging or pulling. Its unmistakable shape adds personality to an otherwise ordinary hairstyle, and you can also find it in other playful animal designs, including a peacock and a seahorse.

A Plush Bread Pillow That Adds Kitsch & Comfort To Nap Time

Levenkeness Bread Pillow

Amazon -

This bread pillow is the kind of kooky home accent that will spark joy in any carb fiend. Its realistic print gives it plenty of personality, while the plush exterior and fluffy filling make it just as huggable as a stuffed animal. Give it a few days to expand to its full size, then add it to your bed, couch, or reading corner as a cozy conversation piece.

A Spill-Like Spoon Rest That Helps Prevent Spills & Messes

LDAOS Ketchup Spoon Rest

Amazon -

This humorous spoon rest celebrates the messy nature of cooking while helping keep your counter clean. Made from flexible, heat-resistant silicone, it's shaped like a giant sauce blob mid-splash and holds spoons and spatulas without cracking or warping.

Stick-On Heart-Shaped Mirrors That Make For Safer Driving

HINGTAI Blind Spot Mirrors (2 Pieces)

amazon -

These heart-shaped blind-spot mirrors turn a practical car safety accessory into an aesthetic upgrade. The convex glass lenses widen your field of view to help spot vehicles and obstacles when merging, reversing, or changing lanes, while adjustable adhesive mounting lets you position them where they're most useful. The two-pack covers both side mirrors and fits most cars, trucks, and SUVs.

A Date Night Dice That End The "What's for Dinner?" Debate

FUAOIS Dinner Decider Dice

Amazon -

When you're in a relationship, "What do you want to eat?" is an eternal question that can eventually drive you nuts. When indecision strikes, leave it to fate and roll this 12-sided dice instead. Made from wood with engraved text and icons, it covers everything from pizza and breakfast food to sushi and steak. One shopper wrote, "They add a bit of spontaneity to planning a date and make it easy to try something different instead of always doing the same thing."

An Electric S'mores Maker That Brings Campfire Vibes Indoors

Nostalgia Electric S'mores Maker

Amazon -

This best-selling tabletop electric s'mores maker brings campfire energy indoors without requiring an actual flame. It plugs into a standard outlet and comes with two stainless-steel roasting forks and a four-compartment tray for keeping graham crackers, chocolate, and marshmallows organized. Use it to bring the joy of a beloved summer pastime to movie nights, social gatherings, or even everyday family dinners.

A Tiny Glass Bulb That Glows Anywhere There's A USB Port

PEOKPIPLE LED Car Light

Amazon -

This mini glass bottle night-light proves you don't need a giant lamp to add ambiance to your space. It plugs into any 5V USB source and uses touch controls to cycle through three brightness levels. The shatter-resistant glass and IPX4-rated waterproof base make it portable, so you can use it in a car or camping tent just as easily as at home.

A Kitty Cat Tape Dispenser That Adds Joy To Your Office Desk

Chapman & Grand Cat Tape Dispenser

Amazon -

This kitty cat tape dispenser turns a standard desk supply into something that deserves a place of pride on your workspace. Simply pop in a regular roll of tape and carry on as usual. The nonslip base keeps it from scooting across your desk every time you tear off a piece, while its compact size doesn't hog valuable workspace.

A Giant Checkers Set That Turns Backyard Hangouts Into Friendly Competition

JOYIN 3-in-1 Giant Game Mat

Amazon -

Turn any gathering into game night with this giant checkers set. The reversible mat supports checkers, tic-tac-toe, and giant tic-tac-toe, while 24 oversized checkers pieces are easy to see and handle. Designed for kids and adults, the set works both indoors and outdoors. It's nostalgic fun that can keep everyone off their screens for just a little longer.

A Crochet Flower Coaster That Doubles As Tiny Table Decor

Vane Oak Crochet Flower Coaster with Pot

Amazon -

If cottagecore decor is your jam, this crochet flower coaster deserves a spot on your coffee table or kitchen counter. Each one is handmade from soft yarn and features a crocheted flower with a matching miniature pot, making it look like a tiny bouquet even when it's not protecting your table from coffee rings or scratches. Choose from an array of pretty designs, or buy several for a colorful set.

A Love Notes Jar That Makes Every Day Feel Like February 14

FUTUREPLUSX Love Pills Message Capsules (100 Pieces)

Amazon -

This love-message capsule jar gives you 100 tiny opportunities to be more romantic. Fill the paper capsules with your own handwritten notes, then let your partner pull one whenever they need a reminder of why they're loved. The set includes the glass jar, 100 inserts, and a decorative box, so it's ready for gifting. It's especially sweet for anniversaries, long-distance relationships, or anyone who appreciates sentimental surprises.

A Portable Ping Pong Set That Turns Any Table Into A Game

FBSPORT Ping Pong Paddle Set

Amazon -

This portable ping-pong set turns nearly any tabletop into a competition site in minutes. It includes a retractable net, two wooden paddles, six balls, and a carry bag. Clamp the net to the sides of your table, channel your inner Marty Supreme, and challenge a friend to a match. Everything packs down easily, so you can take the game to parks, camping trips, and parties instead of sending balls flying around your dining room.

A Piercing Ball Grabber That Makes Jewelry Changes Quick & Easy

GEMQUEEN Piercing Ball Grabber Reacher Tool - Stainless Steel Piercing Jewelry Tools 4 Claw Holder Removal Pick Up Assistant Tool for Changing Jewelry IC Chip Electronic Components Small Parts

Amazon -

Cleaning my bedroom used to involve rescuing a hodgepodge of studs that had slipped out of my piercings and rolled under my dresser, but this grabber is the fix. Its four-claw grip securely holds small piercing balls and studs, while the extended stainless-steel handle gives you better control when switching out jewelry. It's also useful for handling tiny electronics or other small components, so its usefulness isn't limited to body jewelry.

A Best-Selling Magnetic Yarn Spinner That Makes Crocheting More Relaxing

JUCPASH Yarn Holder

Amazon -

If crocheting is your idea of relaxing, don't let tangled yarn ruin the vibe. This magnetic holder keeps things moving smoothly as you work. Made from smooth-finished solid bamboo, it features embedded magnetic fittings that connect the spool to the frame. It holds balls weighing up to 500 grams and spins 360 degrees, saving you from having to manually unwind yarn as you go.

A Margarita Tumbler That Keeps Your Cocktail Cold For 10 Hours

REDUCE Insulated Cocktail Tumbler

Amazon -

There's nothing like a margarita on a hot day, and unlike a plastic cup, this insulated tumbler keeps your drink cold and looking cute to the last sip. Stainless-steel double-wall construction keeps drinks icy for up to 10 hours, while the 360-degree splash-proof lid lets you sip from any angle without needing a straw. Internal measurement markers help ensure accurate pours, and the rim is designed for a traditional dip in salt

item.title: 85 Weird-As-Hell Things That You'll Actually Get A Sh*t Ton Of Use Out Of
item.description: The finds in this collection are strange, but extremely useful, too, so they earn their spot in your cart.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Martinson
item.content:encoded:
One of the simplest ways to spice up everyday life is by introducing some weird-as-hell items into your routine. The finds in this collection are strange, but extremely useful, too, so they earn their spot in your cart. After all, why buy a boring plastic box cutter when you can get a set of teeny tiny chef knives instead? With this ethos in mind, Bustle’s shopping editors gathered their favorite weird AF buys for you below, and made sure each one is practical, too.

Panda-Shaped Hand Warmers That Heat Up In Just 2 Seconds

AaoLin Rechargeable Hand Warmers (2-Pack)

Amazon -

From outdoor sporting events to skiing down mountains, these hand warmers make it so easy to keep your hands comfortably warm during all sorts of cold-weather activities. The batteries deliver up to 20 hours of heat before they’ll need to be recharged. You can also adjust their temperature up to three levels — and they only take about two seconds to heat up.

The Wearable Flashlight With A Beam That Stretches To 393 Feet

OLIGHT Clip-on Flashlight

Amazon -

Don’t be fooled by how small this flashlight is. The ultra-powerful bulb can shine its light all the way out to 393 feet, making it great for staying visible at night, or even just tackling DIY projects. But if that isnt enough? A clip on the back lets you secure it to your clothes for hands-free use.

Rechargeable Headlights That Clip Onto Crocs

CUYLERAZM Flashlight Clog Charm

amazon -

Add these flashlights to your Crocs, and they’ll help keep you visible at night when walking the dog. They’re made from a durable aluminum alloy that won’t short circuit in the rain. Plus, the LED bulb is so strong that it can even be seen from up to 33 feet away.

Chair Leg Socks That Help Prevent Scratched Floors

IAMZAY Chair Leg Socks

Amazon -

Made from double-layer knitted wool with a stretchy elastic fit, these chair socks slip onto furniture legs and stay securely in place without sagging or sliding off. The soft fabric helps prevent scratches on hardwood, tile, laminate, and other hard floors while eliminating the screeching sound of moving chairs. Durable enough for daily use and washable for easy care, they come in 10 colors to complement a wide range of interior styles.

A 20x Pocket Microscope That Fits On Your Keychain

Carson MicroMini 20x Pocket Microscope, UV and LED Flashlight, Blue

Amazon -

This compact microscope fits on your keychain and brings 20x magnification wherever you go, turning everyday objects into something worth examining. Use it to inspect currency, check sneaker stitching, or zoom in on details just for fun. It also comes with a built-in light featuring three modes: LED for microscope use, standalone LED flashlight, and standalone UV flashlight.

This Portable Bidet With More Than 17,000 5-Star Reviews

The Original HAPPYPO Portable Bidet

Amazon -

You’ll be glad you grabbed this portable bidet the next time you’ve got to go in a public bathroom. The angled tip makes it easy to direct the stream of water wherever you need it — and its leakproof design works to keep your bag safe from spills. “I [...] find this easy to squeeze with one hand,” wrote one reviewer. “It's really a terrific item to have on a daily basis or for traveling.”

A Compact Water Flosser That’s Easy To Take With You

WAFLOO Travel Water Flosser

Amazon -

Unlike the water flosser you’ve likely been using, this one features a compact design that takes up minimal space, making it easy to take with you when traveling. Five cleaning modes (child, pulse, soft, normal, and strong) give you options when deciding how thorough of a floss you need. Plus, the battery delivers up to 30 days of use before it’ll need to be recharged.

A Genius 4-Device Car Charger With Retractable Cords

LISEN Retractable Car Charger, for Gifts for Him Her, 69W Cars Adapter USB C Fast Charger for iPhone 17-11, Car Accessories Gadgets for Men, Anniversary Birthday Gifts for Men Women, for Samsung

Amazon -

Keep this charger plugged into your car’s cigarette lighter, and it’ll always be ready to go whenever your phone runs low on battery. It features two retractable charging cables (one type-C and one Lightning) that extend out to 31 inches, making it easy to power devices in the back as well as front seats. Plus, two additional ports (one USB and one type-C) give you the ability to power up to four devices simultaneously.

A Retractable Clothesline That Disappears Into The Wall

Letting bars of soap sit in a puddle can cause them to break down faster. Enter: this soap dish. A channel in the front allows pooling moisture to drain right back into your sink, helping bars of soap last longer. Since it’s made from a combination of ceramic and stainless steel, you won’t have to worry about it corroding over time.

Calming Patches That Can Help Ease Nerves When Flying

Laki Naturals Fly Calm Patches (8-Pack)

Amazon -

Anyone who feels anxious before getting onto a plane is sure to appreciate these patches. They’re made from a blend of ashwagandha, lavender, chamomile, as well as other calming ingredients, all of which work to help ease your nerves. Plus, you only need to apply them 20 minutes before your flight for best results.

Squishy Cleaning Gel That Gets Deep Into Tight Spaces

TICARVE Car Cleaning Gel

Amazon -

Air vents, camera lenses, cup holders — this cleaning gel is great for cleaning deep into all sorts of tight spaces. The surface is tacky enough to latch onto dirt, dust, crumbs, and more, yet not so sticky that it’ll adhere to your hands. The best part? You can reuse it up until the color turns dark.

The Space-Saving Organizer That Holds Up To $6 In Coins

JoyTutus Car Coin Organizer

Amazon -

Don’t go scavenging through your center console whenever you need change. Instead, keep all those loose coins inside of this organizer. It can hold up to six dollars worth of coins, yet is still compact enough that you can keep it in your side door pocket, glove compartment, or nearly anywhere else you like. “The build is sturdy, and the slots hold the coins snugly,” wrote one reviewer. “It’s one of those tiny purchases that actually makes life more convenient.”

item.title: 60 Bougie Things For Your Home That Are So Pretty & Useful
item.description: Discover bougie yet practical home essentials—from stylish towels and bedding to solar-powered outdoor lights—that elevate your space without clutter or high cost.
item.dc:creator: Carina Finn
item.content:encoded:
Want to fill your home with beautiful things, but don't want it to feel cluttered with random tchochkes? It's actually surprisingly easy to find pretty versions of functional things if you know where to look, and this list is a great place to start. You'll find everything from surprisingly inexpensive towels and bedding to furniture hacks and lighting fixtures, all at prices that won't drain your bank account. So go ahead and add solar-powered lighting to your outdoor space and get a new set of matching towels for your bathroom—it won't cost a ton, and it will make your home look way nicer.

A Gorgeous Couch Cover That’s Perfect For Home With Pets

Tiwwie Couch Cover

Amazon -

Your beloved furry friend might be wreaking havoc on your furniture, and even though it's cute when they do a big stretch on the couch, the scratches they leave behind are not as adorable. This couch cover protects your furniture without distracting from the aesthetic, and it's super comfortable to sit on.

An Aesthetic Way To Separate A Loft Space

ANMINY Decorative Thick Wall Screen Panels (12 Pieces)

Amazon -

If you have a big room that you want to divide into distinct spaces or a loft-style home, these divider panels will be a game changer. They have a unique hanging style that makes them easy to install just about anywhere, and they come with all the hardware you need.

Blackout Curtains That Don’t Require A Rod

AJAZZ 100% Blackout Self Adhesive Curtain

Amazon -

Blackout curtains can be super helpful, especially when you’re trying to reset your sleep cycle, but you might not want them up all the time. These come with a self-adhesive strip that makes it easy to put them up and take them down without commiting to something more permanent, like installing a curtain rod.

A Faucet Mat That Dries Instantly

Esdallina Diatomite Faucet Mat

Amazon -

The area around your sink's faucet can get so gross so fast, but a quick-drying mat is a simple way to prevent it. This one is made from diatomite, which is naturally absorbent and won't retain excess water, and it has a two-piece design that makes it easy to install.

An Elegant Desk Lamp That Emits A Soothing Scent

YM Dragon Bird Lamp

Amazon -

This sweet bird-shaped table lamp comes in two wood-grain finishes and features adjustable brightness, so you can use it for reading or as a nightlight. It's USB-C rechargeable, so you don't have to place it near an outlet, and it has a built-in aromatherapy diffuser.

A Set Of Chic Hanging Baskets

Wyocoroy Hanging Basket Organizer

Amazon -

Hanging baskets are the unsung heroes of home organization, and these pretty rope baskets have a tiered design that will help you save so much space. They're made from soft cotton rope, and you can mount them to the wall without drilling holes if you're a renter.

Anti-Fatigue Mats That Look Like Legit Rugs

FRESHMINT Anti-Fatigue Kitchen Mats (2 Pieces)

Amazon -

If you've resisted buying anti-fatigue mats for your kitchen or standing desk because you think they're ugly, you'll be glad to know that cute ones exist. These washable mats look like antique rugs, plus they have nonslip backing to stay in place and offer a ton of cushion to help relieve discomfort.

A Decorative Ceiling Fan With Built-In Lighting

Bevenus Low Profile Ceiling Fan with Lights

Amazon -

One easy way to elevate the look of your rental is by swapping out the standard-issue ceiling fan for something a little more design-forward, and this one fits the bill. It has a modern low-profile design with built-in lighting that’s so much nicer than the one that probably came with your place.

A Set Of Pasta Bowls You’d Find At A Trattoria

Artena Large Pasta Bowls (4-Pack)

amazon -

These elegant pasta bowls have the perfect wide, shallow shape for serving spaghetti, stews, and other cozy, comforting dishes. They're sold in a set of four, are made from high-quality glazed ceramic, and come in a few different colors and patterns.

A Mug That Warms Chilly Hands

Selamica Hand Warmer Mug

Amazon -

This ceramic mug has a clever indentation where you can snuggle your hand near the handle to keep it warm. It comes in seven gorgeous dipped glaze colors, and is both microwave- and dishwasher-safe. Fans on Amazon also say it makes an excellent gift.

A Stained Glass Night Light

L LOHAS LED Vintage Night Light

Amazon -

This vintage-inspired night light has a gorgeous stained glass geometric globe on top that softens and adds color to the light. It has a brushed metal finish, and automatic dawn/dusk sensor that turns it on and off, and a slider so you can customize the brightness.

Reversible Quilted Kitchen Towels

STASOPTK Kitchen Towels (4-Pack)

amazon -

These kitchen towels look like they came from an expensive boutique, but they cost less than five dollars apiece. The reversible design gives you even more bang for your buck, and they come with a convenient hanging loop to make them easy to use and display.

A Marble Salt Cellar That Elevates Your Table

Radicaln Marble Salt Cellar with Lid

Amazon -

Want to get something small that instantly makes your kitchen or dining table look more elevated? Make it a marble salt cellar. This one has a sturdy apothecary-style lid and is made from genuine marble, so looks and feels expensive. It comes in six different colors, and has a 7.4-ounce capacity.

An Easy Way To Make Floral Bouquets

Yncotte Flower Arrangement Holder (3-Pack)

Amazon -

Floral arrangement is a creative skill that can take years to master, but there are a few shortcuts you can take if you don’t want to dedicate your life to making gorgeous bouquets. This three-pack of floreal arrangement holders gives you the right structure and spacing, so you can focus on selecting your favorite blossoms.

A Giant Mug That’s Microwave Safe

ALMA Handpainted Microwavable Soup Bowl

Amazon -

When you’re shifting into soup season, it’s essential to have the right mug. This giant ceramic mug is like the perfect hybrid of a cup and a bowl. It has a big loop handle that’s comfortable to hold, and can be tossed in the dishwasher or microwave.

A Heavy Door Stopper That Looks Delicate

Notakia Cast Iron Bird Door Stopper

Amazon -

If you want a heavy-duty doorstopper that isn't a clunky eyesore, this cast iron bird is an excellent middle ground. It's weighty enough to keep even heavier doors open, and it adds a lovely farmhouse-style aesthetic touch to your home thanks to the antique bronze finish.

A Set Of Vintage-Inspired Measuring Cups

Creative Co-Op Floral Measuring Cups

Amazon -

Upgrade your old set of hanging metal measuring cups for these gorgeous ceramic ones. They have a nesting design, so they won't take up too much space, and each one has a pretty floral pattern on the outside. They also have measuring marks on the interior and convenient pouring spouts.

Shower Steamers That Come In Cute Shapes

BodyRefresh Shower Steamers (14-Pack)

Amazon -

Regular tablet-style shower steamers are a great way to make your daily routine feel a little more luxe, but why not take it up a notch with these gorgeous molded steamers? Each one has a different soothing or energizing aromatherapy scent and a unique botanical shape.

A Gutter Extender That Makes Your Home Look Expensive

Euiroet Gutter Extender

Amazon -

Gutter extenders are a super practical way to manage your outdoor space during rainy seasons, but they also give your home a lowkey Gothic cathedral vibe in the best possible way. This fish-shaped extender comes in white, oxidized bronze, and coppery red color options, as well as a few different designs.

A Genius Purse Hook That Fits In Your Pocket.

Bosketo Foldable Purse Hooks (3-Pack)

amazon -

While it would be great if every bar, restaurant, and cafe had built-in purse hooks, sadly that isn't the case. Fortunately this pocket-sized purse hook exists, and it's the next best thing. It's small enough to keep with you all the time, and all you need is a flat surface with a lip to set it up.

Solar-Powered Lights That Make Your Outdoor Space A Whole Vibe

JKIMK Solar Globe Lights (2-Pack)

Amazon -

These solar-powered outdoor globe lights have pre-installed stakes on the bottom, so all you need to do is drive them into the ground and enjoy the vibes. They have a pretty cracked glass exterior, and automatically turn on and offer in response to the ambient light.

A Minimalist Support System That Makes Your Plants Stronger

Yohsnor Monstera Plant Support System (5 Pieces)

Amazon -

If you want your houseplants to grow healthy and strong, they might need a little extra support. This minimalist gold-toned support ring is designed for monsterra plants, but can give some additional structure to similar plants as well. They come in multiple sizes, and are also available in black and green.

Window Film With A Stunning Lace Effect

ADD.HERES Stained Glass Window Film

Amazon -

If you need a little extra privacy but don't want to totally block out the light with blinds or dark curtains, window privacy film is an excellent alternative. These sheets cover just half the window, so they still let in plenty of sunshine, and they come in a bunch of pretty designs.

A Whimsical Hanging Planter Made From A Disco Ball

MFGDISCO Disco Ball Hanging Plant Pot

Amazon -
