This sparkly planter looks like it came straight from a whimsymaxxing Pinterest board. It has a 6-inch diameter that's perfect for bouquets of flowers or smaller houseplants. It comes with a cute wooden stand if you want to set it on a table, as well as everything you need to hang it up.

Rechargeable Hand Warmers You Can Wear Around Your Wrist

Orastone Rechargeable Hand Warmer

Amazon -

If you know someone whose hands are always cold, this rechargeable hand warmer would make an excellent gift. And if that person is you, consider this your sign to buy it as a gift for yourself. It heats on both sides, and comes with a wrist strap.

A Quilt Set That Looks LIke It Came From A Boutique

Joyreap Floral Patchwork Quilt Set (3 Pieces)

Amazon -

This gorgeous quilt set looks fancy AF, but it's surprisingly affordable on Amazon. It comes with a quilt and two matching pillow shams, and the whole set has a brushed microfiber texture that feels so cozy to snuggle underneath. The quilt is also reversible, so you can switch up the vibe of your bedding in seconds.

A Neutral Lace Table Cloth That’s Perfect For Any Occasion

Juvale White Lace Tablecloth for Rectangular Tables, Vintage-Style Wedding Table Cloths for Reception, Dinner Party, Baby Shower, Tea Party Decorations, Home Decor (54x72 in)

Amazon -

A simple lace tablecloth can make a big impact on your space, especially if you love to host. This one has a vintage-inspired floral lace design with scalloped edges that make it look like a family heirloom, and fans on Amazon say it's so well-made it might just become your family heirloom one day.

Faux Candle Night Lights That Plug Into The Wall

Briignite Flameless Candle Night-Lights (2-Pack)

Amazon -

Flameless candles are a great way to create an instant mood shift, and these plug directly into your wall sockets for the ultimate no-fuss lighting solution. They're sold in a pack of two, and come in amber and warm white colors with an automatic sensor.

A Washable Rug That Fits Perfectly In Corners

Jinchan Radius Washable Corner Rug

Amazon -

It can be hard to find the right rug for tight spaces, like the corner of your kitchen, but this one is literally designed for the task. It comes in a wide variety of sizes and shapes, included round, rectangular, and a unique option that's just right for corners.

A Mini LED Lantern With A Pretty GLass Shade

GZWANHANGMY Mini Soft Warm LED Night Light

Amazon -

You can put this little LED lamp pretty much anywhere in your home that could use some extra light. It's battery operated, has an automatic timer, and it comes on a pretty wooden base with a textured glass shade that makes it look so bougie.

A Rattan Pendant Lamp Tjat’s Easy To Install

Bamboo Lantern Plug in Wall

Amazon -

This pendant lamp doesn't require any hardwiring, so you can set it up in just a few minutes. It has a rustic chic bamboo wicker shade, and the switch is on the plug so it's easy to turn it on and off. It mounts to the wall, and comes with everything you need to install it.

Faux Orchids To Illuminate Your Space

Fantasee Orchid Twig Lights (2-Pack)

Amazon -

At first glance, your guests might think these are real orchids, but the touch of a button makes the magic happen. These faux orchids come with pre-installed warm white LED lights, and they're on copper wire so you can bend and arrange them to look even more legit.

A Pack Of Solar-Powered Hanging Lanterns

PARTPHONER Hanging Solar Lanterns (2-Pack)

Amazon -

These hanging lanterns charge in the sun during the day and turn on automatically at dusk, so all you have to do is set them up and enjoy. They come with loops that also have lights on them, so it's easy to hang them on hooks or fence posts.

Toilet Roll Covers For A Coquettecore Bathroom

Hoolerry Decorative Toilet Paper Roll Cover (6-Pack)

amazon -

Toilet roll covers are one of those things you don't think you need until you have them, and then you wondered why you spent so much time looking at ugly bonus rolls of toilet tissue in your bathroom. They come in a set of six and are available in a bunch of styles including florals, animal prints, and these sweet pink bow patterns.

A Gorgeous Refillable Foaming Soap Dispenser

Malachi Foaming Hand Soap Dispenser

Amazon -

You can use your favorite inexpensive bulk foaming soap with this dispenser and still feel like you splurged on luxury hand care. It has a gorgeous textured glass exterior and a wide mouth opening that makes it easy to top it off without making a mess.

An Aromatic Bouquet For Your Shower

Gifugi Dried Eucalyptus & Lavender (20 Pieces)

Amazon -

If shower steamers aren't your thing but you still want to enjoy the benefits of aromatherapy while you rinse off, this dried bouquet has a similar effect. Just hang it near the shower head and the steam will activate the soothing scents of lavender, eucalyptus, and lemon.

An Absorbent Kitchen Counter Mat

AMOAMI Absorbent Mat

Amazon -

Protect the countertop underneath your coffee bar with this nonslip mat. It's super absorbed, dries quickly, and protects your counter from scuffs, spills, and scratches. It comes in a variety of colors and sizes, and also works great as a bonus drying mat for dishes.

An Inexpensive Stained Glass Window Hack

Aomkmi Stained Glass Window Film

Amazon -

Stained glass windows seem like the kind of thing that would cost a ton of money, but this genius window cling film makes it super easy and cheap to achieve the effect. All you have to do is apply the film to your window, no sticky adhesive or hardware required.

A Simple Way To Upgrade Old Furniture

JEREVER Crystal Drawer Pull Handles (4-Pack)

Amazon -

If you have old furniture that you want to give a second life, replacing the drawer pulls is a quick and inexpensive hack. These crystal pulls come with gold-toned wire accents, as well as mounting screws in two sizes. They're great for dressers and side tables, and you can also use them for cabinets.

Shelf Liners That Are Easy To Install

Amiitay Shelf and Drawer Liner

Amazon -

These nonslip shelf liners come in a big roll, so you can easily cut them to size to fit any drawers or shelves in your home. They come in seven stunning floral designs as well as different widths, and have non-adhesive backing for easy setup and removal.

A Coordinated Towel Set

Modern Threads Cotton Towel Set (6 Pieces)

Amazon -

More than 2,200 Amazon shoppers have given this set of cotton bath towels a glowing five-star rating, so you can trust that they're as high-quality as they look. "I never thought I would be writing a passionate review about bath towels, but here we are," wrote one fan. "These Modern Threads towels have completely transformed my bathroom from “just a place to dry off” into what feels like a five-star spa retreat."

Bright Lights For Your Driveway

URAGO Super Bright Solar Lights (10-Pack)

Amazon -

Illuminate your driveway or outdoor walkway with these ultra-bright outdoor lights, which can last for up to 12 hours on a single charge and cast gorgeous patterns on the ground for added effect. They're solar powered, so you don't have to plug them, in, and they come in cool and warm white tones.

A Zen-Inspired Aromatherapy Diffuser

Lifelines Stacking Stones Aromatherapy Diffuser

Amazon -

This unique aromatherapy diffuser is like having a little zen rock garden on your bedside table. Just pour water over the rocks, add your favorite essential oil, and prepare to relax. You can also adjust the lighting, and set it on a timer so it turns on and off automatically.

Cute Caps For Silicone Straws

CXLL Silicone Straw Cover (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Drinking out of your giant tumbler will be even more fun when you add these straw caps to the mix. They're made from durable silicone that's heat-resistant and easy to clean, and they come in packs of four and six so everyone in your household can have their own.

A Museum-Worthy Analog Timer

NIUASH 15 Minute Hourglass Timer

Amazon -

If you like using the Pomodoro method to get work done, prepare to be obsessed with this hourglass timer. It looks like it came straight out of a museum, and is a great way to do fifteen minute sprints without introducing yet another screen into the mix.

A Canopy That Looks Straight Out Of A Romance Novel

VETHIN Princess Bed Canopy

Amazon -

If you're someone who has always wanted a princess-style canopy bed, you're going to want to add this to your cart. This double-layered tulle canopy is absolutely stunning, and it has a unique round design that means you can use it with literally any size bed. It comes with a self adhesive hook, so you don't have to drill into the ceiling to set it up.

Silicone Molds That Make Stunning Cakes

Sakolla Silicone Cake Molds (3-Pack)

Amazon -

Want to make the kind of stunning cakes you see on social media all the time, but don't exactly have chef-worthy decorating skills? These silicone molds can be your little secret. They come in a pack of three, and each one has a different floral design so you can bake a garden of edible delights.

A Cut-Glass Apothecary Jar

Generic Glass Apothecary Jar

Amazon -

This small crystal-style glass apothecary jar has so many different uses, so you might end up wanting more than one. It's great for holding small bathroom essentials like cotton swabs or floss picks, but you can also use it for things like fancy matches or as a chic alternative to a candy dish.

A Simple, Elegant Bed Skirt

RIMELA Elastic Bed Skirt

Amazon -

If you think bed skirts are purely decorative, consider how nice it is to be able to store stuff underneath your bed without anyone seeing it. This one has a simple design that isn’t over-the-top with ruffles, and it has tons of positive ratings on Amazon.

A Crystal Bulb That Elevates Simple Light Fixtures

SHIYI LED Crystal Bulb

Amazon -

Simple light fixtures get an instant upgrade with this stunning textured glass bulb. It casts pretty designs, and has an elevated look that you won’t want to cover up with a separate lamp shade.

A Battery-Operated Glass Lamp

MJ PREMIER Battery Operated Lamp

Amazon -

This elegant colored glass lamp is battery-powered, so you can use it pretty much anywhere. It’s small enough to pop on a bookshelf or a small bedside table, and offers just the right amount of light for reading before bed without disturbing your circadian rhythm.

A Wooden Serving Board With A Hanging Loop

BILL.F Acacia Wood 12” Cutting Board

Amazon -

This cutting board is made from high-quality acacia wood with a gorgeous natural grain, and it has a paddle-shaped design that makes it great for things like cutting adn serving homemade pizza or laying our a gorgeous cheese and charcuterie board situation.

An Actual Bell For Your Front Door

YRMLYMOP Vintage Decorative Metal Doorbell

Amazon -

Modern video doorbells offer a lot of benefits, but charm isn’t one of them. This antique-style doorbell, on the other hand, has an actual physical bell for your visitors to ring, which is a fun alternative that makes your home feel like an old-school manor house—even if it’s an apartment.

A Cute Mat That Makes Bar Soap Last Longer

Aira Soap Saver Dish

Amazon -

Bar soap lasts so much longer if you take good care of it, which usually means ensuring that it has a dry place to sit when you’re not using it. This butterfly-shapedmat is super cute, and it has built-in drainage and is made from quick-drying materials to help prolong the life of your favorite fancy soap.

A Simple Storage Solution For Dish Towels

SKILLEDSLICING Kitchen Dish Towel Holder

Amazon -

This cleverly-designed towel holder can be put on the door of your fridge, the handle of your oven, or anywhere else you might want a convenient side towel. It’s made from wood and cotton fabric, and doesn’trequire any drilling or adhesive.

A Cheery Bathroom Rug

LUMI Floral Bathroom Rug

Amazon -

Brighten up your bathroom with this colorful floral rug, which is exactly the right size for stepping out of the bathtub. It has nonslip backing that keeps it from sliding around, and a thick, high-pile upper that feels amazing on bare feet.

Reversibke Kitchen Towels That Are So Absorbent

recyco Waffle Kitchen Towels (Set of 2)

Amazon -

All kitchen towels are not made alike, and these are proof. They’re made from a thick, absorbent fabric that dries quickly, and they come in a bunch of pretty reversible designs that add to your kitchen’s aesthetic.

Pretty Tissue Boxes To Keep In Your Car

Winoo Designs Car Tissues (4-Pack)

Amazon -

These genius tube-shaped tissue boxes are designed to fit in a car's cup holders, so you can put one in the center console and always had a tissue close at hand while you're driving. The tubes come in a bunch of pretty designs, and they're sold in a pack of four.

Crystal Bee Clips That Make Your Car Smell So Good

CYG&CL Decorative Air Vent Clips (2-Pack)

Amazon -

If you want your car to both look and smell amazing, you're going to love these adorable bee clips. They're covered in crystals and are kind of like jewelry for your air vents, but each one also hides space for a scented tablet that circulates good smells when you turn on the air.

Reusable Sleeves For Your Iced Coffee

Xumbtvs Reusable Iced Coffee Sleeves (Set of 3)

Amazon -

If the condensation on the outside of an iced coffee cup drives you crazy, you’ll love this three-pack of insulated sleeves. They help keep your drink colder for longer while also keeping your cup dry. They come in multiple sizes, too.

item.title: 60 Kooky Things That Are So Cool & So Cheap On Amazon
item.description: Wacky things for your home, car, and beauty routine that all have one major commonality: they boast a shockingly low price.
item.dc:creator: Veronika Kero
item.content:encoded:
Usually, you pay extra for impressive features and cool design. Below, however, you’ll find a slew of wacky things for your home, car, and beauty routine that all have one major thing in common: They boast a shockingly low price. From a talking fortune-telling pickle to the world’s cutest night-light and a set of hand-shaped mini tongs, everything is as bizarre as it is a must-have.

A Smiley Face Planter That Can Be Used Indoors & Out

UMESONG Smiley Face Planter Pot with Drainage Hole

Amazon -

Put this smiley face planter in any room that’s feeling a bit drab. Its cute expression and mini guitar will make you smile every time you walk by. It’s safe to put outdoors as well and has a pluggable drainage hole to keep roots happy.

A Fortune-Telling Pickle With Witty Answers

DR DINGUS Mystic Pickle

amazon -

This fortune-telling pickle is a weirder version of a Magic 8-Ball. Press the button and it’ll give you over 100 witty responses to your biggest questions. The snarky voice that reads them out loud is what will really get everyone laughing.

Window Privacy Film That Makes Your Home Sparkle

ADD.HERES Window Privacy Film

amazon -

This window privacy film means you won’t have to worry about curious eyes, and you can rest assured knowing that your skin and furniture are being protected from UV rays. As it blocks the sun, it will shine and cast rainbow specks around the room. It goes up with static electricity and can be trimmed for a perfect fit.

A Weighted Stuffed Animal With A Soothing Lavender Scent

OSOCU Microwavable Heating Pad

amazon -

This weighted stuffed animal will be your ultimate comfort item. It makes you feel like you’re being hugged and can even warm you up. Just put it in the microwave before your cuddle session and enjoy its subtle lavender aroma as you doze off.

A Tiny Operation Board Game That Actually Works

World's Smallest Operation Electronic Board Game

amazon -

Whether you’re stuck in traffic on a bus or waiting for your flight to take off, this mini Operation board game will be there to help pass the time. It’s small enough to fit in your pocket and provides an even bigger challenge. Test your skills with this classic.

Mini Toothbrushes That Freshen Breath Without Rinsing

cleaings Disposable Mini Toothbrush (48 Pieces)

amazon -

You don’t necessarily need a sink and water to freshen your breath. These 48 disposable toothbrushes are pre-pasted and made with both a tongue scraper and floss pick. Best of all, they can fit anywhere so that you can always have one with you.

An Animal Carabiner With A Hidden Flashlight

Sun Company WildLight Flashlight

amazon -

This carabiner flashlight is the most exciting tool you’ll ever have in your camping bag — or regular purse. It comes in the shape of almost every animal you can think of and has an LED light hidden inside the mouth of each. Batteries come included and it attaches to a sturdy carabiner.

A Fox Night-Light With A Fun Color-Changing Option

L LOHAS LED Night Light

amazon -

After plugging in this fox night-light, you won’t have to do much else. It has a dusk-to-dawn sensor that turns it on and off automatically to save electricity. Play around with its eight color options (including a color-changing mode) to have it fit in perfectly with the rest of your room.

A Solar-Powered Wind Chime That Changes Color

Zeiliuled Solar Wind Chime

amazon -

Light up your patio with something more than just your porch light. Hang this solar wind chime and let the butterflies turn your home into something out of a fairytale. They’ll gradually change color to keep things interesting all night long.

Latex Polish For Professional-Looking At-Home Manicures

Beetles Latex Polish

amazon -

Brush this latex polish around your nail bed and by the time you’re done painting, you’ll be able to strip away any excess color. It peels right off so that you can have a clean result that looks like it was done by a professional. It even comes with a scraping tool.

An LED Hat With Customizable Text

GOTUS LED Hat

amazon -

Turn yourself into a walking billboard with this LED hat that can be customized via Bluetooth. It gives you a completely unique (and fun) way to express yourself. The electronic portion is easily recharged via USB.

A Turtle String Light That’s 10 Feet Long

Holitown Turtle String Lights

amazon -

This turtle string light replaces ordinary bulbs with adorable creatures, each of which is a different color. At 10 feet long, you can cover quite a bit of wall space with a single strand — or can even wrap it around your desktop monitor or stair banister. Run it via USB or batteries and control it using the included remote.

Highlighter Pens With Multicolor Strokes

AECHY Dual Color Highlighter Pens (8-Pack)

amazon -

Your notes won’t be so boring when you begin using these eight highlighter pens that create two-toned strokes — but you can also choose to only use one color at a time by changing your angle. Either way, you’ll have crisp and quick-drying lines.

A Measuring Cup Set Cute Enough To Be Left Out

Tlence Ceramic Measuring Spoon Set (5 Pieces)

Amazon -

Even when you’re not prepping ingredients, you’ll want this chicken measuring cup set out on your counter because of how cute and compact it is. The four ceramic measuring spoons rest in the chicken-shaped lid; the chicken’s body also acts as a measuring cup.

A Frog Hand Towel That’s More Absorbent Than Regular Ones

JEROKUMI Cute Hand Towels

amazon -

This frog hand towel is not just for fun. Its soft fibers and sponge-like core work to quickly absorb moisture — it actually absorbs 30% more than a regular towel, but it’s machine washable like you’d expect. It comes in the shape of a bunch of other animals as well.

A Donut Blanket That Looks Good Enough To Eat

Bnuitland Donut Blanket

amazon -

Take your love of sweets out to your living room by adding this donut blanket to your cart. This reversible blanket is made of high-quality fleece flannel that will keep you warm — and possibly make you a bit hungry, considering how real its sprinkles look. It measures 5 feet across for plenty of cuddling.

Lots Of Mini Tongs To Keep Your Fingers Clean

Shindel Mini Tongs (8 Pieces)

amazon -

Whether you need to serve ice, pick up a cube of cheese, or want to keep your fingers free of chip residue, reach for these mini tongs. Set these eight pieces around your home so that everything is more convenient and hygienic.

A Sleek Lamp That’s Also A Candle Warmer

PoKat Candle Lamp

amazon -

This candle warmer is a two-for-one deal. As your candle sits in the base, its large shade will add a second glow to your space. Its brightness can be adjusted and it can be put on a timer, and it offers four brightness levels to choose from.

Mini Glow-In-The-Dark Animals That Cost Just 8 Cents Each

YYANMYI Luminous Mini Resin Animals (100 Pieces)

amazon -

This pack of mini glow-in-the-dark animals comes with 100 ducks, frogs, dinosaurs, and more. Each one will light up for hours after being exposed to light and can be used to add a funky collection of color to a vase, jewelry tray, or even a fish tank.

An In-Water Egg Timer That Changes Color

NobleEgg Egg Timer

amazon -

Plop this egg timer into boiling water and it will change water as your eggs go from soft to hard boiled. It’s extremely accurate and easy to track thanks to its bright purple color.

Frog Earrings That Are Super Lightweight

Caiyao Acrylic Frog Earrings

amazon -

These frog earrings certainly make a statement — but they don’t weigh down your lobes as they do. The acrylic is lightweight so that you can comfortably wear them from morning to night. They drop about 3.3 inches in length total.

A Mini Bookshelf That’s Strangely Soothing To Rearrange

Pawnoc Anxiety Bookshelf

amazon -

Rely on this mini bookshelf to give yourself some screen-free entertainment and calm your mind. It comes with 200 tiny titles and faux plants that you can rearrange as you please. When you’re all done, you can give it a shake and start over as desired.

A Chic Plant Propagation Station That Lights Up

Lightalent Plant Propagation Station

Amazon -

This wooden plant propagation station looks much more expensive than it is. The warm finish, paired with its LED lights and glass tubes make it a fabulous piece to put on display as you track the growth of the stems you place inside.

Highly Rated Wall Decor You Can Put A Hat Or Coat On

GUSFREUD Vintage Animal Hook

amazon -

This bronze animal head has a high-end golden finish with tons of tiny details, right down to the realistic-looking feathers. For under $30, the vintage-looking 13-inch-tall piece can decorate your wall and bring in a regal vibe while also doubling as a hook. It has earned a whopping 4.9-star overall rating on Amazon.

An Acorn Bluetooth Speaker With A Built-in Mic

AVWOO Mini Bluetooth Speaker

amazon -

Small enough to pop into your jacket pocket but loud enough to get the party started, this acorn Bluetooth speaker will be your new obsession. It projects crystal-clear sound and even has a built-in microphone so you can answer calls hands-free. It’ll run for up to eight hours per charge.

A Metal Venus Flytrap That’s 2 Feet Tall

Mornihima Whimsical Metal Venus Flytrap Stake

amazon -

Made with two stakes, this 2-foot-tall metal Venus flytrap is designed to withstand rain, wind, and sunshine — but it’s fun for indoors, too. The three heads will stand straight up and make your garden feel more whimsical — and perhaps a little more dangerous. Although it won’t catch any insects, it will catch everyone’s attention.

Screen Door Magnets To Cover Tears — Or Decorate

MeshMagnets Screen Door Magnets (2-Pack)

amazon -

Not only will these screen door magnets make your home entrance more beautiful — they’ll actually act as a temporary fix to tears. The gorgeous butterflies will hide any imperfections and make your screen look custom.

A Candy Machine With 3 Refillable Sections

Handy Gourmet Triple Candy Machine

amazon -

Turn your home into a mini candy factory by bringing out this candy machine. Three of your favorites can be dispensed, and since it can rotate 360 degrees, everyone around the dining room table will be able to reach the snack they have their eye on.

A Squishy Night-Light That Can Be Put On A Timer

Gemmac Squishy Lamp

amazon -

This squishy night-light is made of flexible silicone that you’ll be tempted to cuddle up with. Put it on its 30-minute timer to avoid wasting its battery after you fall asleep. You can also adjust its brightness and choose one of seven colors.

A Wooden Door Chime That Comes In The Cutest Shapes

LODDIY Magnetic Wooden Door Chime

amazon -

This wooden door chime is much more charming than any ordinary or high-tech doorbell. Its brass bowl will create a beautiful chime and your guests will fall in love with the detailed figure (available in the shape of a penguin, cat, bird, and others).

Magnetic Dog Socks That Hold Paws

COZYMATE Magnetic Dog Socks

amazon -

If you’re looking for a way to make your friends laugh, you need this pair of magnetic dog socks. The tiny paws that come together can be your new party trick or — of course — you can reserve them for lazy days at home.

A Rechargeable, Waterproof Scalp Massager For A Deep Clean

arboleaf Electric Scalp Massager Head Massager Scalp Stress Relax, 5 in 1 Kneading 128 Massage Nodes, Waterproof Hair Massage with 8 Removable Claws Cat Scratcher, Gift for Dad Mom

Amazon -

This electric scalp massager can make such a difference that after a few minutes of kneading, you may notice your tension is gone. It does an amazing job at relaxing you, and it also be used to deeply cleanse in the shower (it’s waterproof). It comes with two styles of silicone massaging heads, it can be used on your body as well, and it’s easily recharged via USB-C.

Mini Vase Magnets For Real Or Faux Plants

ZOYVUX Mini Vase Magnets (5-Pack)

amazon -

Cover your fridge with these mini vase magnets and fill them with real (tiny) flowers, dried ones, or use the included faux plants. Five come in a pack and each one measures about 1 inch tall.

A Solar-Powered Cat Statue To Spruce Up Your Garden

MININOVA Solar Garden Statue

amazon -

This solar-powered cat statue is just the thing you need to bring light and character to your garden. Measuring 10 inches tall from its toes to the tip of its tail, the kitty will greet you and make your walkway easier to navigate in any weather.

Magnetic Fidget Toys That Make A Crisp Clicking Sound

Dilabnba Rattle Snakes Magnetic Eggs (24 Pieces)

amazon -

Everything from the feel to the rainbow finish and crisp clicks of this magnetic fidget toy will satisfy your busy mind. You’ll be able to relax your thoughts as you rearrange the 24 smooth pieces. They come with a compact zippered case to keep them safe.

A Detective-Themed Puzzle Book That’ll Strengthen Your Thinking Skills

Brain Games - Sherlock Holmes Puzzles

amazon -

Live out your dreams of being a detective with this puzzle book that’s full of over 100 logical challenges. You’ll have to use all your strengths to find the answer in the complex scenarios on its 192 spiral-bound pages. An answer key is included in the back, too.

Wrapping Paper Cutters That Keep Your Fingers Safe

HMMHYY Dual Ended Wrapping Paper Cutter (2-Pack)

amazon -

When you’re trying to put together picture-perfect presents, you need these two wrapping paper cutters to do it right. They’re easier to handle than scissors, are functional on both ends, and will keep your fingers away from the blades.

A Record Player Air Freshener For Your Car With A Floral Scent

BOCACUE Record Player Air Freshener Car Vent Clip

amazon -

If you love all things vintage, you’ll love this record player air freshener that looks like the real thing — except for the fact that it’s small enough to be clipped onto your car’s air vents. Fifteen “discs” or fragrance tablets are included so your ride can smell of florals for around a year straight.

A Portable Sticker Printer That Doesn’t Require Ink

JEPEErbz Portable Mini Printer

Amazon -

You’d expect this portable sticker printer to be much more than $20, considering it comes with all the extras that you need (including eight rolls of paper) and can be used on the go. It prints in black and white so that you can customize each photo as you please with the mini markers that come along with it. It’s rechargeable and is thermal — it won’t require any annoying ink refills.

Travel Toilet Spray With Long-Lasting Scents

Poo-Pourri Before-You-Go Pocket Toilet Spray (3-Pack)

amazon -

This set of pocket-sized travel toilet spray comes with three different scents to fill your bathroom — or any bathroom you end up in. The person that goes in after you will be pleasantly surprised, especially since the lavender, citrus, and hibiscus scents all last long. Each bottle can be used up to 50 times.

A “Fireplace” Wax Melter With A Cozy Vibe

YSong Fireplace Wax Melt Warmer

amazon -

With a cozy fireplace vibe, this fireplace wax melter features “logs” that look like they’re really burning as the electric gadget warms the cubes that you place on top. Fragrance will fill the room, along with light.

A Guitar Pick Punch Kit That Comes With A Storage Key Chain

ArtAt Guitar Pick Punch Ki

amazon -

Why use boring picks when you can make your very own with the help of this guitar pick punch kit? It comes with 15 colorful strips of plastic; you can also cut through old gift cards or any other piece of plastic to create a new tool. Tuck them all in the faux leather key chain that comes included.

A Vibrating Alarm Clock That Can Also Charge Your Phone

ANJANK Extra Loud Vibrating Alarm Clock

amazon -

This vibrating alarm clock comes with a wireless piece to keep in bed with you. It’ll shake as your alarm rings — so you not only hear it but feel it as well. You can also switch its color and sound to something that will start your day off on the right foot.

Smiley Cooking Spoons That Cost Less Than $4 Each

HANSGO Wooden Cooking Spoons (5-Pack)

amazon -

Even when you’re tired after a long day, these wooden cooking spoons will put a matching smile on your face. The five wooden tools are great to use with nonstick cookware and are the perfect length to keep your hands a safe distance from the heat.

3D Sand Art That Looks Different Every Time You Move It

SOFLIY 3D Dynamic Sand Art

amazon -

You’ll never get bored of this 3D sand art — it will look different every time you invert it. It’s the perfect thing to decorate your desk while keeping things professional or to add whimsical color and a calming visual to your bedside table. The disc measures 1 foot across for impact.

A Tic-Tac-Toe Toilet Paper Holder You Can Actually Play

DAOYOUSKY Tic Tac Toe Toilet Paper Holder

amazon -

Turn a simple game into a life-size display with this tic tac toe toilet paper holder. The X-shaped pieces can be moved so you can actually play a round if you wanted to. The wooden shelves make something you’d typically try to hide the most interesting part of your bathroom.

A Frog Door Stopper Made Of Sturdy Cast Iron

Sumnacon Cast Iron Door Stop

amazon -

Unlike other models made of wood or plastic, this frog door stopper won’t budge. It’s made of solid cast iron that will keep even the heaviest of doors from slamming. Feel free to place the yoga-loving frog outside as well — or on top of your desk as a paperweight.

Velvet Refrigerator Handle Covers That Prevent Fingerprints

Volecy Refrigerator Handle Covers (6-Pack)

amazon -

Keep your stainless steel appliances looking truly stainless with the help of these refrigerator handle covers. They come in a pack of six so that you can protect everything from your air fryer to your microwave from fingerprints and smudges. The luxe velvet material is machine washable as needed.

A Dog-Shaped Pizza Cutter That Keeps Counters Clean

Peleg Design Puperoni Cute Pizza Cutter Wheel

amazon -

You’ll slice through dough like a pro when you have this dog-shaped pizza cutter in hand. Its ergonomic body gives you a secure grip as you use the stainless steel blade to create even slices — it also works well on sandwiches, quesadillas, and more. It’s dishwasher safe and keeps the blade (and counters) clean by elevating it.

A Stitching Tool For Fast Fixes Without Sewing Knowledge Required

Scopck Stitch Tool

amazon -

You won’t need to take your overly long pants and loose shirts in for professional alterations when you have this stitching tool around. Use the handheld tool and the 2,000 fasteners that come included to make improvements at home in just seconds. An instruction manual comes with to make the process easy.

Stained Glass Butterflies To Decorate Flower Pots

EMINGSKY Butterfly Flower Pot Decorations (3-Pack)

amazon -

Even on cold days, your planters will look like they’re a busy meeting spot for butterflies thanks to these butterfly flower pot ornaments. As the three pieces hang from the edge, their stained glass wings will catch the sunlight. Each one measures almost 4 inches long.

A Dinosaur Skeleton Costume That’s Surprisingly Soft

Generic Dinosaur Skeleton Costume

amazon -

This 4-foot-long dinosaur skeleton costume may look like realistic bones, but it’s actually super soft and comfortable to wear — like a stuffed animal. It comes in a few sizes (and several colors) for a perfect fit for that next Zoom call.

A Lime Wedge Ice Mold That Melts Slowly

Tovolo Lime Wedge Ice Mold

amazon -

This lime wedge ice mold is genius not just because it makes your homemade cocktails look cooler but because it makes them taste better, too. The extra-large cube that it creates melts slowly to prevent diluting. Two dishwasher-safe molds come included.

Hair Tinsel That Takes Seconds To Clip In

Colorful Glitter Tinsel Hair Extensions

Amazon -

Switching up your look takes only seconds if you’re planning on using this highly rated hair tinsel as your star accessory. Strands can be clipped into place and their glitter will be seen from across the room. They come with 12 pieces that measure 20 inches long (trim them to match your hair if desired.)

A Bamboo Toilet Stool That Folds Up For Storage

JLKCTHH Foldable Bamboo Toilet Stool

amazon -

This bamboo toilet stool folds flat between uses, making it easy to store in any bathroom. It supports colon health and makes everything easier so that you can get back to your day in record time. Plus, the adorable panda face is one you won’t mind having out on display. 

A Duck Umbrella That Holds Up In The Wind

LEAGERA Duck Umbrella

amazon -

This duck umbrella may look cute and delicate, but it’s unbelievably strong thanks to its sturdy frame. Even in harsh winds, it’ll keep you covered. And since it comes in fun color combinations, you’re less likely to walk right past it and leave it behind.

Low-Priced Cat Pushpins To Add Color To A Corkboard

LLHDKF Cute Cat Push Pins (30-Piece)

Amazon -

Nothing — except these cat pushpins — costs a quarter these days. Fortunately, you can grab this entire 30-pack of thumb tacks for under $8 and use them to brighten corkboards, cubicle walls, and more.

An Oil & Vinegar Cruet Shaped Like A Skull

OTOTO Glass Oil and Vinegar Cruet

amazon -

This skull-shaped oil and vinegar cruet is cool enough to be kept out year-round. Fill it with your favorites to save space and keep them out on the table without crowding the surface with unaesthetic bottles.

A Light-Up Headband That Can Flash

CAKURE Light Up Headband

amazon -

You’ll feel like something in between a rockstar and a princess when wearing this light-up headband. It can flash or remain steady as you wear it to your next concert or incorporate it into your going-out outfit.

Swaying Garden Lights That Look Like Fireflies

DooYard Solar Swaying Firefly Garden Light (2-Pack)

amazon -

To go back to those magical nights of your childhood when you would chase fireflies, add this two-pack of swaying garden lights to your Amazon cart. As they glow and move in the wind, they’ll look like the magical insects and bring your yard to life.

item.title: 75 Kooky New Gifts On Amazon That We're Loving Right Now
item.description: Amazon is a treasure trove of the world’s weirdest new products. To deliver weird without wasting time, these strange new things are totally brilliant too.
item.dc:creator: Carina Finn, and ,BDG Commerce
item.content:encoded:
The holidays can get repetitive, and sometimes a person really doesn't need another pair of cozy socks. That's why weird gifts can often be the best ones. These awesome new gifts are all available on Amazon, so you don't have to deal with shipping cutoffs, and they're all the perfect blend of joy-inducing and inexpensive. They might not be practical (though some of them are), but that's because it's alright to let yourself have fun with gift-giving. So go ahead and add those novelty earrings and a teensy record player to your cart, because you know exactly who's going to be obsessed with them.

A Night Light That Brings The Great Outdoors Inside

PetiitLyt Campfire Night Light

Amazon -

Whether you have a little one who loves the idea of sleeping outside or know someone who makes their annual camping trip their entire personality, there's probably someone on your list who will love this night light. It comes in multiple sizes, both with a legit stone base, and makes a realistic crackling sound that can be turned on or off.

A Pair Of Single-Serving Ice Cream Makers

DASH My Mug Ice Cream Maker Machine (Aqua): Multi-Purpose Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine with (2) Bowls for Homemade Gelato, Sorbet, Frozen Yogurt, Built-In Ingredient Chute, Easy to Clean and Store

Amazon -

"I love this ice cream maker! It’s fast and not a big bulky thing that takes up a bunch of freezer space," wrote one fan of these ice cream maker mugs. They have a one-touch churn function, can be used with a variety of recipes, and make ice cream in just 25 minutes.

A Stuffed Animal That Doubles As A Heading Pad

Happy Fuel Microwavable Weighted Stuffed Animal

Amazon -

This cuddly stuffed animal is an excellent gift idea for people of all ages, since it comes with a removable insert that can be popped in the microwave to help relieve aches and pains. The insert is filled with clay beads, and you can add your favorite essential oil.

A Tiny Record Player That Really Plays

MGA's Miniverse Real Music Record Player

Amazon -

This little record player isn't just a toy, it actually plays music once you have a few of the matching mini records. The set comes with a tiny playable vinyl to get your collection started, and you can keep finding new favorites by purchasing additional blind boxes.

Coffee-Scented Gel Pens That Make Note-Taking More Fun

Scentco Coffee-Scented Gel Pens (6-Pack)

amazon -

These gel pens are all scented like a different coffee drink, including mocha, caramel macchiao, and French vanilla. That makes them a fun little upgrade for journaling, office notes, or doodling when plain pens feel too boring. The coffee scents are designed to last for up to two years, so they are not just a one-week novelty.

A Table Lamp For Cat Lovers

Dlfghos Cat Candle Holder

amazon -

This cat statue has a lantern on its tail that offers a gorgeous soft, warm light anywhere you need it. Since it uses your own regular or flameless candles, you don't have to worry about placing it near an outlet or remembering to recharge it, which is a nice bonus.

An Elephant Mug With A Secret Compartment

HAPPINESS APPLY HERE Elephant Tea Mug

Amazon -

Tea drinkers will delight in this pretty ceramic mug not just because it's adorable (even though it obviously is), but because it solves the perpetual problem of finding a place to put your tea bag when it's done steeping. The elephant's head has a secret compartment just for this purpose, which will make it a new favorite.

A Slim Cardholder Wallet That Helps Protect Your Info

Jogjam Slim Wallet

amazon -

Slender enough to slip into a front pocket, this floral black cat cardholder packs in eight RFID-blocking card slots, a clear ID window, a cash compartment, a zippered coin pocket, and two exterior quick-access slots — all without any bulk. The attached metal keyring means you can clip your keys directly on it, keeping everything in one place rather than scattered at the bottom of a bag.

Earrings That Are So Cute, It’s Okay If They Bite

choice of all Animal Bite Earrings (6 Pairs)

Amazon -

These adorable animal-shaped earrings look like they're taking a little chomp out of your ear, which is fine because they are so freaking cute. They come in a pack of six, and fans on Amazon say they get tons of compliments when they wear them.

An Anti-Anxiety Bookshelf Toy

WifePro Anxiety Bookshelf

Amazon -

If you know someone who finds their center in the middle of a giant organizing project, they'll love this mini bookshelf toy. It's just as effective for calming the mind, but doesn't require turning their actual house upside down. The bookcase comes in five colors, and is made from durable solid wood.

A Game For People Who Would Be Horrible Therapists

Exploding Kittens Horrible Therapist: Extra Horrible Edition Card Game

Amazon -

This hilarious card game from the makers of Exploding Kittens is perfect for playing after a dinner party or before heading out for drinks. It's designed for groups of three to eight players, and lets you create comics that will make you laugh so hard you cry—no drawing skills required.

A Set Of Sweet Travel Cases

Juvale Macaron Pill Case (16-Pack)

Amazon -

These macaron-shaped mini travel cases are surprisingly useful, and they can even be used to gift-wrap smaller gifts like jewelry if you want to amp up the surprise factor. They're sold in a pack of 16, and also make great pill cases.

A Pair of Wacky Knit Socks

Linzhouzhiguang Crocodile Shape Socks

Amazon -

Know someone who loves novelty socks? Add to their collection with these bizarre crocodile socks. They make it look like you're legs are being gobbled up, and they also come in a silly pink fish style. "They make a wonderful small Christmas gift that is both fun and practical," wrote one fan on Amazon.

A Mini Bow And Arrow Set That Really Works

TIETHEKNOT Hand Archery Bow Set

amazon -

This pocket-sized archery set lets you get in some target practice without the time or expense of going to a range or investing in a ton of special equipment. It comes with a set of arrows that are sharp enough to pierce things like paper, wood, and empty cans, so you don’t need to buy a separate set of specialty targets.

A Meditative Art Set That Helps You Reach Flow State

Lifelines FlowArt Activity Pad, 2-Pack - Guided Dot Art Meditations with Markers - Dot-by-Letter, Botanicals & Landscapes - Color by Number/Letter Coloring Books for Teens, Adults & Seniors

Amazon -

If there's someone on your list who is into coloring books, these dot coloring books will be a fun way to change up their artistic practice. Each pocket-sized book comes with tons of guided dot coloring pages that can help calm and anxious mind and help you find your flow state.

A 3D Puzzle For People Who Like To Play On Hard Mode

Bgraamiens Hard 3-D Puzzle

Amazon -

Some puzzle lovers want an easy win, but others are in it purely for the challenge. If you know someone who falls into the latter group, they'll love this ultra-hard 3D puzzle. The optical illusion style makes it especially difficult to complete, and it's pretty enough to hang on the wall once you do.

A Pocket-Sized Version Of A Classic Arcade Game

Tiny Arcade Atari 2600

Amazon -

This miniature Atari system has all the functionality of a full-sized machine in a pocket-sized package that you can play on the go. It's a great alternative to playing games or scrolling on your phone, and it makes super satisfying retro arcade game sounds, too.

A Salt Stone That Makes Your Shower More Relaxing

UMAID Himalayan Bath Salt Buddy™ 2 lb, Hanging Salt Rock for Shower & Bath, Solid Himalayan Stone for Relaxation, Spa Soaks & Steam Sessions, Unique Valentine’s Day Gift for Men, Women & Couples

Amazon -

You've probably heard of Himalayan salt diffusers, but did you know you can hang a salt stone in your shower to create the same soothing, therapeutic effects. This two-pound salt stone can be hung from your showerhead to infuse the steam with salt air, and you can also dunk it in your bath for a mineral-rich soak.

A Heart-Shaped Bundt Pan You Can Use Year-Round

Nordic Ware Wildflower Heart Bundt

Amazon -

This gorgeous bundt pan has a nonstick interior, so you can be sure your design will come out perfect every time. The cake pan itself is heart-shaped with a pretty wildflower pattern on the top that's not only great for the holiday table, but can be used throughout the year for everything from boxed mix to special occasion bakes.

A Mini Baking Project That Won’t Destroy Your Kitchen

MGA's Miniverse Make It Mini from Scratch Series 2 (2-Pack)

Amazon -

Baking can be deeply therapeutic and so satisfying, but it also often makes a mess that you have to clean up afterwards—which kind of cancels out the relaxation part. This mini baking set gives you all the vibes of making a cake, but you won't have a disaster in the kitchen at the end.

A Cozy Tea Light Holder That Comes With A Buddy

Teppellze Cat Candle Holder

Amazon -

"This is so cute!! Such a happy little cat!" wrote one shopper who bought this tea light holder as a gift. The design makes it look like the cat is warming itself by the fire, so anyone who loves cats, candles, or cozy vibes will love it.

A Mini Otter Diorama In A Convenient Travel Tin

JULEASEL Pocket Otter Tin (4 Pieces)

Amazon -

This little pocket otter set gives you a resin otter, a tiny pond scene, and miniature accessories all packed into a small travel-friendly tin, so it works as part collectible, part travel game. It’s fun for display, imaginative play, or just keeping on a desk. There are several other animal varieties available to collect, as well.

A Countertop Candy Machine You Can Fill With Anything

Handy Gourmet Original Triple Candy Machine

Amazon -

This genius countertop candy dispenser has two separate compartments, so you can get super creative with it. Fill it with two complimentary candies like M&Ms and peanuts to make a custom snack mix on the go, or pop in some cereal and granola to make your morning routine even easier.

Copper Statues That Clean Your Bird Bath

Otoolling Mini Turtle Copper Bath Disk Ornaments (4-Pack)

Amazon -

These cute copper turtles don't just add flair to your bird bath or outdoor water fountain, they also help to keep the water clean. They're made from 75% genuine copper, are fully weatherproof so you can leave them out all year, and clean your water without chemicals.

Soda Can Lids That Keep Flies Out & Fizz In

Hoimoto Silicone Soda Can Lids (6-Pack)

Amazon -

Nothing ruins a cold, fizzy drink faster than a fruit fly or a spill, but these can lids help keep everything secure and protected. Not to mention, they can also help lock in carbonation for a few hours, so you can sip slowly instead of gulping it all down before your drink goes flat. Made from silicone, they’re dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.

A Swinging Owl Planter With Serious Storybook Energy

Saysmile Swinging Owl Hanging Planter

Amazon -

This hanging planter is designed to hold small plants in a mother-and-baby-owl design. Made from resin, it includes a drainage hole plus a removable stopper, so it is not just cute — it is actually built to house succulents or trailing plants properly. It gives you a sweet way to add greenery without defaulting to a plain pot.

A Journal-Friendly Marker Set With 18 Colors & Designs

AECHY Curve Highlighter Pen Set (18-Pack)

Amazon -

This 18-piece pen set is built for people who want their notes, planners, and journal pages to look much more interesting than standard straight-line highlighters allow. Each marker has a fine tip on one end and a special curve roller tip on the other, so you can write normally and then add decorative borders, underlines, and shapes with a single pen. With 18 colors and 18 different line styles in the set, you get so many options to choose from.

Tiny Resin Cats That Add Personality To Your Dashboard

Kiofs Cat Dashboard Decorations (5-Pack)

Amazon -

These mini resin cat figurines are made to perch on dashboards, rearview mirror areas, desks, shelves, or windowsills and add a little personality without taking up real space. The set includes a variety of poses — sitting, climbing, hanging, and lounging — along with adhesive tabs for easy placement.

A Night-Light That Casts Out The Coolest Light Patterns

Briignite Night Light

Amazon -

Plug this night-light into a regular outlet, and it’ll project the coolest intricate light patterns both upwards and downwards. It glows a warm white hue, and the brightness level is adjustable as you see fit. The built-in dusk-to-dawn sensor turns it on and off automatically.

Electric shoe heaters that dry wet boots

KOODER Boot Dryer

Amazon -

Wet shoes are so frustrating to deal with, but these slide-in heaters have you covered. Each one is designed to provide 360 degree heat to speed up drying for sneakers and boots. The temperature control is designed to prevent overheating, and the plug is made with short-circuit protection.

Pretty Tumbler Glasses That Stack Into A Space-Saving Fish Shape

MDLUU Fish Design Tumbler Glasses (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Guests will love sipping beverages at your house when you pull out these tumbler glasses. They stack into a fun fish design that’s compact for easy storage, and then separate into four individual glasses. Each one has a unique fish-inspired design, so your guests won’t get their cup confused with someone else’s.

This Oddly Satisfying Hair Pulling Toy

L&L LEOLUCAS Polka Fun Hair Pulling Fidget Toy

Amazon -

You’ve heard of fidget rings — but have you heard of hair pulling toys? This weird-but-brilliant little toy allows you to pull out its teeny tiny hairs in an aim to help soothe anxiety and reduce trichotillomania-related compulsions. It’s also just plain fun, for both adults and kids.

Solar-Powered Sunflower Pathway Lights

Meagoo Solar Sunflower Lights (2-Pack)

Amazon -

Why settle for boring pathway lights when these solar-powered sunflower lights exist? They come in a pair and can be stuck in the ground on the included stakes. When fully charged via sunlight, the flowers can glow for up to 15 hours overnight. They operate automatically, turning on at dusk and off at dawn.

Toilet Bowl Stamps That Clean With Every Flush — For Weeks At A Time

Simple Life Toilet Bowl Cleaner Gel | Fresh Flower Toilet Gel Stamp | Stops Limescale and Stains with Air Freshening Scent | Deodorizing Clean | 32 Stamps, Blue & Green

Amazon -

Keep your toilets clean — all day, every day — with this genius automatic toilet bowl stamper set. There are 32 stamps in each of the four tubes (for 128 in total), and they’ll stick for up to two weeks each, cleansing and deodorizing with each flush.

A Portable Lamp That Looks Like A Little Bird

YM Dragon Bird Lamp

Amazon -

This light-up bird functions just like a table lamp, but as it’s USB rechargeable and totally cordless, you can move it anywhere with ease. It has three brightness settings and comes in two different colors: maple and red.

A Rubber Shower Steamer Holder That Makes Tablets Last Longer

SHARLOVY Shower Steamers Tray

amazon -

Stick your favorite shower steamer into this rubber tray to make it last way longer — the knob allows you to have better control over the water that reaches it. The tray hangs on your shower floor or walls using a large, sturdy suction cup, and the drainage holes help catch tablet inclusions like petals.

A Microwave Cover With A Steamer To Keep Food From Drying Out

NUTIKAS Microwave Splatter Cover with Water Steamer

Amazon -

Place this cover over the top of your plates before warming them up in the microwave — a unique water reservoir incorporates steam to keep your food from drying out, and the whole thing will contain any splatter. Plus, its integrated reinforced handle is heat-resistant, giving you a safe place to get a good grip.

A Mini Makeup Bag With A Rechargeable LED Mirror

Relavel Mini Makeup Bag

Amazon -

What sets this makeup bag apart from the rest is its clever LED mirror, which makes touch-ups on the go so much easier. Crafted from high-quality PU leather, this bag has a waterproof bottom and recharges easily using a USB-C port. You can grab it in one of three colors.

Light-Up Scrunchies That Are Undeniably Fun

POZILAN LED Scrunchies (8-Pack)

Amazon -

How cool are these light-up scrunchies? By day they look like pastel hair ties, but hide LED bulbs inside that transform them into glowing tie-dyed accessories. You can even program them to three different flashing patterns.

A Snail Vent Clip That Freshens Your Car

ORIESSE Snail Air Freshener Vent Clip

Amazon -

Freshen your car in the cutest way with this snail-shaped vent clip. Designed to clamp onto most standard car air vents, the attachment is made from a real conch shell and comes with scented tablets that release floral fragrance throughout your vehicle. You can also add your own essential oils to the pads for a customized scent.

A Soft Pillow That Looks Like Your Fave Snack Cracker

Snack Plushies Cheese Cracker Plush Pillow

Amazon -

Shaped and styled like your favorite cheese-flavored cracker, this 10-by-10-inch snack plush is the kind of absurd-yet-awesome pick that brightens up your space and sparks conversation from guests. It’s made to be velvety-soft and stuffed squeezably full for solid cuddle sessions.

A Dainty Necklace With A Stone That’s Calming To Rub

B BBPM Worry Stone Necklace

Amazon -

Yes, this gold-plated necklace is a pretty addition to any look. However, it’s more than just that — in moments you’re seeking calm, hold the stone between your index finger and thumb and rub the surface. Reviewers confirm it makes a big difference.

A Plush Hand Towel With A Fun Animal Shape

Generic Chenille Towel Ball

Amazon -

This chenille hand towel is made to hang by the sink and dry hands quickly, but it also looks like a plush little animal for added visual interest. The soft chenille texture is designed to be absorbent for everyday use, and since it’s machine washable, it’s also easy to keep clean.

A Roomy Insulated Lunch Tote That Can Keep Food Hot Or Cold Up To 6 Hours

Goodies Lab Insulated Lunch Tote

Amazon -

Crafted from premium vegan leather, this insulated lunch tote can be carried two ways. With tons of storage inside, it keeps temperatures hot or cold for up to six hours. The design is also leakproof, helping ensure your lunch looks the way it did after leaving the house. Since it’s stain-proof, it’ll always look good.

A Zen Bell To Alert You When A Door Or Window Is Opened

Cizenal Shopkeepers Bell

Amazon -

Hang this circular bell on any spot that you want to get alerted when it’s opened ... like a door, window, fridge, etc. The body is made from high-quality aluminum with a brass bell that emits a lovely, zen ringing sound. Double-sided tape is included for installation.

This Ultra-Bright Flashlight About The Size Of An AirPod

Blukar Rechargeable Flashlight

amazon -

This tiny but powerful keychain flashlight packs a bright 360-lumen beam into a little 2.61-inch body, lighting up to over 157 feet ahead. Suitable for everyday use, outdoor adventures, or emergencies, it’s USB-C rechargeable in just an hour. Tough, waterproof, and so lightweight, it also offers three brightness levels to choose from.

A Clever Book Pillow Stand For Cozy, Hands-Free Reading

Viozon Lap Book Pillow Stand

Amazon -

Make book breaks a little cozier with this clever pillow stand that can hold your current read. It includes premium foam beads that can comfortably mold to your lap, and includes a built-in storage compartment to house all of your essentials. Two clamps help you keep your place, even for thicker novels, and make it perfect for a hands-free reading experience.

A Tiny Wooden Door To Cover An Outlet Or Add Whimsy

MaxForJoys Self-Adhesive Outlet Cove

Amazon -

This tiny door works as an outlet cover or playful decorative detail, and is handcrafted from paulownia wood with a rustic finish. It sticks over a standard wall plate with traceless adhesive and turns an otherwise boring fixture into warm and adorable decor. No tools or damage to the wall are required, and it opens cleanly whenever you need access to the outlet.

A Retractable Box Cutter Shaped Like A Cat Paw

Generic Cat Paw Box Cutter

Amazon -

Shaped like a cat paw with a sharp, retractable blade you can click in and out with one hand, this box cutter brings some personality to the otherwise tedious task of opening or breaking down packages. It’s sturdy enough for everyday use and small enough to toss in a drawer or bag.

Cute Lidded Containers That Keep Tiny Essentials Together

Kigley Hair Tie Containers (4 Pieces)

Amazon -

A container set like this is useful because it gives all the small essentials an actual home. Each box has a lid and a compact footprint, perfect for storing elastics, cotton swabs, clips, jewelry, or other random little items that tend to get scattered fast. Since there are four containers included, you can split them between a bathroom, purse, work bag, or travel kit pretty easily.

A Heated Eyelash Curler For A Natural-Looking Lift

DUDUDU Heated Eyelash Curler

Amazon -

This heated eyelash curler is designed to warm up in about 10 seconds and help shape lashes quickly for a natural-looking lift. It’s made for all lash styles, and it has two adjustable temperature settings. You can charge it with a USB-C cable, and it’s compact enough to fit easily in a purse or travel makeup bag.

Shimmery Vanilla Lip Balm That Changes Color To Your pH

Winky Lux Color Changing Lip Balm

Amazon -

Infused with jojoba oil and scented with vanilla, this pH-activated lip balm reacts to your unique chemistry to create a custom shade of pink with subtle shimmer. The formula is vegan and cruelty-free, delivering a hydrated, cushiony feel without sketchy ingredients that can be found in lesser tinted balms.

An Under-Eye Patch That Hydrates With Retinol & Hyaluronic Acid

RoC Retinol Correxion Deep Wrinkle Non-Invasive Targeted Patches

Amazon -

Not only are these under-eye patches a really nice self-care moment, but they also deliver powerful hydration thanks to their hyaluronic acid-, peptides-, and retinol-rich formula. These go on easy and come in a pack of six, so you’ll have a pair for nearly every day of the week.

Colorful Metal Flowers That Make Tiny Bee & Butterfly Baths

Retyion Bee Watering Stations (4-Pack)

Amazon -

Designed to look like flowers blooming, these bee watering stations give pollinators a safe, shallow place to drink without the risk of drowning that comes with deeper water sources. Made of metal painted with high-temperature-resistant paint, these hold up through rain and sun without fading.

A Sticky Note Holder With Genius List Templates Included

JUMYGEAR Sticky Note Stencil & Holder

Amazon -

Lowkey genius, this sticky note holder comes with five stencils for easily creating to-do lists, checklists, weekly plans, and more — satisfying for anyone who wants their notes to look ultra-organized. A starter pack of sticky notes is included so it’s ready to use straight out of the box.

A Weighted Sloth Plush That Warms Up For Soothing Heat Therapy

Mewaii Weighted Stuffed Animal

Amazon -

This 4-pound weighted sloth plush is soft and soothing to cuddle — and the whole thing is microwave-safe for easy heat therapy. The natural ceramic bead filling helps retain heat longer than flaxseed or rice, and stays evenly distributed throughout the little sloth for a balanced, huggable weight.

An Candle That Looks & Smells Just Like An Espresso Martini

SILEAGEO Espresso Martini

Amazon -

Enjoy the delicious scent of an espresso martini at any point — and without even taking a trip to the bar — with this unique candle that also looks like one. It’s made from soy wax with a cotton wick that’ll burn cleanly for a while.

Colorful Spheres That Glow Beautifully In A Wooden Base

KRISININE Healing Spheres

Amazon -

Place these colorful, cracked spheres into the included wooden base — the built-in LEDs cast a soft, ambient glow, highlighting their texture. It’s incredibly calming to look at, whether you place it in your living room, bedroom, office, or somewhere else.

A 12-Pack Of Hair Clips That Look Like Caterpillars Crawling On Your Head

JINBUYAO Caterpillar Hair Clips (12-Pack)

Amazon -

Whether you’re a nature lover or just like to get a little weird, these caterpillar hair clips make a head-turning statement. The set includes 12 surprisingly realistic creatures in different sizes and colors. Wear them all at once for a caterpillar convention atop your head or choose just one to keep things (sort of) subtle.

A tiny Glo Worm That Lights Up When You Squeeze It

Worlds Smallest Glo Worm

Amazon -

You can never have too many cute companions, so go ahead and invite this little Glo Worm to come home with you. Inspired by the classic 1980s toy, this tiny version is complete with a plush body, cute face, and sleeping cap. Give him a squeeze to light him up and make him glow.

Adjustable Kettlebells That Take Up Hardly Any Room

TopMade Adjustable Kettlebell Weights Set

Amazon -

If you don’t have a ton of room to store your workout equipment, you need this stackable kettlebell set. The compact set allows you to choose from 5-, 8-, 9-, and 12-pound kettlebells, and the thick vinyl coating is designed to protect your floor and reduce noise. You can get the weights in three colors.

This Teeny-Tiny Pocket Knife For Opening Boxes & Letters

Eastern Delights Mini Pocket Knife

Amazon -

Thumb-sized and complete with a tiny metal case, this mini pocket knife is made to function as a letter opener, box cutter, and handy everyday carry item. The shell handle options give it a surprisingly refined look, and the included key ring makes it easy to keep on hand.

A Bougie Handmade Soup Bowl That’s Dishwasher Safe

ALMA Microwavable Soup Bowl with Handle

Amazon -

Handcrafted by artisans from pure white clay, this ceramic soup mug has the kind of weight and texture that makes even a weeknight bowl of chili feel considered. Safe for the microwave, oven, freezer, and dishwasher, it works just as well for ice cream or cereal as it does for soup or stew.

Cute Charms That Secretly Protect Your Device’s Charging Ports

sunla E-Reader Dust Plug Charms (4 Pieces)

amazon -

This set of four decorative dust plugs — two pink bows, a lily of the valley, and a peach — snap into any USB-C port to keep out lint and debris while adding unexpected cute detail to your phone or Kindle. You can also choose from tiny coffee, dessert, or even kitty options.

A Clever Lamp Made To Slip Into Your Bookshelf

AELS Wood Bookshelf Lamp

Amazon -

This solid wood bookend lamp does double duty keeping books upright while casting soft ambient light from its linen shade. Cordless and USB-C rechargeable, it runs for four to six hours per charge and can be placed anywhere without hunting for an outlet. A tap turns it on and a long press dims it from a barely-there glow to full brightness.

The Cutest Bookends That Come In 3 Styles

JARPSIRY Duck Decorative Bookends (1 Pair)

Amazon -

Make your bookshelves or desk a little cuter with this pair of duck bookends. They have nonslip feet on the bottom and come in a yellow version (as well as a pair of elephants) in the listing.

Waterproof Lights To Create A More Zen Bathroom

Bgmonster Waterproof Shower Lights (2-Pack)

Amazon -

You deserve some rest and relaxation after a long day, and these waterproof lights turn your bathroom into a true oasis. They can be set to 15 colors and two dynamic lighting modes (using the included remote control) to create the perfect atmosphere. And there’s even a handy timer function for auto-off after a certain duration.

A Budget Binder That Makes Tracking Expenses Easy

SKYDUE Budget Binder

Amazon -

Keep better track of your savings with this budget binder. It comes with places to store credit cards, budget sheets, and cash envelopes, as well as labels for marking which money is for emergencies, personal expenses, food, and more. Choose from over 15 stylish binder designs.

A Fluffy Reading Pillow With A Cute Cartoon Design

UNWAAT Campfire Reading Pillow

amazon -

This plush reading pillow has the cutest cartoon campfire design. It’s stuffed with fluffy filling, and the side zipper lets you take some out to adjust the support level. It’s made from soft, skin-friendly fabric and can be placed in a chair, on a bed, and more.

A Mini Reusable Notebook That You Can Scan Straight To Your Phone

Rocketbook Mini Reusable Smart Notepad

Amazon -

This reusable notebook is app compatible, so you can scan and upload your notes directly to your phone. It comes with a pen, and you can wipe the pages clean and start over when you’re done with that day’s to-do list. At just 3.5-by-5.5 inches, the notebook is easy to toss into a purse or stuff in a pocket.

Genius Scissors That Fold Up For Safer Storage

YVAOG Folding Scissors (2-Pack)

amazon -

Lightweight and compact, these folding scissors are made of sturdy stainless steel and zinc alloy. Ideal for cutting paper, fabric, thread, cardboard, and even hair, they fold up to hide the blades when not in use, making them safer to stash in a bag, drawer, or even on a keychain.

Gel Masks That Hydrate Your Lips

LOOPS Weekly Reset Hydrogel Lip Mask (5-Pack)

Amazon -

Give your lips a little TLC with this five-pack of hydrogel masks. The aloe and jojoba formula is dermatologist-approved and designed to leave your lips feeling cool and refreshed. The gel is made to help the ingredients penetrate deeply for lasting hydration.

An Adorable Hand-Painted Mug With Space For A Straw

JMCRATE Ceramic Coffee Mug

amazon -

The divided top of this adorably striped ceramic mug keeps a straw or spoon a dedicated home so it won’t slide around the mug so you have to chase it down. And, the green and white striped pattern is cheerful enough to make it a standout on any desk or kitchen shelf.

Tiny Decorations That Add Whimsy To Your Door Hinges

Wallertree Mushroom Hinge Heads (6-Pack)

Amazon -

These decorative door hinge toppers add a playful touch to a spot that’s almost always overlooked, adding an unexpected bit of personality. Built with magnetic bases, they can stick to metal surfaces like cabinets, shelves, or frames, letting you move and display them wherever you’d like a pop of fun.

An Odd Toast-Shaped Seat Cushion That’s Actually So Comfy

lumogeva Toast Seat Cushion

Amazon -

This toast seat cushion is oddly hilarious and yet, actually really comfortable to sit on ... it makes your office chair, couch, vehicle seat, or another similar spot way better. The cushion has a plush filling, and the exterior is made from smooth and soft velvet.

item.title: How Are These 55 Bougie Home Upgrades So Damn Cheap On Amazon?
item.description: Ready to give your space a glow-up without the sticker shock? Check out our picks for achieving luxe vibes with little cash.
item.dc:creator: Debbie Lee
item.content:encoded:
Your home doesn’t need an expensive renovation to feel refreshed. Often, tiny details make all the difference — a simple sliding rod for your closet, a soap dispenser to replace the original plastic pump bottle, or a night-light that looks like a fancy sconce rather than a kid’s toy. Ready to give your space a glow-up without the sticker shock? Check out the Bustle shopping editor’s picks for achieving luxe vibes with little cash.

A Protective Couch Cover That’s Plush & Pet-Friendly

ZQFFB Pet Couch Cover

Amazon -

You don’t have to choose between having a pet and having nice things with this couch cover. It's durable enough to stand up to claws and paws, but it’s still ultra-plush and stylish enough to make your sofa look (and feel) great. A nonslip bottom grips your cushions so it doesn't slide, and when it needs cleaning, you can toss it in the washing machine and run the gentle cycle.

A Clever Doorbell Chime Cover That Looks Like Elegant Wall Decor

GRAUES Doorbell Cover

amazon -

This decorative wooden cover turns your doorbell chime box into a design opportunity. The intricate scrollwork pattern is far more interesting than a yellowed plastic box, and you can even paint it to match your wall color. It slips right over most standard chimes and comes with screws to secure it in place.

Wood Grain-Style Trim That Makes Plain Mirrors Look Fancy

DESOMINOR Peel & Stick Wood Grain Wallpaper Border

Amazon -

This trim couldn’t be an easier way to upgrade built-in, frameless, builder-grade mirrors. Just cut it to size and peel-and-stick the strips to the edges for a border that looks like a custom wood frame. It’s waterproof, heat-resistant, and fade-proof, so it works in steamy bathrooms, hot kitchens, and sunny corners.

An Electrical Outlet Cover That Solves The Bulky Plug Problem

Sleek Socket Ultra-Thin Electrical Outlet Cover

Amazon -

If you know the frustration of a bulky plug keeping your furniture from sitting flush, you need a Sleek Socket. Its ultra-thin plate covers your outlet, hugs the wall, and reroutes power to a three-outlet strip on a 3-foot cord. I have one in nearly every room, and my couch finally sits right up against the wall. Don’t just take my word for it, though. More than 26,000 Amazon shoppers have rated it five stars.

A Magnetic Dishwasher Cover That Gives Your Appliance A Dramatic Makeover

AOHMPT Dishwasher Magnet

Amazon -

Dents and scratches shouldn’t be grounds for replacing a working dishwasher. Instead, give it a makeover with this magnetic cover. It sticks to the door, hides cosmetic flaws, and creates a dramatic focal point in your kitchen. It comes in multiple designs printed to look like embossed metal, plus a few holiday-themed options. One shopper wrote, “Now I smile when I enter my kitchen because there is a bit of beauty.”

A Himalayan Salt Lamp That Glows In 3 Color Temperatures

Runyangshi Himalayan Salt Night Lamp

Amazon -

Add some relaxing mood lighting to your bedroom with this creative, pint-sized take on a Himalayan salt lamp. Instead of a single glowing crystal, this version features a glass jar filled with chunks of pink salt, capped with a cork sphere. It runs on USB power, offers three white light temperatures, and doubles as a diffuser — just add a few drops of essential oil to the salt for aromatherapy benefits.

Stained Glass Window Film That Give Your Home Privacy & Jewel-Toned Light

DKTIE Stained Glass Window Film

amazon -

You don’t need to live in a chapel or a historic home to enjoy colorful windows. This frosted film mimics stained glass, right down to its textured surface. White panels and jewel-toned diamonds deliver the perfect trifecta of privacy, softly filtered light, and pops of color. It’s also a smart pick for renters, since there’s no drilling holes for blinds or curtain rods.

Sturdy Cast Iron Wall Hooks That Look Like Birds In Flight

Ambipolar Cast Iron Wall Hooks (5-Pack)

amazon -

When you want wall hooks that don’t look like they came from a hardware store, these cast-iron birds are a whimsical choice. Each one is shaped like a gull in flight, and its outstretched wing doubles as a spot to hang coats, bags, hats, and more. Each hook holds up to 35 pounds, and the set includes matching screws and drywall anchors. Mount them in a cluster, and they’ll look like a flock soaring across your wall.

Toilet Decals That Make A Plain Porcelain Bowl Look Custom

Fumwase Toilet Tank Stickers (2-Pack)

Amazon -

Nobody thinks of their toilet bowl as a spot to decorate, but these decals may change minds. The set includes two pieces — one for the seat and one for the tank — featuring line drawings of wildflowers and butterflies. You can remove and reposition them as needed; they also work on other smooth surfaces like walls and windows.

Room Divider Panels That Create Custom Spaces Without Construction

KEIBIKEIDI Hanging Room Dividers (16 Pieces)

Amazon -

Open floor plans and studio apartments are great until you want a moment to yourself. These white hanging room divider panels add privacy without the bulk of a traditional screen. The set includes 16 white panels with delicate flower and butterfly cutouts that let air and light filter through. Connecting rings link them into whatever shape and length you like, and the finished piece looks like a cool art installation.

A Popular Towel Set Made From 100% Soft, Absorbent Cotton

Amrapur Overseas 6-Piece Jacquard Towel Set

Amazon -

If you want your bathroom to look bougie, start with matching towels. This popular set is made from 100% combed cotton with a substantial weight for plushness and absorption. It includes six pieces — two bath towels, two hand towels, and two washcloths — to cover all the bases, and comes in aesthetically pleasing soft colors. The jacquard design keeps them from being boring, and they’re machine-washable for easy care.

Wood Grain Peel-&-Stick Paper That Instantly Refreshes Surfaces

WESTICK Peel & Stick Wood Contact Paper

Amazon -

Before you give up on a dated piece of furniture, consider refreshing it with this heavy-duty contact paper. Made from vinyl, it features a faux wood grain with a dark stain. Grid marks make it easy to measure for cutting, and the adhesive is secure but removable when you’re ready for something new. One shopper used it to cover her “awful” counters and wrote, “It's a very nice, classy instant upgrade if you're looking for a cheap option to get you through.”

Adjustable Night-Lights With Modern Looks & Functionality

JandCase LED Night-Light (2-Pack)

Amazon -

If you’re looking for night-lights that don’t look like they were poached from a nursery, try these modern plug-ins. The box shape and slatted design make them look like contemporary mini sconces. You can adjust the brightness with the click of a button, and dusk-to-dawn sensors handle the power. Amazon shoppers praise the design as “slick,” “classy looking,” and “modern yet chic.”

An Entryway Rug That Welcomes Guests With A Pop Of Color

PLHXFR Entryway Rug

Amazon -

Your entryway is the first thing guests see, and this rug gives them an enthusiastic welcome. The floral patterns are perfect for anyone who isn’t afraid of color, and it’s designed to withstand busy households. The low pile lets the front door swing right over it, and a nonslip backing keeps it secure in areas with heavy foot traffic. It’s durable enough to handle mud and spills, and it’s machine washable whenever it needs cleaning.

A Low-Tech Bidet That Gives Your Toilet A Luxury Upgrade For Less

LUXE Bidet Attachment

Amazon -

If no one has put you on to bidets yet, this attachment lets you give it a try for cheap. It fits right under your existing toilet seat and doesn't require electricity. A rear wash nozzle provides a more thorough clean than toilet paper alone, and a dial lets you adjust the water pressure for comfort. With nearly 8,000 five-star ratings, you may find that it’s the first and last bidet you’ll ever need.

A Foaming Soap Dispenser That Makes Your Sink Setup Look Chic

zuxzmj Glass Foaming Hand Soap Dispenser

Amazon -

Swapping a plastic soap bottle for this glass dispenser is an easy move for a bougier bathroom. The embossed glass body comes in a variety of colors and pairs with either a modern matte black or glam gold pump. It turns diluted liquid hand or dish soap into smooth foam to help reduce waste, and its wide opening makes refills quick and mess-free.

A Polished Paper Towel Holder That Keeps Your Rolls Off The Counter

niffgaff Paper Towel Holder

amazon -

Counter space is precious, this wall-mounted paper towel holder gives you a sleek, space-saving alternative to a standing holder. Simply stick or screw it under a cabinet or against a wall for easy access. It comes in four colors, so you can coordinate with your hardware, and it also works great for hanging utensils, dish towels, foil, or plastic wrap.

Bendable, Textured Willow Branches With Warm, Glowing Fairy Lights

Hairui Willow Branch Lights

amazon -

These light-up faux willow branches are a brilliant shortcut for adding atmosphere to any room. Bend them to sit alone in a vase, add them to holiday arrangements, or incorporate them into centerpieces for height and light with minimal effort. They’re pre-strung to save you time, and they’re battery-operated for cordless convenience. They’re also IP44 waterproof, so you can use them indoors or out.

An Adhesive Transition Strip That Makes Your Floors Look Finished

Art3d Floor Transition Strip

amazon -

That awkward, uneven gap where two floors meet can make a space look unfinished, even when everything else is lovely. This self-adhesive transition strip covers it in seconds for a polished, professional-looking finish. The sturdy PVC is durable, easy to clean, and comes in multiple colors and faux wood finishes to match a wide range of flooring. To install, just cut it to length with scissors, peel, and stick.

A Blooming Throw Pillow That Adds Romance To Any Room

JWH 3D Flower Throw Pillow Cover

Amazon -

Before you buy another square throw pillow, consider mixing things up with this gorgeous blooming rose throw pillow cover. The layered petals have a slight sheen, adding texture and dimension to your bed or sofa. It's available in a dozen colors, from a range of soft pink hues to moody gray and burgundy.

A Soft Stone-Looking Bath Mat That Is Highly Absorbent

ZHUZHISHAN Diatomaceous Earth Bath Mat

Amazon -

No one likes stepping onto a soggy bath mat, and this version spares you from that cold, clammy feeling. It’s made from diatomite, a porous material that soaks up moisture fast and dries in minutes. A nonslip rubber backing keeps it in place on tile, and the river rock pattern gives your bathroom a high-end spa vibe for way less than you’d expect.

Decorative Curtain Tiebacks That Secure Drapes With A Single Snap

Hion Magnetic Curtain Tiebacks (2 Pieces)

Amazon -

Pulling back your curtains is a small step to make your windows look styled, and these popular magnetic tiebacks do the job for a great price. Just wrap the silky rope around your panels, then click the pearl-studded balls together for a firm hold. They’re a simple but stylish solution that saves you from drilling into your wall. More than 10,000 Amazon shoppers rated it five stars.

A Ruffled Bed Skirt That Gives Your Room A More Finished Look

Amazon Basics Lightweight Ruffled Bed Skirt

Amazon -

It’s hard to get good rest when the first thing you see in your bedroom is all the stuff crammed under your bed. This bed skirt covers it all while adding a soft, finished look to your setup. The ruffled hem adds slight volume, and the 16-inch drop creates a curtain that hides clutter and dust bunnies. Made from 100% microfiber, it’s machine-washable and wrinkle-resistant for easy care.

An Ornate Light Switch Plate With Major Versailles Energy

Spshian Embossed Light Switch Plate

amazon -

Maximalists and coquettes shouldn’t settle for a plain light switch cover. This embossed plate is over-the-top in the best way, adding texture and color where you least expect it. The ornate, raised design resembles antique plasterwork, and the pretty colored finish instantly stands out on any wall. Matching screws are included for a seamless finish — just grab a screwdriver for a quick swap-out that makes a lasting impression.

Highly Rated Botanical Decals To Embellish Walls Without Paint

RoomMates Peel and Stick Wall Decals

amazon -
