The quick-drying material has a nonslip backing and can be tossed in the washing machine when it needs a refresh. It also comes in plenty of sizes and colors, making it easy to find an option that works with your bathroom.

item.title: 50 Weird Grooming Hacks That Make You Look So Damn Good
item.description: These clever grooming upgrades are weird enough to make you curious and useful enough to keep around.
item.dc:creator: Tanisha Pina
item.content:encoded:
Every good beauty or maintenance routine involves at least a few unusual steps. In fact, the more eyebrow raises, the better. Without gatekeeping, ahead is a list of some of the smartest beauty hacks that involve products you probably wouldn't think to look for in the first place — and you don't need to spend a fortune to get impressive results, either. These clever grooming upgrades are weird enough to make you curious and useful enough to keep around.

Buff Away Flaky Lips With A Sugar Scrub In A Stick

e.l.f. Lip Exfoliator

Amazon -

Dry, flaky lips can make even your favorite lipstick look patchy, which is where this lip exfoliator comes in. Instead of digging into a messy jar, you can swipe the sugar-based formula directly onto your lips to buff away dead skin. Jojoba oil, shea butter, and vitamin E help keep everything soft and moisturized, leaving you with a smoother canvas for lip color.

Make Your Natural Nails Look Flawless With A Milky-Pink Polish

LONDONTOWN Illuminating Nail Concealer

Amazon -

If your nails are looking yellowed or uneven but you're not in the mood for a full manicure, this illuminating nail concealer offers an easy fix. The sheer, milky-pink polish disguises discoloration while giving nails a glossy, healthy-looking finish. It also contains biotin and botanical ingredients to condition your nails, so it’s great for a little rehab before your next set of acrylics or press-ons.

Reset Oily Roots & Get Rid Of Product Buildup With A Shampoo Bar

Ethique Clarifying Solid Shampoo Bar

Amazon -

If your roots get oily quickly or you use a lot of styling products, this clarifying shampoo bar helps wash away buildup without taking up much space in your shower. It lathers directly in wet hair and contains citrus oils, castor oil, and ginseng extract for a refreshing cleanse. One bar is designed to replace three bottles of liquid shampoo, making it particularly convenient for travel.

Soften Dry, Cracked Heels With These Moisturizing Socks

LOVE, LORI Moisturizing Socks

amazon -

These moisturizing gel socks are a clever way to soften dry, cracked heels without booking a pedicure. The silicone lining is infused with vitamin E, jojoba oil, and other nourishing ingredients that moisturize your feet while you wear them. Just slip them on for about 20 minutes while you're watching TV, then wash and reuse them whenever your feet need another little treatment.

Give Your Legs An Airbrushed Finish Without Wearing Tights

Sally Hansen Airbrush Legs

Amazon -

For days when you want your legs to look a little more even-toned, this Sally Hansen leg makeup works like foundation for your body. The lightweight lotion helps disguise the appearance of veins, freckles, and uneven coloring while giving skin a subtle, sun-kissed finish. It dries in about a minute, resists water and transfer, and washes off with soap and water whenever you're ready.

Give Your Hair & Skin A Softer Feel By Filtering Your Shower Water

VOESH Vitamin C Shower Filter

Amazon -

Your shower water could be contributing to dry-feeling hair and skin, and this vitamin C shower filter offers a surprisingly simple upgrade. It attaches between your shower arm and showerhead to help reduce chlorine and other impurities, while adding a spa-like fragrance to your bathroom. Available in scents like Lavender Land and Blossom Bliss, it's also designed to be gentle on color-treated hair.

Keep Ingrown Hairs At Bay With A Roll-On Treatment

Peach Slices Ingrown Hair Treatment

Amazon -

Dealing with bumps after shaving is annoying enough without having to awkwardly apply treatment to your bikini line or underarms. This ingrown hair treatment has a 360-degree roller that makes it easy to reach those areas without getting product all over your hands. Its blend of exfoliating acids helps clear buildup around hair follicles, while niacinamide, aloe, and cica work to soothe skin and improve the appearance of dark spots.

Condition Your Lashes & Brows With This Castor Oil Serum

Live Fraiche Castor Oil Lash Serum

Amazon -

If you're curious about using castor oil on your lashes and brows, this organic castor oil serum makes application much less messy. It comes in a dual-ended tube with a fine brush for the lash line and a mascara-style wand to coat lashes and groom brows. The single-ingredient formula also works as a moisturizing treatment for dry hair ends and your scalp, making it useful well beyond your makeup bag.

Smooth Crepey-Looking Skin With A Retinol Body Lotion

Medix 5.5 Retinol Body Lotion

Amazon -

Retinol isn't just for your face, and this retinol body lotion brings its smoothing benefits to your arms, legs, and anywhere else that could use some attention. The formula pairs retinol and ferulic acid to help improve the appearance of uneven texture, while shea butter, aloe, and vitamin E provide moisture. Despite its rich consistency, it absorbs without leaving a greasy film.

Map Your Brows For Symmetry With This Patented Tool

Billion Dollar Brows Eyebrow Shaping Tool (2 Pieces)

Amazon -

If you love the way professionals can map your eyebrows, you can actually do it yourself too. This patented eyebrow-shaping tool adapts to your face shape to give you a custom mapping of your ideal start, arch, and end points. It comes with a white pencil to mark your points and is an especially useful upgrade if brow maintenance is something you already do from home.

Keep Freshly Washed Skin Clean With These Single-Use Face Towels

Grace & Stella Ultra-Soft Face Towels

Amazon -

Your regular bathroom towel might not be the cleanest thing to put against freshly washed skin, which makes these disposable face towels a smart skin-care upgrade. Each oversized, biodegradable towel has a smooth side for gently drying your face and a textured side for light exfoliation. They're also lint-free and soft enough for sensitive skin, and you can use them wet with your favorite cleanser or makeup remover.

Fill In Sparse Brows With A Dual-Ended Pencil

e.l.f. Instant Lift Brow Pencil

Amazon -

A little eyebrow definition can change your whole face, and this retractable brow pencil makes it easy to get the shape you want. The fine tip lets you draw small, precise strokes to fill in gaps, while the spoolie on the opposite end blends the color and brushes hairs into place. Its creamy, smudge-resistant formula is buildable, so you can keep your brows looking natural rather than overly drawn on.

Tackle Strawberry Skin With An Acid-Infused Body Scrub

frank body Glycolic Acid Body Scrub | Exfoliating Body Scrub for Strawberry Skin, KP, Bumps & Ingrowns | Smooths Rough Skin on Legs, Arms, Back & Bum | Niacinamide, Witch Hazel & Pumice | 8.82 oz

Amazon -

For stubborn bumps and rough texture, this glycolic acid body scrub takes a two-pronged approach to exfoliation. Glycolic, lactic, and salicylic acids help loosen dead skin and pore buildup, while finely textured pumice physically buffs away rough patches. It also contains niacinamide and witch hazel, and you can use it on your arms, legs, back, and even your bottom a few times a week.

Brighten Your Smile Between Dentist Visits With A Whitening Pen

GuruNanda Teeth Whitening Pen

Amazon -

Coffee, tea, and red wine can leave their mark on your teeth, but this teeth-whitening pen makes tackling surface stains pretty straightforward. The mint-flavored hydrogen peroxide gel comes with a soft brush tip for applying a thin, even layer without dealing with strips or trays. Leave it on for 15 minutes before rinsing, and use it consistently to gradually brighten your smile.

Spot Every Last Peach Fuzz Hair With This Clever Dermaplaning Spray

enttgo Hair Identifier Spray

Amazon -

Even with a magnifying mirror, it's surprisingly easy to miss fine facial hairs when dermaplaning. This hair identifier spray coats those barely visible strands so you can see exactly where to shave, making the whole process more precise. It also creates a protective layer to help reduce friction, and the set includes four guarded facial razors to get you started.

Get Rid Of Peach Fuzz With These Beginner-Friendly Face Razors

40pcs Dermaplaning Tool for Women, Newbie Friendly Facial Hair Removal | Stainless Steel Face Eyebrow Razors and Shaver with Protective Covers for Peach Fuzz Remover (Cream Gray Brown)

Amazon -

These dermaplaning razors make removing peach fuzz and tidying up your eyebrows so easy to do at home. Each one has a slim, angled blade with a protective guard, giving you more control as you gently shave away fine facial hair and dead skin. The pack comes with 40 razors (!) in three neutral colors, so you'll have plenty of backups when it's time for a fresh blade.

Turn Your Shower Into A Mini Spa With A Soap-Infused Sponge

Spongellé French Lavender Wild Flower Bath Sponge

Amazon -

Forget juggling a loofah and a bottle of body wash; this soap-infused bath sponge handles cleansing and exfoliating in one step. Simply wet and squeeze it to release a rich lather, then massage it over your skin to wash away dirt and buff off roughness. The French lavender scent makes your shower feel a little more luxurious, and each sponge lasts for at least 14 uses.

Give Your Face A Plumper Look With A 2-Piece Collagen Mask

Dr.Jart+ Hydro Firming Korean Face Mask

Amazon -

This collagen sheet mask comes in two separate pieces, making it easier to position around the contours of your face than a traditional single sheet. It's soaked in a hydrating serum with collagen and hyaluronic acid to help skin look plumper, smoother, and more refreshed. Leave it on for 20 minutes, then massage in the remaining serum for an extra dose of moisture.

Get Fresher Breath By Scraping The Buildup Your Toothbrush Might Miss

MasterMedi 2 Pack Tounge Scraper

Amazon -

Brushing your teeth doesn't always take care of everything contributing to bad breath, which is where these stainless steel tongue scrapers come in. The curved, U-shaped design gently removes buildup from the surface of your tongue, with two handles that make it easy to control. They're reusable, dishwasher-safe, and come with individual travel cases, so you can keep one at home and one in your toiletry bag.

Slough Off Dry, Flaky Skin With A Brown Sugar Scrub

Brooklyn Botany Brown Sugar Body Scrub

Amazon -

There's a reason sugar scrubs are a forever bathroom staple, and this brown sugar body scrub goes beyond basic exfoliation. The sugar granules gently buff away flaky skin, while sweet almond oil, jojoba oil, and vitamin E help leave it feeling soft rather than stripped. You can use it on your body, hands, and feet, or even as a lip scrub when you're dealing with dry patches.

Make Dry Lips Look Juicier With A Cooling Serum

SKINTIFIC Brightening Lip Serum

Amazon -

This brightening lip serum has a cooling metal applicator that makes putting on lip treatment feel like a mini facial. The lightweight formula combines peptides, vitamin C, squalane, and ceramides to moisturize, smooth, and help improve the appearance of dull, dry lips. It leaves behind a glossy, fuller-looking finish without a sticky feel, and you can wear it alone or layer it over your favorite lip color.

Blast Away Plaque Your Stubborn With A Cordless Water Flosser

Waterpik Cordless Water Flosser

Amazon -

If traditional flossing feels like a chore, this cordless water flosser offers another way to clean along your gumline and between your teeth. It uses targeted pulses of water to flush out food particles and plaque, with two pressure settings so you can adjust the intensity. The waterproof design even lets you use it in the shower, and it runs on AA batteries rather than needing a charging station.

Fade The Look Of Dark Spots With A Turmeric & Kojic Acid Soap

VALITIC Kojic Dark Spot Remover Soap (2-Pack)

Amazon -

This kojic acid soap combines two popular brightening ingredients, turmeric and kojic acid, to help improve the appearance of dark spots and uneven skin tone. It also contains retinol, vitamin C, and moisturizing shea butter, so you're getting more than a basic cleansing bar. You can use it on areas like your underarms, inner thighs, and neck, making it a handy addition to your body-care routine.

Buff Away Rough Heels With A Long-Lasting Terracotta Scrubber

GILDEN TREE Pumice Stone

Amazon -

Unlike pumice stones that gradually crumble, this terracotta foot scrubber is designed to hold up through years of pedicures. The handmade tool has two distinct sides: a rough surface for tackling calluses and a smoother, ridged surface for buffing away remaining roughness. Its palm-friendly shape makes it easy to grip, and you can also use it on dry elbows and hands.

Smooth Out Stubborn Body Bumps With A Gentle Peel

Medicube Body Peel Shot With Hypochlorous Acid

Amazon -

If you've noticed rough patches or tiny bumps on your arms and legs, this body peeling treatment is worth adding to your shower routine. The lightweight liquid helps exfoliate dead skin while hypochlorous acid calms and purifies, and rice extracts and panthenol provide hydration. Apply it to the areas that need attention, let it sit for a few minutes, and rinse to help reveal smoother-feeling skin.

Scrub Your Back With The TikTok-Famous African Net Sponge

Kitsch African Net Sponge – Exfoliating Body Scrubber for Cleansing & Gentle Daily Exfoliation – Stretchable Bath Sponge for Hard-to-Reach Areas, Long-Lasting Shower Essential - Berry Pink, 3 Pcs

Amazon -

The TikTok hype around African net sponges makes sense once you see how practical they are. Unlike a traditional loofah, the long, stretchy mesh can be pulled across your back to reach spots that are otherwise difficult to scrub, while its textured material helps exfoliate and create a rich lather. It also dries quickly between showers, and this pack comes with three sponges.

Wake Up To Curled Lashes For Weeks With An At-Home Lash Lift Kit

Korean Lash Lift Kit

Amazon -

If your lashes refuse to hold a curl, this Korean lash lift kit offers a longer-lasting alternative to reaching for your curler every morning. It comes with perming and setting solutions, nourishing lotion, and silicone rods in three sizes to help create a lifted, curled effect that can last up to eight weeks. Plus, there are enough supplies for five full treatments.

Get A Custom Sun-Kissed Tan By Mixing These Drops Into Your Favorite Moisturizer

Beauty by Earth Self Tanning Drops

Amazon -

Getting a sun-kissed look without lying in the sun is easier when you can control the color yourself. These self-tanning drops mix directly into your favorite moisturizer, so you can add a few drops for subtle warmth or more for a deeper tan. The formula contains aloe, squalane, and nourishing plant oils, and it develops over approximately six hours without requiring a separate tanning mousse.

Brush Away Flaky Skin Before You Step Into The Shower

POPCHOSE Dry Brushing Body Brush

Amazon -

A few minutes with this dry body brush can help make rough, flaky skin feel noticeably smoother. Its natural boar bristles gently exfoliate as you brush over dry skin, while the palm-sized wooden handle and cotton strap give you a secure grip. Use light, sweeping strokes before showering, then follow with your usual body lotion to lock in moisture.

Fake A Fresh Pedicure In Minutes With Press-On Toenails

BTArtbox Press on Toenails

Amazon -

When you don't have time for a salon appointment, these press-on toenails can give you a glossy French pedicure without waiting for polish to dry. The short, squoval tips come in multiple sizes to fit your toes, and the kit includes glue, adhesive tabs, a nail file, and prep supplies. They're designed to last up to two weeks or longer, making them a convenient option before a vacation or special occasion.

Plump Up Dry Lips With These Collagen-Infused Gel Patches

Miniling Plumping Lip Masks (20-Pack)

Amazon -

If your lips are feeling dry or looking a little lined, these gel lip masks offer a quick moisture boost. Each lip-shaped patch is infused with collagen, hyaluronic acid, and cherry extract to help lips feel softer and appear smoother and fuller. Leave one on for about 20 minutes, then massage in the remaining serum before applying your favorite lip balm or lipstick.

Tidy Up Overgrown Cuticles With A 2-In-1 Nail Care Pen

Sally Hansen Push & Buff Cuticle Pen

amazon -

You don't need an entire manicure kit to make your cuticles look neat, thanks to this Sally Hansen cuticle pen. Its textured ceramic tip gently pushes back and exfoliates excess cuticle, while the built-in oil formula contains centella, sweet almond oil, and apricot oil to soften the surrounding skin. Just twist the pen to dispense the treatment and work it along your nail beds for a quick manicure refresh.

Tame Flyaways & Add Shine With A Folding Boar Bristle Brush

Ancable Travel Boar Bristle Brush

Amazon -

For those moments when your hair needs a quick refresh, this folding boar-bristle brush is small enough to keep in your purse. The combination of natural boar bristles and nylon pins helps smooth flyaways, work through minor tangles, and distribute your scalp's natural oils along your strands for added shine. It folds in half to take up barely any room, making it a useful little grooming tool for touch-ups throughout the day.

Keep Your Skin From Feeling Tight After Showering With This Cleansing Oil

Nivea Shower Oil

amazon -

If your skin feels tight after showering, swapping your regular body wash for this moisturizing shower oil could make a difference. Its formula contains 55% natural oils to cleanse while helping skin feel softer and more comfortable, rather than leaving it stripped. Massage it onto wet skin and rinse as usual for a little extra moisture without adding another step after your shower.

Remove Unwanted Facial Hair With A Lipstick-Sized Shaver

innobeaut Facial Hair Remover

Amazon -

This electric facial hair remover looks a little like a lipstick tube, but it's actually a rechargeable shaver designed for peach fuzz on your upper lip, chin, and cheeks. Its rounded foil head gently trims fine hairs without requiring shaving cream, while a built-in LED light helps you spot strands you might otherwise miss. It's small enough to keep in your bag for quick touch-ups.

Peel Away Dead Skin With These Exfoliating Foot Masks

Plantifique Foot Peel Masks (2-pack)

Amazon -

These exfoliating foot masks might be the strangest way to get softer feet, but that's part of their appeal. Slip on the solution-filled booties for up to 90 minutes, then watch as dry, dead skin gradually starts peeling away over the following days. The formula combines lactic acid and urea with moisturizing ingredients like glycerin and aloe to help tackle rough heels and calluses.

Smell Like A Pistachio Dessert From Head To Toe

eos Cashmere Body Mist

Amazon -

This pistachio-scented body mist is an easy way to smell delicious from head to toe without reaching for a heavy perfume. Notes of toasted pistachio, vanilla toffee, and coconut create a warm, sweet scent, while hyaluronic acid and aloe hydrate your skin. You can spritz it on your hair and clothes, too, or layer it with a matching lotion for a more noticeable fragrance.

Get Rid Of Coffee & Wine Stains With A Whitening Toothpaste

Crest 3D White Deep Stain Removing Toothpaste (2-Pack)

Amazon -

If your daily coffee habit is starting to show on your teeth, swapping your usual toothpaste for this Crest whitening toothpaste could help. The enamel-safe formula is designed to lift surface stains from coffee, tea, wine, and other dark foods, with the brand claiming visible whitening in as little as one day. It also contains fluoride for cavity protection and helps prevent new stains from sticking to your teeth.

De-Puff Your Face With A Cooling Stainless Steel Gua Sha Tool

Kitsch Stainless Steel Guasha Tool

amazon -

If you love a little facial massage in the morning, this stainless steel gua sha tool has a few advantages over traditional stone versions. The metal stays naturally cool against your skin, making it particularly refreshing when your face looks puffy, and its smooth edges glide easily over facial oil. It's also nonporous and easy to clean, so you don't have to worry about product soaking into the surface.

Bring Limp Curls Back To Life By Removing Hard-Water Buildup

Malibu C Curl Partner Wellness Remedy

Amazon -

Sometimes your curls need more than another styling product. This Malibu C curl treatment tackles the mineral buildup that can weigh them down. The vitamin C-based crystals dissolve in your wet palm, then work through your hair to help remove deposits left behind by hard water. Leave the treatment on for about five minutes before shampooing again and rinsing for curls that feel lighter and have more bounce.

Darken Your Lashes & Brows For Up To 4 Weeks With An At-Home Tint

Luxe Cosmetics Lash & Brow Tint Set

Amazon -

For naturally light lashes or brows that seem to disappear without makeup, this lash and brow tint kit offers longer-lasting definition. The two-part cream formula develops into a black tint that can last for up to four weeks, helping hairs look darker without daily mascara or brow pencil. It's designed for at-home use, though you'll want to follow the safety instructions carefully and avoid getting the dye in your eyes.

Keep Your Cuticles Soft & Hydrated With A Mess-Free Roll-On Oil

essie Roll-On Apricot Cuticle Oil

Amazon -

Dry, ragged cuticles can make an otherwise nice manicure look a little worse for wear, but this essie cuticle oil makes taking care of them incredibly easy. Instead of dealing with a drippy brush or dropper, the rollerball applicator lets you apply the nourishing blend of apricot and jojoba oils directly around each nail. The formula absorbs quickly, so you can keep it in your bag for touch-ups throughout the day.

Reach Every Inch Of Your Back With This Self-Tanning Applicator Kit

G GAIYAH Self Tanner Applicator Kit (3 Pieces)

Amazon -

Applying self-tanner to your back is practically a gymnastics routine, which is why this three-piece tanning applicator kit is so useful. It includes a long back applicator for hard-to-reach spots, a velvet mitt for blending color across larger areas, and a soft kabuki brush for smaller areas like your hands, feet, and face. The waterproof lining also keeps tanning formula off your palms, helping you avoid telltale orange hands.

Give Your Butt A Mini Facial With These Caffeine-Infused Sheet Masks

BAWDY Slap It Caffeine Beauty Butt Mask

Amazon -

Yes, sheet masks for your butt are a thing, and these caffeine-infused butt masks make for a pretty entertaining addition to your body-care routine. They're formulated with plant-based collagen, aloe, and grape seed extract to hydrate skin and help improve the appearance of texture and tone. Apply the sheets to clean skin for 10 to 15 minutes, then peel them off for a little extra softness.

Get The Look Of Lash Extensions Without A Salon Appointment

Goddvenus Lash Clusters Kit (300 Pieces)

Amazon -

If you love the look of lash extensions but not the upkeep or price, these DIY lash clusters offer a more customizable alternative. The kit contains 300 wispy clusters with lightweight bands that you can arrange along your lash line to add fullness exactly where you want it. You can keep the effect subtle for everyday wear or layer on a few extra clusters for a more dramatic finish.

Lift Away Dead Skin Without Harsh Scrubbing With An Enzyme Peeling Gel

MANYO Galactomy Enzyme Peeling Gel

Amazon -

If traditional facial scrubs feel too abrasive, this Korean enzyme peeling gel offers another way to deal with dullness and rough texture. The formula uses papain enzymes to help loosen dead skin cells and buildup, while hyaluronic acid and amino acids provide hydration. Massage it gently onto clean, dry skin before rinsing to help leave your face feeling smoother and looking fresher.

Calm A Puffy Morning Face With A Reusable Cooling Gel Mask

ZNÖCUETÖD Cold Face Mask

Amazon -

Whether you slept poorly or woke up feeling a little swollen, this reusable cooling face mask makes it easy to give your face a refreshing cold treatment. The gel-filled design covers your forehead, cheeks, and eye area, with adjustable straps to keep it in place while you relax. Pop it in the freezer ahead of time for a cooling session, or warm it according to the instructions when you'd rather have soothing heat.

Target Stubborn Blackheads With A Set Of Precision Extraction Tools

JPNK Blackhead Remover Kit

Amazon -

This six-piece blackhead extractor kit comes with an assortment of stainless steel tools designed to address different types of clogged pores. The various looped and angled tips help you access tricky areas around your nose, while textured handles offer a more secure grip. Everything fits inside a compact storage case, though it's important to use gentle pressure and avoid attempting to extract deep or inflamed blemishes.

Soften Stubborn Heel Calluses In Minutes With A Pedicure Gel

Lee Beauty Professional Callus Remover Gel

Amazon -

If your heels have rough patches that regular scrubbing barely touches, this callus remover gel can help loosen hardened skin before you reach for a foot file. Apply it to callused areas after soaking your feet, let it work for five to 10 minutes, then gently remove the softened buildup with a pumice stone or rasp. It's a handy way to tackle stubborn calluses at home, but be sure to wear gloves and keep the strong formula away from healthy skin.

Get A Long-Lasting Lash Curl Without Pinching Your Eyelids

DUDUDU Heated Eyelash Curler

Amazon -

Traditional lash curlers can be awkward to use, but this heated eyelash curler swaps the usual metal clamp for a gently curved silicone pad. It heats up in about 10 seconds, offers two temperature settings, and has a color-changing indicator, so you know when it's ready. The compact, USB-C rechargeable design fits easily in a makeup bag, and the brand claims it can keep lashes curled for up to 24 hours.
